Title: Digital Performance Marketing Analyst
HTML:
Chi è Redcare Pharmacy

Redcare Pharmacy è la farmacia online n. 1 in Europa, guidata da persone appassionate e da un forte spirito di innovazione. Ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente di lavoro sano e collaborativo, in cui ogni persona si senta valorizzata e motivata a contribuire alla nostra visione: “Until every human has their health”.

Se desideri una carriera che abbia un vero significato e sia in linea con i tuoi valori, unisciti a noi e inizia oggi stesso la tua #Redcareer.

Job Description

Il tuo ruolo:

Il tuo ruolo

In qualità di Digital Performance Marketing Analyst (m/f/d), entrerai a far parte del team Retail Media di Redcare, contribuendo alla crescita del business attraverso un approccio data-driven e orientato all’ottimizzazione delle performance digitali.

Ti occuperai di impostare, attivare, monitorare e ottimizzare campagne digitali per i nostri partner, su canali onsite e offsite. Analizzerai dati provenienti da fonti differenti, sviluppando report, dashboard e insight operativi utili a individuare trend, supportare le decisioni strategiche e migliorare concretamente i risultati delle campagne.

Le tue attività:

  • Configurare e attivare campagne Retail Media onsite sul sito e sull’app Redcare per i nostri partner;
  • Analizzare dati provenienti dalle campagne digitali e da diverse fonti aziendali;
  • Gestire, consolidare e incrociare database di grandi dimensioni utilizzando Excel;
  • Sviluppare report, dashboard e analisi delle performance;
  • Interpretare i risultati e trasformarli in insight e raccomandazioni operative per ottimizzare le campagne;
  • Collaborare con i team Marketing, Campaign Management, Ad Tech e Commerciale per supportare decisioni data-driven e migliorare continuamente le performance.

Qualifications

Il tuo profilo:

  • Almeno 2 anni di esperienza in ambito Data Analysis, Performance Marketing o ruoli affini, preferibilmente in contesti strutturati;
  • Spiccate capacità analitiche e approccio data-driven, con esperienza nella gestione di database complessi, nell’interpretazione dei dati e nella trasformazione dei risultati in insight e raccomandazioni operative;
  • Conoscenza avanzata di Microsoft Excel, incluse formule e strumenti di analisi; la conoscenza di Power Query o di altri strumenti di data analysis costituisce un vantaggio;
  • Capacità di sviluppare report e dashboard chiari ed efficaci;
  • Precisione, attenzione ai dettagli e problem solving, unite a solide capacità organizzative e di gestione di attività e stakeholder differenti;
  • Ottima conoscenza dell’italiano e dell’inglese, scritto e parlato, considerando che circa l’80% delle comunicazioni avverrà in inglese;
  • La conoscenza di Google Ads, Econda e Contentsquare sarà considerata un valore aggiunto.

Additional Information

I tuoi benefit:

Per offrirti il miglior supporto possibile in base alle tue esigenze individuali — che si tratti di vivere in modo sano, avere tempo per te o sviluppare le tue competenze — offriamo un’ampia gamma di benefit:

Welcome days: vogliamo che tu ti senta a tuo agio fin dal primo giorno, per questo ti accoglieremo con un programma di onboarding dedicato.

Mental health: se ti senti sopraffatto/a nella vita personale o professionale, puoi ricevere supporto rapido e professionale da psicologi tramite nilo, in modo anonimo e gratuito.

Smart working: quando il ruolo non richiede la presenza in sede, prevediamo modalità di lavoro ibrido con la possibilità di lavorare da remoto.

Redcare Events: possiamo crescere solo insieme. Promuoviamo lo spirito di squadra attraverso eventi di team e corporate, celebrando regolarmente i nostri successi tutti insieme.

Training and personal growth: incoraggiamo l’apprendimento continuo e la crescita attraverso training, workshop e percorsi formativi interni ed esterni.

Employee discount: naturalmente, potrai usufruire di sconti sul nostro webshop.

Title: Strategy Analyst
Description:
Sector Alarm: sicurezza, innovazione e crescita 

Con 730.000 clienti in tutta Europa e una crescita costante, Sector Alarm è tra i leader nel settore della sicurezza. Operiamo in 8 Paesi con una squadra di 3.700 persone, offrendo soluzioni all'avanguardia per proteggere famiglie e piccole imprese. 

Siamo un’azienda in forte espansione e crediamo nel talento: cerchiamo persone ambiziose, orientate al cliente e agli obiettivi, pronte a crescere in un ambiente dinamico e collaborativo. Se la sicurezza e l’innovazione ti appassionano, unisciti a noi! 

Strategy Analyst  

Siamo alla ricerca di un* Strategy Analyst da inserire nel nostro team, a diretto riporto dello Strategy Manager. La figura selezionata supporterà l'execution operativa delle iniziative di value creation del team, con particolare focus sulla gestione degli strumenti di incentivazione commerciale, sul reporting delle performance di vendita e sulla costruzione di business case.

Questa posizione offre un percorso di crescita verso maggiore autonomia analitica e progettuale, con possibili sviluppi futuri in base alle esigenze aziendali e al percorso della persona.

Quali saranno le sue responsabilità?


Supporto nella preparazione e attuazione di strategie commerciali e finanziarie, per garantire una crescita efficiente della base clienti
Collaborazione e monitoraggio delle iniziative di ottimizzazione dei costi, insieme alla direzione finanziaria e operativa, nell'attività commerciale, con focus particolare sul CPA (cost per acquisition)
Organizzazione ed esecuzione dei processi di reporting per il monitoraggio dell'attività commerciale, anche attraverso l’ideazione/ implementazione di dashboard sui gestionali aziendali (e.g. Power BI)
Supporto operativo al business development (realizzazione di materiale, reportistica, follow-up con i contatti esistenti)
Supporto allo sviluppo, alla gestione e al monitoraggio della strategia go-to-market della forza vendita, tra cui:
Sviluppo e ottimizzazione dell'offerta commerciale
Miglioramento dei processi di monitoraggio delle prestazioni
Supporto ad analisi e business case a sostegno delle decisioni commerciali e di pricing


I requisiti per questa posizione sono:


Laurea in economia e gestione aziendale, ingegneria gestionale o affini
1-2 anni di esperienza in ruoli analitici (consulenza, FP&A, business analyst, analytics commerciale o simili)
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese
Conoscenza avanzata di Excel e Power Point; esperienza nell'uso di Power BI è un plus
Forte orientamento all'execution e attitudine a operare con crescente autonomia nel tempo
Capacità analitiche e visione strategica
Forte orientamento al problem-solving
Ottime capacità di sintesi e comunicazione


Cosa offriamo?


Contratto a tempo indeterminato, full time, III-II livello, CCNL Terziario e Servizi (Confcommercio).
Remunerazione: RAL prevista a partire da 30.000€ lordi/anno. Ticket restaurant e welfare aziendale.
Work-life balance con possibilità di smart working fino a 2 giorni a settimana.
Sede di lavoro: Milano, Viale Sarca 336
Un ambiente dinamico e collaborativo, con un forte focus su innovazione e crescita. 


Processo di selezione:

Il percorso di selezione prevede colloqui con il team HR, il Finance & Business Development Director e altri membri del Management Team. Potrebbero essere previste prove pratiche (Excel/Power BI) per valutare le competenze tecniche e di rigore analitico.

Title: Risk Analytics Junior Consultant | Milan 1
Description:
Risk Analytics Junior Consultant | Milan

The chance to build a better future is right in front of you

Responsibilities

Do Work That Matters - Your role and responsibilities

Do you want to pursue a profession that is truly meaningful and impactful? At KPMG, you will have the opportunity to help clients, the company and colleagues address and solve the most current and complex challenges. KPMG Advisory offers consulting services to companies to assist them in business model transformation, process improvement and digitisation, risk analysis and management, and support in extraordinary finance transac tions. When you join the Risk Analytics team in Milan, you are going to work on financial projects using tech solutions and AI support for top-tier clients in different sectors.

Specifically, you will be tasked with:


Risk Analysis & Application Development :


Build and maintain high-performance applications and microservices that underpin data analytics platforms; develop robust APIs and integration layers to seamlessly connect various internal and external data sources.


Financial Data Engineering & Control:


Design, implement, and optimize financial data ingestion and transformation pipelines to process high-volume datasets from diverse energy systems and sensors; ensure data quality and integrity through testing, validation and monitoring processes.


Financial Analytics, Reporting & Visualization:


Collaborate with data scientists to integrate machine learning algorithms and predictive modeling into live production environments; create interactive dashboards and reporting tools that transform raw data into actionable insights for technical and non-technical stakeholders.


System Optimization & Scalability:


Enhance system performance through code optimization, cost optimization, robust testing, and effective resource management; implement scalable solutions that support growing data demands and evolving business needs in the client domain.


Agile Collaboration:


Participate in agile development practices, including sprint planning, code reviews, and continuous integration, to ensure efficient delivery of features and improvements; work closely with cross-disciplinary teams, including business analysts, data engineers, and product managers, to align technological advancements with strategic objectives.

Skills

Come As You Are - Your skills and characteristics

This is the perfect opportunity if you have:


Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field;
Motivation to build a career in the Risk sector with a focus on financial services industry;
Some knowledge in software engineering with a strong understanding of full-stack development;
Proficiency in modern programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Javascript or similar) and experience working with data processing frameworks;
Some knowledge with API development, cloud platforms, and containerization technologies;
Familiarity with data visualization tools and basic statistical modeling techniques;
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences.


Your Future With Us - What you’ll find at KPMG


Immediate exposure to live data challenges, where you can apply your skills to solve authentic business problems and see the impact of your work in real time.
Join a collaborative, agile team that values creativity, technical excellence, and practical problem solving, facilitating rapid prototyping and successful project deployments (from PoCs to MVPs).
Opportunities to acquire leading certifications (Azure, Google Cloud, AWS, Databricks) and engag e in challenging projects that accelerate your technical and professional learning curve.
Tailored compensation packages and benefits designed to support both your personal and professional success.


Standard employment contract under the collective labour agreement for the commerce sector, with a starting gross annual salary of €29,000. The salary is determined on the basis of objective criteria, including educational qualifications and an assessment of the candidate’s profile against the requirements of the role.

In accordance with applicable legislation, we do not collect or use information relating to remuneration received in current or previous employment. Our selection procedures are based on objective and gender-neutral criteria.

Together for Better – Our values and commitment

Title: Quantitative Analyst (Math, Physics & Engineering degrees)
Description:
Are you looking for a new challenge?

Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance?

Prima could be the place for you.

Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain.

To help fuel that growth, we’re looking for Data Scientists to join our Pricing & Underwriting Department, the strategic engine behind Prima's growth.

As part of this global team, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping our strategy and strengthening our competitive edge. Using data, analytical thinking, machine learning and business acumen, you’ll help predict the future and set the right prices, keeping our offering both attractive and sustainable. You’ll work with your data science tools and skills to bring real-world impact, collaborating with cross-functional teams to turn insights into action and fuel innovation across the company and its different branches.

Excited to make an impact? Here are the details.

What You’ll Do


Leverage data to identify risks, opportunities and key pricing drivers, turning complex information into actionable insights that influence strategic decision making;
Leverage Machine Learning and advanced analytics to develop risk and pricing models that power real-time insurance pricing for millions of customers;
Contribute directly to the company’s growth and long-term success through innovative modelling, experimentation and commercially impactful insights.


What We’re Looking For


Strong academic background in Mathematics, Physics, Engineering (Maths, Physics and Computer Science specialisations), Data Science, Computer Science or Statistics;
Strong quantitative, logical and analytical abilities, a solid foundation in statistics, probability and advanced analytics, and a curious, proactive and innovative mindset focused on solving complex problems;
Fluency in English, both spoken and written.


Nice-to-Have


Strong communication skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions, and drive new ideas;
Possess a solid foundation in code development and machine learning, ideally in Python;
Know how to create, manipulate and analyse large datasets.


€45,000 - €75,000 a year

Please note: this is the same position as the one referred as “Data Scientist” on our career site, posted with different job titles to reach STEM students and graduates who might not know a Data Scientist role suits them.

Why you'll love it here

We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks.

💵 Competitive compensation: Benefit from competitive salaries, starting from €45k up to €75k, with clear opportunities to grow as you do.

🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year.

🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you.

🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support.

Think you’re a match? Apply now.

At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives.

Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

Title: Specialista Risk Management
Description:
Sede di lavoro: Milano

Siamo alla ricerca di una risorsa da inserire all’interno dell’area Risk Management, con focus sulle attività di misurazione, monitoraggio e reporting dei rischi assicurativi, finanziari e operativi nell’ambito del framework Solvency II, sia a livello locale sia di Gruppo.

Di cosa ti occuperai


Monitoraggio dei moduli SCR secondo Standard Formula e Modello Interno, incluse analisi di sensitività, proiezioni ORSA, calibrazione delle Management Actions Health e test di recoverability pro LAC DT.
Supporto all’aggiornamento delle metodologie statistiche per la modellizzazione dei rischi, con particolare riferimento a distribuzioni, tecniche attuariali e sviluppo di proxy per il monitoraggio continuativo della solvibilità.
Analisi delle ipotesi tecniche e valutazione del relativo impatto sul SCR.
Contributo alla redazione del report regolamentare ORSA e supporto ai report RSR e SFCR.
Partecipazione alle attività della Local Validation Unit, inclusa la predisposizione dei Local Suitability Assessment e l’esecuzione di test statistici per verificare l’adeguatezza del Modello Interno alla realtà locale.
Valutazione della solvibilità e sostenibilità patrimoniale dei prodotti vita, risparmio, investimento e previdenziali in ottica Solvency II, Modello Interno, POG/IDD e IFRS 17.
Produzione di report, dashboard e analisi periodiche sulle variazioni di rischio per il Risk Manager e il top management, anche tramite R, Python o Power BI.
Automazione di calcoli e attività ricorrenti, sviluppo di database condivisi e creazione di strumenti operativi in VBA, R o Power Query.


Requisiti richiesti


Laurea magistrale in discipline quantitative, ad esempio Finanza Quantitativa, Scienze Attuariali, Statistica, Matematica, Economia a indirizzo quantitativo o titolo equivalente.
Conoscenza approfondita del framework Solvency II, con riferimento a Standard Formula, Modello Interno, BSCR, SCR, RAF, ring-fenced fund e Management Actions.
Conoscenza della normativa POG e IDD e dei relativi adempimenti in ambito product governance.
Buona padronanza di almeno uno tra R e Python per analisi quantitative, modellistica e automazione.
Buona conoscenza di Excel, inclusi VBA e Power Query, e di strumenti di Business Intelligence, in particolare Power BI.
Ottima conoscenza della lingua italiana e buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, almeno livello B2; il livello C1 sarà considerato un plus.


Costituiscono titolo preferenziale


Esperienza di almeno 3-4 anni in ambito assicurativo o nella consulenza assicurativa.
Formazione post-laurea o certificazioni in ambito attuariale.
Conoscenza dei principi IFRS 17 e delle relative metodologie di calcolo.
Esperienza nell’utilizzo di software attuariali, ad esempio Prophet o Disar.
Conoscenza di RMarkdown o Python per la produzione di report automatizzati.
Conoscenza di una seconda lingua straniera, preferibilmente spagnolo o greco.


Completano il profilo

Spiccate capacità analitiche, attenzione al dettaglio e attitudine alla semplificazione di dataset complessi. Sono inoltre importanti autonomia operativa, capacità di gestire più attività in parallelo, ottime doti comunicative e di sintesi, proattività e orientamento al miglioramento continuo di metodologie e strumenti di lavoro.

Title: Oliver Wyman - Data&Analytics - Associate Team Leader - Milan
Description:
Oliver Wyman - Data & Analytics

Oliver Wyman, a Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) business, is a management consulting firm driven by deep industry insight, bold innovation, and a collaborative approach that cuts through complexity to help organizations navigate their most defining transformative moments.

Clients approach us with their most significant challenges, and we assemble teams of experts to address each facet of these complex issues. Together, we create breakthroughs that lead to remarkable impact.

Within Oliver Wyman, the Data and Analytics (DNA) division was established in 2017 and is operating across the entire world, with a focus on Europe. We are a dynamic and rapidly growing team of quantitative analytics specialists, collaborating closely with colleagues across the firm to cover a global footprint, working across multiple industries including, but not limited to, Financial Services, Climate & Sustainability, Energy, Retail, and Transportation.

We believe in the power of diverse perspectives and collaborative teams to drive innovation. Our team comes from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences, and we embrace the unique skills and insights they bring to our work.

At Oliver Wyman and within DNA, we are proud of the values we uphold that guide us every day in how we work and collaborate. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

____

The Roles And Responsibilities

This position offers excellent career and growth opportunities for talented, highly motivated professionals with relevant prior experience in quantitatively intense areas, particularly though not exclusively within financial services.

Flexible working and market leading work life balance will be a priority. There will be opportunities to travel with a mix of around 50% of time spent on client site vs off site, though individual needs will be considered when staffing offsite vs onsite roles.

Competitive salary and benefits. Clear career path to partner level, with potentially steeper trajectory than in similar firms.

The role will focus on managing projects:


Associate Team Leaders would typically work on one project at a time.
Project work typically involves developing hypotheses; managing data collection, model creation and analyses; conducting primary and secondary research; creatively tackling information limitations; and surfacing insights, overseeing the work of analysts
Using Partners and the internal network effectively to provide technical and senior-level steer to projects
Working in a team together with clients to complete project deliverables to high standard
Maintaining energy and positive work life balance of team
Coaching Oliver Wyman and client team members to develop their skills


Your Attributes And Experience


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative discipline. Ideally Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science, Informatics, Data Science or, Engineering
Strong analysis, documentation, and communication skills
Experience in using advanced analytics and data manipulation software - R, Python, SAS, SQL, or SPSS.
Work effectively and collaboratively in a team.
Be independent and work under limited supervision respecting defined timelines.
Present effectively results, potential issues and implications.
Excellent command of Italian and English language (verbal and written)
Ability to manage a demanding work volume and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
Ability to maintain and respect confidentiality
Willingness to travel regularly
At least 3 years of previous working experience in specialised consulting firms, top tier banking or financial institutions with content in data analytics, credit risk, financial modelling, machine learning techniques


Why Join Us?

Expect a steep learning curve, as no two projects are ever the same. You’ll have the opportunity to travel internationally, gaining invaluable experiences and insights across different cultures and with access to the latest technologies, you’ll constantly expand your toolkit with each new endeavour.

You won’t be alone on this journey; various colleagues will guide and coach you throughout your career. You’ll have a dedicated buddy, a career adviser, and a talent manager to help you navigate your professional path. We also care deeply about sustainable work-life quality, providing you with the flexibility to balance your career aspirations with your personal life.

This role will empower you to embrace your curiosity and step out of your comfort zone. You will have the opportunity to work alongside genuine colleagues who measure success by the lasting impact we create together. If you’re excited by challenges and eager to make a meaningful impact, we look forward to welcoming you aboard!

How to Apply?

Please submit your CV, cover letter and transcripts. If you would like to find out more information about Oliver Wyman, please visit our website or alternatively, apply to attend one of our events, details of which can be found here.

Compensation Information

Job title: Associate Team Leader (m/f/d)

Location: Milan, Italy

Contract type: Permanent contract (contratto a tempo indeterminato)

CCNL applied: CCNL Commercio (National Collective Bargaining Agreement of companies in the Services and Distribution Sectors)

Level / Classification: Quadro

Remuneration

Total compensation for this role includes base salary, annual discretionary performance bonus, and a market-leading benefits package described below.

The expected base salary remuneration range for these positions is between EUR 49.000 gross and EUR 75.000 gross per year (full-time equivalent).

This amount is expressed as a full-time equivalent. The above salary range has been determined on the basis of objective and gender-neutral criteria, in accordance with applicable law. Any final salaries may vary based on factors such as your unique blend of experience and skills, and our current organizational needs.

Variable Compensation And Benefits

Variable pay


Annual discretionary bonus under the terms of the applicable Company Policy (variable remuneration linked to individual and company performance)


Benefits (company-paid And Additional Benefits)


Supplementary insurance package paid by the Company, including health, life, accident insurance and permanent disability coverage
Company car or car allowance available for eligible roles under the Car Policy of Oliver Wyman Italia
Subscription to Wellhub paid by the Company
Corporate discounts: access to a range of partner discounts
Employee Assistance Program (EAP): confidential psychological, legal, and financial support services
Bonus for employee referral to fill an official vacancy
Employee Share Purchase Plan
Seniority milestone paid leave


We will also grant any relevant economic provisions provided by the National Collective Bargaining Agreement to successful candidates.

Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X. 

Marsh is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

Title: Operations Analyst Customer Service
HTML:
Descrizione lavoro:

Con oltre 20.000 collaboratori in tutto il mondo, il Gruppo Jungheinrich è una delle maggiori realtà nel settore dell'intralogistica attraverso la fornitura di carrelli elevatori industriali e lo sviluppo di tutto ciò che riguarda i grandi impianti di stoccaggio e magazzini a grandi altezze interamente automatizzati. 

In Italia l'azienda, con Headquarter situato a Rosate (MI), nasce nel 1958 ed è presente con 3 Regioni che includono 7 filiali e 3 centri regionali e più di 1.200 dipendenti.

 

Per la Direzione Service, ricerchiamo un/una Operations Analyst Customer Service da inserire all’interno del dipartimento Customer Service Operations, a diretto riporto dell’Head of Operations Customer Service. 

Il ruolo prevede il coordinamento di tutte le operazioni di analisi ed efficientamento del processo Service e il supporto nello sviluppo di progetti in area Service e Ricambi. 

 

 

Principali Attività: 

 

  • Individuare inefficienze e opportunità di miglioramento attraverso l'analisi di dati e processi;
  • Misurare le performance, identificare trend e costruire soluzioni concrete basate sui dati;  
  • Collaborare con stakeholder nazionali e internazionali su progetti strategici;  
  • Contribuire allo sviluppo di strumenti, metodologie e processi orientati alla digitalizzazione, automazione e miglioramento continuo; 
  • Generare valore per il cliente attraverso processi più efficaci, efficienti e innovativi. 

 

Requisiti: 

 

  • Laurea in Ingegneria Gestionale o in materie economiche/statistiche;
  • Esperienza anche minima maturata in contesti strutturati e relativamente ad attività di analisi dei processi e gestione di progetti;
  • Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese (almeno livello B2);
  • Dimestichezza nell’utilizzo di tool informatici e buona conoscenza del pacchetto Office, in particolare Excel avanzato;
  • Ottima capacità di analisi e interpretazione di dati complessi;
  • Precisione, capacità di lavorare in team e lavorare per obiettivi.

 

Sede di lavoro: Rosate (MI) 

 

Il pacchetto retributivo prevede una Ral indicativa tra 35.000 e 40.000 euro, buoni pasto, welfare aziendale e assicurazione sanitaria.

È prevista un’assunzione diretta in azienda con inserimento e retribuzione commisurati alle effettive competenze ed esperienze. 

 

In Jungheinrich Italiana puntiamo all'eccellenza e investiamo nei talenti. Lavorare con noi significa agire in un ambiente innovativo e con tecnologie di prodotto altamente avanzate. Significa iniziare un percorso professionale orientato allo sviluppo delle competenze, attraverso il supporto di una formazione continua. Entrando a far parte della nostra squadra ti unirai ad un team di persone appassionate e di successo!

Title: Specialist analisi temi territoriali
Description:
Assolombarda è alla ricerca di un/una professionista da inserire con contratto di sostituzione maternità nell’Area Territorio.




La risorsa sarà dedicata prevalentemente ad attività di analisi e ricerca su temi territoriali:

analisi di impatto economico-territoriale su progettualità infrastrutturali, di trasformazione territoriale e affordable housing;
analisi di inquadramento economico-territoriale su specifici asset immobiliari;
elaborazioni quali-quantitative su politiche di programmazione territoriale d’impatto per le imprese.




Collateralmente a queste attività principali, sarà chiesto al candidato di supportare alcune attività trasversali all’Area e di monitoraggio e advocacy territoriale su logistica e infrastrutture.




Il/La candidato/a ideale, con Laurea magistrale in economia e management/architettura e pianificazione territoriale/ingegneria gestionale, ha già maturato esperienza di attività di analisi e ricerca in campo immobiliare e/o territoriale.




E’ richiesta conoscenza delle principali dinamiche di sviluppo urbano e territoriale, così come

del contesto territoriale di riferimento e delle relative politiche.




Competenze di analisi e gestione dati, scrittura di report e documenti, preparazione di presentazioni, utilizzo di strumenti di visualizzazione grafica dei dati e business intelligence (es. Flourish, Datawrapper, Tableau) completano il profilo.




Si offre contratto di sostituzione maternità; RAL (su 14 mensilità) 35K

Diplômé d'une école d'ingénieurs ou équivalent (Bac +5), vous justifiez d’a minima 2 ans d’expérience réussis en tant que data analyst :

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
WHAT IS CREAM ALL ABOUT?

We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency…

But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.

The Cream recipe

• 1/3 Personal development • 1/3 Collective intelligence • 1/3 Intrapreneurship • Bonus ingredient: some passionate colleagues




YOUR FUTURE PROJECTS :

As Benjamin Data Analyst at Cream, you work close to business teams and help them turn data into concrete insights that support decision-making.




Your tasks will be :

• Understand business needs and translate them into analytical questions

• Collect, clean and analyse large datasets

• Identify trends, patterns and performance drivers

• Build dashboards, reports and analytical outputs

• Support business users in data interpretation

• Contribute to the selection and use of analytics tools

• Work closely with business, IT and data teams




WHAT DO WE EXPECT FROM OUR CONSULTANT ?

• At least 2 years of experience in data analysis AND Master’s degree (or equivalent in experience)

• Experience with SQL and BI tools (Power BI, Qlik, Tableau, …)

• Knowledge of Python or SAS

• Fluent in French and English, a good level of Dutch is an asset

• Ability to explain data insights in a clear and business-oriented way

• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset




WHY SHOULD YOU TASTE THE LIME FLAVOR ?

A strong learning environment: tribes, training budget
Career follow-up with dedicated Business Managers and an associate plan
Attractive benefits package (mobility plan, meal vouchers, insurances,...)
Hybrid working model: client working, home working & Cream working
Strong CSR commitments, with recognized labels in environmental responsibility and diversity & inclusion.
A consulting company of around 200 Creamers, located in the center of Brussels




Our recruitment process is clear and structured, with three steps and feedback throughout.

Cream Consulting is committed to equal opportunities. If you need any specific accommodation to fully participate in the recruitment process or the interview, please let us know.

Think this role is a match? Apply and let’s talk, or explore our other opportunities at Cream.

WHAT IS CREAM ALL ABOUT?

We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency…

But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.

The Cream recipe

• 1/3 Personal development • 1/3 Collective intelligence • 1/3 Intrapreneurship • Bonus ingredient: some passionate colleagues


YOUR FUTURE PROJECTS :

As Benjamin Data Analyst at Cream, you work close to business teams and help them turn data into concrete insights that support decision-making.


Your tasks will be :

• Understand business needs and translate them into analytical questions

• Collect, clean and analyse large datasets

• Identify trends, patterns and performance drivers

• Build dashboards, reports and analytical outputs

• Support business users in data interpretation

• Contribute to the selection and use of analytics tools

• Work closely with business, IT and data teams


WHAT DO WE EXPECT FROM OUR CONSULTANT ?

• At least 2 years of experience in data analysis AND Master’s degree (or equivalent in experience)

• Experience with SQL and BI tools (Power BI, Qlik, Tableau, …)

• Knowledge of Python or SAS

• Fluent in French and English, a good level of Dutch is an asset

• Ability to explain data insights in a clear and business-oriented way

• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset


WHY SHOULD YOU TASTE THE LIME FLAVOR ?

  • A strong learning environment: tribes, training budget
  • Career follow-up with dedicated Business Managers and an associate plan
  • Attractive benefits package (mobility plan, meal vouchers, insurances,...)
  • Hybrid working model: client working, home working & Cream working
  • Strong CSR commitments, with recognized labels in environmental responsibility and diversity & inclusion.
  • A consulting company of around 200 Creamers, located in the center of Brussels


Our recruitment process is clear and structured, with three steps and feedback throughout.

Cream Consulting is committed to equal opportunities. If you need any specific accommodation to fully participate in the recruitment process or the interview, please let us know.

Think this role is a match? Apply and let’s talk, or explore our other opportunities at Cream.

Title: Corporate Data Analist
Description:
Onze klant, een toonaangevende en mensgerichte organisatie gespecialiseerd in dienstverlening voor ondernemers, zoekt een Corporate Data Analist om complexe data te vertalen naar strategische groei. In deze rol combineer je technische expertise met business-inzicht om de digitale maturiteit en operationele efficiëntie van de organisatie direct te beïnvloeden.

Responsibilities

Je werkt nauw samen met corporate diensten, data engineers en data architects om de vertaalslag te maken van ruwe data naar waardevolle sturingsinformatie. Je rapporteert over de voortgang van de analytics roadmap en adviseert stakeholders op basis van jouw bevindingen.


In kaart brengen van businessbehoeften en deze vertalen naar relevante analyses, dashboards en datagedreven inzichten ter ondersteuning van strategische beslissingen.
Ontwikkelen, testen en optimaliseren van dataproducten die trends, opportuniteiten en risico’s visualiseren voor het management.
Beheren van de prioriteiten binnen de analytics roadmap, rekening houdend met budgetten, GDPR, security en technische haalbaarheid.
Bewaken van de datakwaliteit en consistentie door het toepassen van standaarden en kwaliteitscontroles.
Omzetten van data-inzichten naar concrete beleidsaanbevelingen voor de verdere uitbouw van de organisatie.
Opvolgen van innovaties binnen data en analytics om processen en besluitvorming continu te professionaliseren.


Requirements


Je beschikt over een masterdiploma in een analytische richting of bent gelijkwaardig door relevante werkervaring.
Je hebt sterke ervaring met het modelleren van datasets en het bouwen van rapportages in Power BI.
Je beschikt over een diepgaande kennis van DAX om complexe logica te vertalen naar gebruiksvriendelijke dashboards.
Je hebt ervaring in het samenwerken met diverse stakeholders en kunt vlot schakelen tussen business-noden en technische IT-oplossingen.
Je bent in staat om complexe materie begrijpelijk over te brengen aan verschillende doelgroepen.
Je bent kritisch, nieuwsgierig en proactief ingesteld om verbeterpotentieel binnen de organisatie te detecteren.
Je beschikt over uitstekende organisatorische vaardigheden om diverse projecten en deadlines efficiënt te beheren.
Je bent communicatief vaardig en vloeiend in het Nederlands.
Affiniteit met data-architectuur en databeveiliging is een pluspunt.


Offer


Contract: vast contract van onbepaalde duur.
Extra-legale voordelen: bedrijfswagen met laadpas en laadinstallatie, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques, cadeaucheques, hospitalisatieverzekering, pensioenfonds, loonbonus en een flexibel verloningssysteem (o.a. fietsleasing).
Arbeidsregime: voltijds (38u) met een glijdend uurrooster.
Werkmodel: hybride (telewerk mogelijk na de inwerkperiode).
Vakantie: 32 vakantiedagen bij een voltijdse tewerkstelling.
Opleiding: uitgebreid aanbod aan e-learnings en georganiseerde opleidingen voor persoonlijke groei.
Atmosfeer: een professionele werkomgeving met een sterke focus op welzijn en een informele compagnon-cultuur.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Location: Brussels, Belgium

Company: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) Belgium

Employment Type: Full-time




Nature of the Tasks

Collect and clean data from various sources.
Analyse datasets to identify trends and patterns.
Create interactive dashboards and reports that utilize data storytelling to effectively present findings, with defined refresh cadences and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for key deliverables.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data needs.
Develop and maintain data dashboards and reporting tools that provide intuitive access to key metrics and insights, supported by clear documentation and update schedules.
Perform statistical analysis to support decision making.
Ensure data accuracy and consistency through the implementation of data quality checks, validation rules, and regular reconciliation processes with source systems.
Conduct exploratory data analysis to uncover insights.
Document methodologies and analysis processes.
Recommend improvements based on data insights.
Partner with Data Engineers on data modelling (e.g., star/snowflake schemas) and contribute to a centralized definitions and metrics catalogue.
Present data-driven insights and create actionable, decision-oriented recommendations tailored for non-technical audiences and stakeholders.
Write complex Structured Query Language (SQL) queries for data extraction and transformation, and optimize them for performance and efficiency.




Specific Expertise and Technologies

Knowledge of data analysis and manipulation using SQL, Python, or R to extract, transform, and analyse structured and unstructured datasets.
Experience with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Qlik, Microsoft Fabric) to design interactive dashboards and reports.
Knowledge of statistical analysis methods and tools (e.g., SPSS, R, Python libraries) to support evidence-based insights.
Familiarity with spreadsheet tools, especially Microsoft Excel.
Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and platforms (e.g., star/snowflake schemas, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, BigQuery) to support scalable reporting.
Knowledge of data preparation and transformation tools (e.g., Alteryx, Power Query, dbt) to ensure clean and reliable datasets.
Ability to work with large datasets and databases.
Awareness of basic machine learning algorithms (e.g., regression, clustering, classification) to support advanced analytics in collaboration with data scientists.
Knowledge of ETL processes and orchestration tools (e.g., SSIS, Informatica, Talend, Azure Data Factory) to support data pipelines.
Knowledge of cloud-based data services (e.g., Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse) to enable scalable and modern analytics.
Knowledge of data quality practices (e.g., validation rules, reconciliation, lineage tracking) to ensure accuracy and consistency of insights.
Knowledge of metadata and cataloguing tools (e.g., Azure Purview, Collibra) to support data governance and discoverability.




Minimum Level of Expertise

Junior for analysts supporting a senior team.
Normal for standalone Data Analysts accountable for business domains.

Certification and/or Standards

Optional for 'Junior' level:

A certification directly related to the requested profile.

Optional for 'Normal' level and above:

Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Associate
Microsoft Azure Data Engineer Associate
Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate
Fabric Data Engineer Associate
Or an equivalent certification




Skills

Ability to analyse datasets, detect trends, and deliver evidence-based insights.
Skill in presenting findings with visuals and storytelling that support decisions.
Commitment to maintaining accuracy, consistency, and integrity in reporting.
Ability to resolve data issues and propose actionable improvements.
Competence in managing tasks and delivering insights on time.
Drive to explore new methods, tools, and data sources proactively.
Ability to interpret analytical findings to tell a compelling story that clearly prescribes business actions and drives strategic decision-making.
Flexibility to adopt new data platforms, tools, and approaches.
Ability to frame insights into narratives that support decisions.
Ability to participate in multilingual meetings.
Ability to understand, speak, and write English, optionally French as an additional asset.
Excellent interpersonal skills.
Ability to work in a team as well as autonomously.
Results-oriented mindset, focused on delivering.
Ability to present insights concisely for senior decision-makers.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description


Role: Data Analyst
Level: Medior
Scope: Support our GTM teams with analytics, reporting, and operational insights, as well as assist with some of our internal AI-related initiatives
Language requirement: Fluent in English
Location: Ghent, Belgium, with hybrid/on-site working model


Who are we and why should you care?

Teamleader is a SaaS scale-up born in 2012 in Ghent, Belgium, and part of the Visma Group since 2022. Our mission? To make work easier, not harder , for small and medium-sized businesses.

Here’s What We Bring To The Table


Teamleader Focus : the all-in-one tool that helps small businesses optimise CRM, projects, and invoicing.
Teamleader One : the go-to e-invoicing software that self-employed pros can count on.


We’ve Also Been Growing Smarter Through Strategic Acquisitions


Teamleader Orbit (2019): helping medium-sized agencies thrive and scale.
Vectera (2022): powering seamless customer meetings.
Dexxter (2024): making financial admin a breeze for freelancers.


Curious to learn more about us, our products, and why you’ll love working at Teamleader? Check us out here .

We Are Looking for an Data Analyst to Join us

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our central Data & Revops Team . In this role, you will turn data into actionable insights across the full customer funnel, from Marketing and Sales through onboarding, usage, and retention.

You will work closely with GTM teams, product stakeholders, and fellow data colleagues to deliver high impact analysis, dashboards, and data stories that influence decision making. In addition, you will contribute to the rollout of applied AI use cases by preparing high quality datasets, supporting automation, and helping translate insights into scalable solutions.

This is a hands-on, impact-driven role focused on applied analytics and AI rather than research-oriented data science.

As a Data Analyst At Teamleader, You Will


Analyze performance across the full Go-to-Market funnel, including acquisition, conversion, activation, retention, and expansion
Build and maintain dashboards and reporting layers using Looker to enable self-serve insights across teams
Create clear data stories and communicate insights, trade-offs, and recommendations to business stakeholders
Collaborate with GTM and Product teams to define metrics, ensure reliable tracking, and evaluate experiments or initiatives
Work with structured datasets in Snowflake , including relational modeling using SQL
Support recurring analytics needs as well as ad hoc deep dives across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Product
Contribute to applied AI initiatives by preparing datasets, identifying automation opportunities, and supporting insight generation workflows
Help improve data quality, documentation, and analytical best practices across the organization
Take ownership of analytics projects from scoping through delivery, in close collaboration with technical and business stakeholders


Why others chose Teamleader: we're lively, not corporate

We have the energy and boldness of a start-up and the expertise and pragmatism of a scale-up. The result: a team of both young and seasoned professionals led by supportive and approachable managers who give recognition and rewards for hard work. You’ll be working in a fast-paced tech environment with open feedback culture and room for initiatives as well as ideas. You’ll have plenty of room to apply your personality, express yourself, and impact our course of action with your insights or ideas.

On Top Of That, You’ll Get


An extensive training budget.
A hybrid working model: a pleasant mix of office and home working.
A personal tooling budget, to make working from home as comfortable as from our offices.
Daily budget-friendly in-house prepared lunch and dinner options (only in our Ghent office), as well as Friyays and numerous sport initiatives!
32 holidays on top of the standard public ones! (based on full-time employment).
Our long-lasting dedication to employee well-being, just take a look at our career page and Instagram to see how we keep the Team(leader) spirit going.


We value diversity

Our ambition is to build and sell a product that helps everyone everywhere (starting with Europe) to work smarter, so we want our team to reflect that. We believe that a diverse, inclusive working environment is crucial to realise that ambition, so we’re committed to continue to build and cherish a culture where every colleague feels welcome, appreciated and heard.

Job Requirements

You’d be a great fit for this role if you:


3–5 years of experience in a Data Scientist, Data Analyst, or Analytics role
Strong SQL skills and solid understanding of relational data modeling
Proven experience building dashboards and visualizations using tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI
Ability to translate complex analyses into clear business insight s and actionable recommendations
Experience working with funnel metrics and business KPIs
Comfortable collaborating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Strong ownership mindset and ability to work autonomously on projects


Bonus If You Have


Experience with Snowflake or other modern cloud data warehouses (e.g. BigQuery, Redshift)
Familiarity with GTM systems such as HubSpot or similar CRMs
Exposure to experimentation, A/B testing, or product analytics
Hands-on experience with AI-driven workflow automation tools and processes
Experience bringing analytics or automation workflows into production
Interest in AI, automation, and scalable analytics solutions
Experience in SaaS or B2B environments


Interested? Questions? Get in touch!

Title: Data Analyst / BI Expert Sparen & Betalen
Description:
Ben jij gepassioneerd door data, heb je een analytische geest en ga je graag op zoek naar verbanden? Dan ben jij de persoon die we zoeken om onze resultaten te optimaliseren en onze strategieën verder te ontwikkelen!

Welkom in het team

Als data analist zorg je mee voor een visie, strategie en praktische oplossingen voor datagebruik en data-evolutie binnen de directie Sparen & Betalen. Zo zorg je ervoor dat alle activiteiten en beslissingen gerelateerd aan deze afdeling kunnen gebeuren op basis van kwalitatieve, toegankelijke data.

Jouw rol in het team:


Je verzamelt en definieert datanoden om zo input te geven voor de datastrategie en -visie. Deze strategie zal ons toelaten om projecten te lanceren en bij te sturen zodat Argenta meer toekomstgericht kan evolueren.
Je onderzoekt en ontwikkelt oplossingen die het hele management voorzien van nuttige data om meer datagedreven beslissingen te kunnen nemen.
Je bouwt gesimplificeerde en vooraf berekende datamarts om de business snel toegang te geven tot kwaliteitsvolle data en analyses en zo de rapportering te versnellen.
Als data analist draag je bij aan boeiende data science initiatieven.
Je activeert een (proactieve) data driven cultuur om de strategie van operaties binnen Argenta naar een hoger niveau te tillen.


Argenta en jij: een match?

Als je bij Argenta komt werken, word je Argentaan. Maar Argentaan zijn is meer dan een job hebben bij Argenta.

Bij alles wat je doet, verlies je nooit onze focuswaarden uit het oog: we werken samen, in alle eenvoud, voor onze klanten.

Dat doe je met kennis van zaken, en altijd met twee voeten op de grond. Als Argentaan geef je elke dag opnieuw het beste van jezelf. Je komt terecht in een veilige omgeving waarin je fouten mag maken. En waarin we elkaar durven uitdagen en feedback geven. We zijn ambitieus en leggen de lat hoog. Door elkaar te helpen raken we samen over die lat. Zo maken we een positief verschil voor onze medewerkers, onze klanten en de samenleving.

Wees gerust: bij Argenta kun je gewoon jezelf zijn. Jouw talenten en ambities staan centraal. Groeien en samen winnen, daar gaan we voor.

Jouw loonpakket


Een aantrekkelijk brutoloon
Maaltijdcheques
Groepsverzekering
Hospitalisatieverzekering
Netto onkostenvergoeding van 165 euro per maand
Een cafetariaplan waarmee je het bedrag van je 13de maand flexibel kunt inzetten om aan voordelige voorwaarden bijvoorbeeld een smartphone te leasen of extra verlofdagen aan te kopen
Keuze tussen een bedrijfswagen (inclusief tankkaart of laadoplossing) of een aantrekkelijk mobiliteitsbudget dat je kunt spenderen aan duurzame mobiliteitsalternatieven, zoals de aankoop van een fiets, het gebruik van een deelauto of de terugbetaling van je huisvestingskosten


Extra

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Wil jij met data échte impact maken op het onderwijs van morgen?

Als Data Analist help je onze organisatie betere beslissingen nemen door data om te zetten in heldere inzichten. Je werkt met een moderne data stack (SQL, Power BI, Snowflake, ...) en krijgt veel autonomie om end-to-end oplossingen uit te bouwen die ook écht gebruikt worden.

Je komt terecht in een mensgerichte organisatie waar data steeds belangrijker wordt en waar jouw werk zichtbaar bijdraagt aan maatschappelijke impact.




Jouw team

Je wordt onderdeel van het Data & Analytics team, waar je samenwerkt met één andere data-analist in België. Daarnaast heb je regelmatig contact met een groter team van data-analisten en experts in Nederland.

Via kennisdeling en best practices versterk je je expertise en draag je mee bij aan de verdere uitbouw van een datagedreven organisatie. Af en toe werk je ook samen op locatie in Den Bosch.




Wat ga je doen?

Als Data Analist werk je van businessvraag tot bruikbaar inzicht. Je fungeert als brug tussen data en besluitvorming en helpt collega's data beter te begrijpen en te gebruiken.




Concreet betekent dit dat je:

• Businessvragen scherp stelt en vertaalt naar analyses en datavereisten.

• Data verzamelt, transformeert en modelleert uit verschillende bronnen.

• End-to-end oplossingen bouwt met SQL en Snowflake; ervaring met Power BI en dbt is een mooie plus.

• Heldere, actiegerichte dashboards en rapporten ontwikkelt die effectief gebruikt worden.

• Datakwaliteit, governance en betrouwbaarheid mee bewaakt.

• Inzichten en aanbevelingen duidelijk communiceert naar zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders.

• Business teams ondersteunt in projecten en besluitvorming.

• Meebouwt aan de verdere professionalisering van processen, data-infrastructuur en het dataplatform.

• Data literacy binnen de organisatie versterkt via begeleiding, workshops of kennisdeling.




Wie zoeken wij?

Je hoeft niet alles al perfect te beheersen; leergierigheid en analytisch denkvermogen zijn minstens zo belangrijk.




• Je hebt een bachelor diploma of gelijkwaardige ervaring.

• Je hebt 2 tot 4 jaar ervaring in data-analyse, BI of insights.

• Je werkt vlot met SQL en BI-tools.

• Ervaring met dbt, Power BI en Snowflake is een sterke troef, of je wil je hierin snel verdiepen.

• Kennis van Python is een plus.

• Je kan complexe informatie helder uitleggen aan verschillende doelgroepen.

• Je werkt gestructureerd, denkt analytisch en neemt ownership.

• Je bent een teamspeler die kennis deelt en graag bijleert.

• Je volgt trends in data, AI en analytics en denkt mee over toepassingen.

• Je kan professioneel communiceren in het Frans of bent bereid dit verder te versterken.




Wat mag je van ons verwachten?

• Een mensgerichte cultuur met veel aandacht voor welzijn en werkgeluk.

• Een betekenisvolle job met maatschappelijke impact.

• Werken binnen een sterke internationale groep (Sanoma).

• Ruimte om te groeien, leren en initiatief te nemen.

• Samenwerking met ervaren data-professionals in België en Nederland.

• Een competitief loon aangevuld met extralegale voordelen.

• Hybride werken met meerdere dagen per week thuiswerk.

• Moderne kantoren in Wommelgem en Mont-Saint-Guibert, volledig uitgerust voor hybride samenwerking.

Title: Commercieel Data Analist
Description:
Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Ben jij iemand die moeiteloos verbanden legt tussen cijfers, marktinformatie en commerciële opportuniteiten? Krijg je energie van analyses die een directe impact hebben op klanten, groei en strategie? Dan is dit jouw kans om data om te zetten in waardevolle inzichten.

Voor een internationaal actieve organisatie binnen de consumer goods-sector zijn we op zoek naar een Commercieel Data Analyst. In deze functie werk je op het kruispunt van sales, marktanalyse en business intelligence en ondersteun je commerciële teams met inzichten die écht het verschil maken.

Als Commercieel & Data Analyst help je commerciële teams om beter onderbouwde beslissingen te nemen. Je brengt data samen uit verschillende bronnen, analyseert trends en vertaalt complexe informatie naar heldere aanbevelingen. Dankzij jouw analyses krijgen accountmanagers, category specialisten en business stakeholders een beter inzicht in markt dynamieken, consumentengedrag en commerciële opportuniteiten.


Je verzamelt en combineert gegevens uit verschillende databronnen zoals verkoopresultaten, marktinformatie, klantdata en promotiecampagnes.
Je analyseert prestaties, evoluties en trends binnen productcategorieën en klantsegmenten.
Je vertaalt cijfers naar concrete aanbevelingen die commerciële groei ondersteunen.
Je levert inzichten aan voor klantgesprekken, strategische business reviews en commerciële presentaties.
Je helpt accountmanagers bij het identificeren van groeikansen en optimalisaties.
Je ondersteunt bij assortimentsanalyses en aanbevelingen voor klanten.


Profiel kandidaat


Je werkt graag met cijfers, rapporteringen en datasets.
Je bent analytisch sterk en denkt kritisch.
Je bent nieuwsgierig en gaat actief op zoek naar verbanden en inzichten.
Je werkt gestructureerd en behoudt overzicht over verschillende projecten tegelijk.
Je hebt interesse in consumentengedrag, retail en commerciële strategie.
Je bent zeer sterk in Excel.
Ervaring met Power BI of andere reportingtools is zeer grote troef.
Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en Engels.


Geboden wordt


Een functie waarin jouw analyses rechtstreeks bijdragen aan commerciële groei en strategische beslissingen.
Veel ruimte om initiatief te nemen en verbeteringen voor te stellen.
Nauw samenwerken met ervaren professionals binnen sales, category management en business operations.
Een internationale werkomgeving waar data een belangrijke rol speelt in de besluitvorming.
De kans om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen business intelligence, commerciële analyse en category management.
Een organisatie waar ondernemerschap, samenwerking en innovatie centraal staan.
Een aantrekkelijk salarispakket aangevuld met extralegale voordelen.
Een omgeving waar jouw inzichten zichtbaar impact hebben op klanten, resultaten en toekomstige groei.

Title: Data Analyst / Data Visualisation
Description:
Data Analyst / Data Visualisation Consultant

Who We Are

NORRIQ is a leading international consulting firm headquartered in Denmark and Belgium, with 350+ consultants driving business transformation through technology. Our Financial Services practice includes 100+ specialists supporting banks, insurers, and financial institutions in navigating regulatory challenges, embracing emerging technologies, and meeting evolving client demands. We prioritize growth, innovation, and excellence, offering abundant opportunities for professional development and collaboration.

The Opportunity

NORRIQ is seeking to grow its Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence team with additional Data Analyst / Data Visualisation Consultants to improve the business performance of financial institutions. You will help our clients to optimize the value they can get from their internal and external data, through improved business performance monitoring and enhanced reporting quality and readability. Join us to work on impactful projects that shape the future of finance.

Responsibilities


Collecting and interpreting internal and external data about customer behaviour via the digital platforms (Web and mobile) and their digital transactions with the bank.
Translate data insight into actionable recommendations in order to coordinate the business needs around data and improve the bank’s digital and marketing strategy and optimize future campaigns.
Collect, analyze, and interpret large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and correlations
Develop and maintain complex data models, databases, data warehouses and data marts .
Create data visualizations and reports to communicate insights to stakeholders.
Perform data quality checks and ensure data integrity, develop and implement data governance policies and procedures
Stay up-to-date with industry trends and emerging technologies in data analysis and visualization


Your Profile


Master’s degree (or equivalent work experience) in mathematics or statistics, business intelligence, computer engineering, economy.
1-3 years of experience in data projects, preferably within the financial services industry.
Technical Expertise & Tooling: SQL (mandatory), SAS (nice to have), Python & R (to support our AI team), Reporting & Visualisation tools (Power BI, Tableau, Adobe Analytics, ...),.
ETL Processes: Affinity with ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes, including an understanding of data preparation, cleansing, and integration from multiple sources.
Analytical Skills: Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities to translate complex data into actionable insights.
Business Analysis Skills: Experience in requirements gathering, process design and developing action plans.
AI knowledge: AI knowledge & interest to connect easily with our data scientist and machine learning engineers.
Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communication skills; ability to work well in cross-functional teams and engage effectively with stakeholders.
Languages: Fluent in English and native in French or Dutch.


What We Offer


Dynamic Work Environment: High-impact projects with leading financial institutions in a fast-growing consulting firm.
Career Development: Continuous learning and growth opportunities to advance your career.
Collaborative Culture: A supportive, innovative team environment that encourages new ideas and professional development.
Global Exposure: International experience working on cross-border projects that shape the financial services industry.


Why Join Us?

At NORRIQ, we are shaping the future of finance through transformation and innovation. If you're passionate about improving financial processes, driving change, and delivering value to clients, this is the perfect opportunity for you.

Title: Data Analist Sales
Description:
Data analist Sales I JAVA Foodservice




Rotselaar I 39 uur (afwijken in overleg) I JAVA Foodservice Sales Team




“Data vertalen naar actie, teams versterken en de commerciële koers mee bewaken.”




✅ Werken op het snijvlak van data, sales en operatie

✅ Directe impact op omzet, marge en teamperformance

✅ Veel samenwerking met Sales Manager en accountteams

✅ Ruimte om te coördineren, verbeteren en meedenken met sales collega’s

✅ Bijdragen aan de commerciële strategie van JAVA Foodservice




Wat ga je doen?

In deze rol draait alles om sterkere salesprocessen en duidelijke richting. Data‑analyses worden omgezet naar heldere inzichten en acties die resultaten verbeteren. Nauwe samenwerking met de Sales Manager hoort erbij, net als afstemming met accountteams. Dankzij jouw rapportages en presentaties werken collega’s efficiënter en ontstaat rust in planning en uitvoering. Het verkoopproces loopt daardoor merkbaar soepeler.




Wat zijn jouw verantwoordelijkheden?

Verkoopsdoelen en KPI’s krijgen scherpe opvolging. Analyses monden uit in concrete verbetervoorstellen die omzet en marge versterken. Rapportages en decks voor salesoverleggen lever je consistent en begrijpelijk aan. Als aanspreekpunt voor verkoopdata houd je definities zuiver en beschikbaarheid op orde. De commerciële strategie van JAVA Foodservice bewaak je zorgvuldig. Duurzaam omgaan met middelen en respectvolle communicatie maken integraal deel uit van jouw manier van werken.




Wat bieden wij jou?

Een uitdagende functie binnen een dynamische en groeiende organisatie

Korte communicatielijnen en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief

Mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen

Een aantrekkelijk salaris in verhouding tot jouw ervaring




Wat neem je mee?

Ervaring in een commerciële omgeving vormt een stevige basis. Analytisch denkvermogen zorgt voor scherpe inzichten en heldere dashboards. Bekendheid met aanbestedingen helpt bij het herkennen van patronen en kansen. Nauwkeurigheid in rapportages combineer je met planmatige voortgangsbewaking. Duidelijke communicatie en een coachende houding maken samenwerking met accountteams extra sterk.




Word jij het nieuwe gezicht van JAVA Foodservice?

JAVA Foodservice is onderdeel van Sligro Food Group en dé foodservicepartner voor zorg, onderwijs en grootkeukens. Bij JAVA Foodservice zetten we ons elke dag in om overheidsinstellingen, organisaties in de zorg en het onderwijs te voorzien van kwaliteitsvolle voeding en een uitstekende service. Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Cronos Europa

Cronos Europa is a leading IT and digital transformation partner dedicated exclusively to European Institutions and agencies, delivering mission‑critical solutions that shape Europe's digital future. As part of the Cronos Group, one of the most innovative and fastest‑growing tech ecosystems in Europe, we benefit from a vast pool of expertise and cutting‑edge capabilities. With over 1,000 specialists across Belgium, Luxembourg, and the Netherlands, we combine deep institutional knowledge with strong engineering excellence to support long‑term, high‑impact EU programmes requiring reliability, scalability, and innovation.

About The Job

We are seeking a Digital Intelligence & Data Analyst to support the analysis of complex digital environments and online information ecosystems. The role focuses on identifying trends, risks, opportunities, and influence dynamics across digital platforms, social media, and other online sources. You will transform large volumes of data into actionable insights that support strategic decision-making within one of the European Institutions.

Key Responsibilities


Collect, structure, and analyse data from digital sources, social media platforms, and online communities.
Produce quantitative and qualitative analyses to support strategic and operational decision-making.
Develop dashboards, reports, and data visualizations to communicate findings effectively.
Monitor and assess online trends, communities, influencers, and influence campaigns.
Conduct information risk and disinformation analyses to identify potential threats and vulnerabilities.
Collaborate with communication, marketing, public affairs, and leadership teams to translate data into actionable recommendations.
Utilize monitoring, business intelligence, and large-scale data analysis tools to support research and reporting activities.


Profile Requirements


Proven experience in Data Analysis, Digital Intelligence, Business Intelligence, or a related field.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret and synthesize complex datasets.
Solid understanding of digital media, social networks, and online behavioral trends.
Experience in reporting, data visualization, and the generation of strategic insights.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present findings to diverse stakeholders.
Ability to work in strategic, sensitive, or institutional environments while handling complex information with discretion.


Desired Assets

While not required, the following qualifications would be considered an advantage:


Experience monitoring online influence operations, information risks, or disinformation activities.
Knowledge of OSINT, social media analytics, or digital monitoring methodologies.
Proficiency with data visualization and business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
Familiarity with data mining, statistical analysis, or large-scale data processing techniques.
Experience working with multidisciplinary teams in communications, marketing, public affairs, or strategic advisory environments.
Curiosity, critical thinking, and a proactive approach to identifying emerging digital trends and risks.


If you wish to integrate a dynamic structure on a human scale while working with the latest technologies, don't wait anymore and join Cronos Europa!

Title: Data Analyst — Service Performance Dashboards for NATO with security clearance
Description:
An enterprise service performance dashboard has come out of prototype and now has real users, real feedback and a growing list of service providers who need to feed data into it. A small analytics team is being formed to take it further: more features, a better interface, and pipelines that can absorb far more service data than they do today.

You would be one of five analysts in that team, working alongside a service level manager, on site with the customer's own technical staff.

What You Would Be Doing


Analysing how services are performing and turning that into metrics people will actually act on.
Designing and building new dashboard features, from the first look at user feedback through to the released version.
Improving the experience of using the dashboard — the visualisations, the accessibility and the plain usability of it.
Designing the data collection interface: formats, measurements and controls, written up as a specification and taken through a formal review with the people who will use it.
Building, testing and deploying that interface so several service providers can supply their own performance data to one standard.
Building and automating the pipelines behind it with Python and modern ETL tooling, so the dashboard scales as more services are added.
Operating and maintaining what you build — incidents, access requests, user questions and training — against agreed availability and resolution targets.
Keeping the as-built documentation, use cases and data model accurate as the thing changes.


What you would bring


A relevant degree from a recognised university and at least four years of related experience, as a data analyst, data scientist or UX designer.
Demonstrable Python, and SQL against relational databases such as SQL Server.
Real depth in data visualisation, principally Power BI.
Experience building and integrating APIs so that monitoring can be driven by data rather than by hand.
Experience managing data flows with ETL and ELT tooling — Apache NiFi specifically is required.
Sound knowledge of KPIs and formal reporting through dashboards, including how to design user-experience metrics and monitor them.
Practical UX and UI design skills, and experience of IT service management.
The ability to write technical documentation, requirements and user guides, and to translate between what users ask for and what gets built.
Excellent spoken and written communication, with good briefing skills.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
À propos de YouMeal : améliorer la qualité nutritionnelle et environnementale de dizaines de millions de repas 🥗🌱

Chez YouMeal, nous sommes convaincus que les données ont le pouvoir de transformer notre façon de manger. Notre mission ? Accompagner les grandes entreprises du foodservice vers une transition plus saine, plus durable et plus transparente.




Grâce à notre technologie d'analyse de données alimentaires, nous calculons l'impact nutritionnel et environnemental de milliers de recettes (allergènes, valeurs nutritionnelles, Nutri-Score, empreinte carbone, Green-Score, etc.) et aidons à optimiser les menus aussi bien sur le plan de la santé, que de l’impact environnemental.




Rejoindre YouMeal, c’est mettre votre expertise analytique au service d'un projet engagé et porteur de sens, au sein d'une équipe passionnée de "foodies" où règnent transparence, bienveillance et esprit d'innovation.







L’offre de Data Analyst




Tu es amoureux des logiciels et tu adores les chiffres et les statistiques ?




Tu es méticuleux et rigoureux pour vérifier et garantir les résultats qui sortent du logiciel, tenir à jour les bases-de-données source, et assurer une transmission correcte des nombreuses informations ?

Tu es méticuleux et rigoureux pour concevoir des unit tests complets, optimiser nos process et vérifier la fiabilité des résultats issus d'un environnement technique complexe ?

Tu es logique et analytique et peut ainsi penser à tous les cas de figure pour écrire des tests complets ? 

Tu aimes offrir une documentation claire et complète à tes collègues ? Tu peux écrire des documents techniques nous engageant auprès de nos clients ? 




Tu aimes analyser la donnée, concevoir des rapports d'analyse pertinents et automatiser le traitement des informations ?







Alors on va s’entendre ☺ :D 







Objectifs du poste : 

Garantir que l’ensemble des résultats calculés par le logiciel soient justes, stables, à jour, et documentés. 
Maintenir, optimiser et alimenter les bases de données sources pour garantir la fiabilité des données et des process.
Effectuer des analyses approfondies, créer des rapports détaillés et écrire des unit tests robustes dans un contexte technique complexe.




Ton quotidien : 

100% centré sur la Data (analyse, qualité de la donnée, unit tests, optimisation et rapports d'analyse).

Accès à une documentation détaillée sur le métier : https://www.apec.fr/tous-nos-metiers/informatique/data-analyst.html 




Ton profil : 

Min 3 ans d’expérience en tant que Data Analyst.
Et des expériences professionnelles précédentes renforçant ta candidature.
Langues : langue maternelle ou niveau professionnel pour le français et l’anglais.
Tu es comme nous : logique, structur, et sympa :)  




Typiquement, tu adores les datas, tu es passionné par la valeur de la donnée et la rigueur technique. Tu aimes travailler sur des modèles complexes, automatiser des flux de données et fournir une documentation ainsi que des analyses irréprochables.




L’offre YouMeal : 

Le logiciel YouMeal permet de calculer de nombreuses informations alimentaires sur des milliers de recettes culinaires : allergènes, valeurs nutritionnelles, nutri-score, empreinte carbone, green-score, si le plat est végétarien, vegan, s’il contient du porc, s’il est de saison, mais aussi calcul du food cost et des marges, etc. Le logiciel permet également aux professionnels de l’alimentation d’améliorer leur ingrédients, recettes, et menus sur ces différentes thématiques.




Nous te proposons un poste challengeant et varié. Mais ce n’est pas tout, l’offre YouMeal c’est aussi :

Une petite équipe dynamique dans une entreprise en pleine croissance 
Ton travail apporte une contribution directe et palpable à l’entreprise :-) 
Un métier qui a du sens : contribuer massivement à une alimentation plus saine et plus durable !
Des valeurs partagées au quotidien : transparence, kindness, détermination, persévérance, optimisme et collaboration. Et bien sûr une équipe de foodies
L’entreprise étant amenée à croître rapidement, des opportunités d’évolution sont possibles !




Note sur l’évolution possible à terme : Après avoir fait tes preuves sur le poste (environ 1 jour tous les 15 jours), une évolution vers des responsabilités de Product Owner pourra s'ajouter. Ces missions incluront la réalisation de mock-up, la rédaction de spécifications détaillées, la rédaction des tickets, la compréhension des besoins clients et la coordination de l'équipe technique.

Title: BI Engineer - Antwerpen Noord
Description:
Over het bedrijf



Onze klant is een internationale organisatie met een sterke focus op innovatie, digitalisering en maatschappelijke impact. Binnen een warme en mensgerichte werkomgeving krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan een datagedreven organisatie waarin samenwerking, initiatief en persoonlijke groei centraal staan.



Jouw rol



Krijg jij energie van het verbinden van data en business? Stel je graag de juiste vragen en weet je complexe informatie te vertalen naar heldere inzichten en concrete aanbevelingen?

Als Data & Insights Analyst ben je een belangrijke sparringpartner voor verschillende teams binnen de organisatie. Je bouwt sterke relaties op met stakeholders, verdiept je in hun uitdagingen en vertaalt hun behoeften naar relevante analyses, dashboards en dataproducten.

Je hoeft hiervoor niet de meest technische dataspecialist te zijn. We zoeken vooral iemand die analytisch sterk is, begrijpt wat er met data mogelijk is en collega's kan meenemen in datagedreven besluitvorming.

Je maakt deel uit van een internationaal Data & Analytics-team en werkt nauw samen met collega's in België en Nederland.



Takenpakket


Je brengt de doelstellingen, uitdagingen en informatiebehoeften van stakeholders helder in kaart.
Je stelt kritische vragen en gaat op zoek naar de werkelijke behoefte achter een businessvraag.
Je vertaalt businessvraagstukken naar concrete use cases, analyses, dashboards en dataproducten.
Je adviseert stakeholders en management op basis van data en inzichten.
Je presenteert complexe informatie op een duidelijke en toegankelijke manier.
Je beheert verwachtingen en bewaakt samen met de business de prioriteiten binnen de development roadmap.
Je ontwikkelt rapporteringen en dashboards in Power BI die aansluiten bij de behoeften van gebruikers.
Je ondersteunt teams bij het gebruiken en interpreteren van data.
Je stimuleert data literacy en helpt collega's zelfstandiger met data te werken.
Je denkt mee over self-service analytics, procesverbetering en nieuwe toepassingen van data en AI.


Profiel


Je beschikt over een bachelor- of masterniveau, of bent gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
Je hebt bij voorkeur twee tot vier jaar ervaring binnen data-analyse, business intelligence, insights of een vergelijkbare omgeving.
Je combineert analytisch inzicht met sterke communicatieve vaardigheden.
Je voelt je comfortabel in gesprekken met verschillende stakeholders en durft door te vragen.
Je kunt complexe analyses vertalen naar begrijpelijke conclusies en concrete aanbevelingen.
Je denkt vanuit de business en kijkt verder dan alleen de technische oplossing.
Je hebt ervaring met Power BI of een vergelijkbare BI-tool.
Je beschikt over een goede basiskennis van SQL en begrijpt de principes van datamodellering.
Je werkt proactief, neemt ownership en krijgt energie van samenwerking.
Kennis van Snowflake, dbt, GitHub, Python of moderne cloudomgevingen is mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste.

Aanbod
Je krijgt de kans om mee te bouwen aan een organisatie met maatschappelijke impact, binnen een moderne en internationale werkomgeving waar autonomie en vertrouwen centraal staan.
Daarnaast mag je rekenen op:

* Vast contract
* Een aantrekkelijk salarispakket met bedrijfswagen
* Maaltijdcheques, verzekeringen en cafetariaplan
* 12 ADV-dagen
* Hybride werken met 3 dagen thuiswerk
* Flexibele werkuren
* Veel ruimte voor groei, initiatief en kennisdeling

Een ideale opportuniteit voor een data professional die impact wil maken in een warme, mensgerichte organisatie met een duidelijke toekomstvisie.

Klaar om met jouw analytische skills impact te maken binnen een innovatieve en mensgerichte organisatie? Solliciteer vandaag nog en ontdek hoe jij mee het verschil kan maken in een omgeving waar data, samenwerking en groei centraal staan.
