Title: Data Analyst 🍋
Description:
Data Analist

Over de Rol

Bij Lemon 🍋 geloven we dat de beste data oplossingen voortvloeien uit diverse perspectieven. Ben jij de Data Analist die de vertaalslag kan maken tussen complexe datastromen en concrete business impact?

Als Data Analist ben jij de drijvende kracht achter het optimaliseren van onze datastromen en de structurele verbetering van de datakwaliteit. Je neemt de regie in handen: van het analyseren van de huidige status tot het coördineren en uitrollen van verbeterinitiatieven. Je communiceert vlot met stakeholders op verschillende niveaus, rapporteert over de voortgang en stuurt bij waar nodig om onze ambities waar te maken. Binnen het projectteam ben je zelf verantwoordelijk voor jouw doelstellingen, ondersteund door een dynamische en collegiale omgeving.

Jouw bijdrage

Wij zoeken iemand die een proactieve en coördinerende rol wil spelen:


Uitwerken van een structureel plan om de datakwaliteit te verhogen, de uitvoering hiervan te coördineren en de voortgang te rapporteren.
Identificeren, documenteren en analyseren van data-opportuniteiten en het initiëren van inhoudelijke data cleaning en captatie op het terrein.
Bouwen van bruggen en het aligneren van stakeholders (betrokken diensten en leidinggevenden) om een gemeenschappelijk begrip en engagement te garanderen.
Definiëren van verantwoordelijkheden en taken, deze bespreken met de juiste partijen, afstemmen en nauwgezet opvolgen.
Proactief bijsturen bij problemen of escaleren naar de projectleider om de kwaliteitsdoelen te bewaken.
Actief kennis delen tijdens lunch & learns en collegiale feedback geven via peer reviews of document reviews.
Bijdragen aan de continue verbetering van de data-analyse methodologieën en -tools binnen Lemon.


Welke kwaliteiten breng je mee?

Gericht op competenties en potentieel, moedigen we je aan om te solliciteren als je denkt dat je voldoende vaardigheden bezit. Je bent pragmatisch en hands-on, met een gezonde dosis leergierigheid en ondernemingszin. Je werkt gestructureerd en nauwkeurig, maar blijft flexibel in een veranderende omgeving. Je hebt doorzettingsvermogen, durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en bent een echte teamspeler die samenwerking stimuleert.

Essentiële Vaardigheden


Scherpe analytische inzichten: Het vermogen om datakwaliteit niet alleen te beoordelen, maar ook helder te beschrijven, te rapporteren en te presenteren.
Sterke coördinatie & Netwerken: Moeiteloos een intern netwerk opbouwen, afspraken onderhandelen, doelen definiëren en zorgen dat iedereen zich eraan verbindt.
Change Management & Soft Skills: De nodige soft skills bezitten om draagvlak te creëren, mensen te motiveren, verandering te realiseren en weerstand om te buigen naar samenwerking.
Uitmuntende communicatie: Je communiceert helder, overtuigend en weet vertrouwen op te bouwen in zowel het Nederlands als het Engels.
Gedrevenheid: De intrinsieke motivatie om voortdurend te leren en je professionele en analytische vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen.


Aanbevolen opleiding & ervaring 🎓

Een academische achtergrond (Bachelor/Master) in Bedrijfskunde, Informatica, Economie, of een gerelateerd studiegebied.

Doorgaans minstens 4 jaar ervaring als data analist in een gelijkaardige omgeving (grote ondernemingen), bij voorkeur op Medior/Senior niveau.

Aantoonbare ervaring als planner en organisator van projecten.

Aantoonbare ervaring met change management (o.a. stakeholdermanagement) en data-migratieprojecten (eerdere ervaring hiermee is een absolute plus).

Aantoonbare ervaring met data cleaning en het structureel verhogen van datakwaliteit.

Praktische ervaring met data visualisatie/reporting tools zoals Power BI, Tableau, Qlik

Wat we je bieden

Bij Lemon 🍋 streven we naar een werkplek waar iedereen zich welkom, veilig en gewaardeerd voelt:


Waarden: We moedigen een cultuur van respect en open dialoog aan.
Flexibiliteit: Flexibele werkuren en de mogelijkheid tot thuiswerk om een gezonde balans te ondersteunen.
Ontwikkeling: De Lemon Academy 🏫 staat centraal voor kennisdeling, mentorschap en voortdurende persoonlijke groei.
Inclusiviteit: We ondersteunen redelijke aanpassingen in de werkomgeving of -processen zodat jij optimaal kan functioneren.
Compensatie: Een all-in salarispakket dat meegroeit met jouw impact. Dit omvat een flexibel verloningsplan, maaltijdcheques, een bedrijfswagen met tankkaart, een performante laptop en een comfortabel gsm-abonnement.
Zorg & Welzijn: Een uitgebreide hospitalisatieverzekering en een ambulante verzekering die een breed scala aan medische kosten dekt.
Events: Vrijblijvende sociale momenten en teamactiviteiten die openstaan voor ieders voorkeur ; zoals onze jaarlijkse skireis, de zomer-bbq, onze Lemon-running-group, een wederkerend padeltoernooi, en nog zoveel meer. Geheel divers, maar allemaal onvergetelijk!

Title: Data Quality Analyst
Description:
As a Senior Data Analyst, you will play a key role in the transition from legacy systems to a new ERP platform within the logistics operations of the organisation. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, the IT department, and external implementation partners to ensure high data quality, develop automated data validation tools, and support stakeholders in expanding their knowledge and capabilities throughout the transformation.

Main Responsibilities:


Promote cross-functional alignment by working with data stewards, business owners, and IT leaders to establish consistent data quality rules, standards, and metrics
Conduct root cause analyses to understand drivers of data quality issues across the application landscape
Document findings, quantify the business impact of data quality problems, and work with stakeholders to translate insights into actionable improvement plans
Analyse relevant datasets to address specific business questions or challenges
Perform data profiling on critical datasets to identify anomalies, inconsistencies, and redundancies
Develop tools to automate data quality checks for the systems within the scope of the transformation
Create dashboards and reports that provide ongoing visibility into data quality and overall data health
Support business teams in improving data creation and maintenance processes at the source, fostering a proactive data quality mindset



Capabilities:


Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate analyses into clear, actionable insights for diverse audiences
Strong analytical skills and ability to interpret complex datasets
Continuous improvement mindset: curious, persistent, and proactive in identifying opportunities to enhance data processes



Qualifications:


Solid understanding of data governance principles
Proven experience (3+ years) as a Data Analyst
Experience with SAP ERP modules related to supply chain or logistics (MM/PP/SD/ECC/...)
Strong SQL skills for data querying
Experience with data visualisation tools for dashboards and reporting
Experience with data science tools such as Python is a plus

Je vertaalt businessvraagstukken naar concrete use cases en realiseert samen met collega's de bijbehorende data-oplossingen en dataproducten.

Je bouwt en onderhoudt betrouwbare datasets en datamodellen voor analyses en rapportages.

Je bewaakt en verbetert de kwaliteit, structuur en betrouwbaarheid van data.

Bachelor- of masterniveau, of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.

Goede kennis van SQL en ervaring met datatransformatie en datamodellering.
Ervaring met Power BI of een vergelijkbare BI-tool.
Je begrijpt hoe data vanuit verschillende bronnen wordt verwerkt tot betrouwbare datasets en dataproducten.
Je werkt nauwkeurig en gestructureerd en hebt oog voor datakwaliteit.
Je vindt het leuk om technische vraagstukken uit te zoeken en oplossingen te bouwen.
Je kunt complexe data en analyses vertalen naar duidelijke inzichten, onderbouwde conclusies en concrete adviezen voor stakeholders. Je bent zelfstandig, proactief en nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe technologieën en AI toepassingen binnen Analytics.
Je werkt graag samen en spart gemakkelijk met andere data professionals.




Mooi meegenomen

Ervaring met Snowflake en dbt.
Ervaring met GitHub en versiebeheer.
Kennis van Python.
Ervaring met moderne cloud dataomgevingen.
Interesse in AI, automatisering en nieuwe toepassingen binnen analytics.




Wat bieden wij?

Veel vrijheid, eigenaarschap en verantwoordelijkheid.
Een moderne analyticsomgeving met Snowflake, dbt, GitHub en Power BI.

Ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling.

Title: Data Reporting Analyst
Description:
Inleiding

In de afdeling Koudwalserij Beitserij Tandems wordt de warmgewalste staalplaat gebeitst en naar de finale dikte gewalst. Hiervoor telt KBT drie beitserijen die de plaat van de oxidelaag ontdoen met zoutzuur. Het gebruikte zoutzuur wordt geregenereerd in twee ovens. Eén beitserij levert gebeitste plaat als eindproduct naar de klanten. De andere twee beitserijen zijn rechtstreeks gekoppeld met een tandem koudwalserij, elk bestaande uit vijf walstuigen. In de walsenwerkplaats worden de benodigde walsen hiervoor geslepen en getextureerd. De kwaliteit van de producten en de bedrijfszekerheid van de installaties zijn essentiële factoren in dit stadium van het proces.

Hiertoe beschikken we enerzijds over een continu gloeilijn en anderzijds over klassieke gloeiovens in combinatie met twee skinpass installaties. Title: Senior Data Analyst GIS Specialist - European Agency
Description:
🔹Role🔹

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst / GIS Specialist with a strong technical background in environmental data analysis, biodiversity, spatial modelling, and advanced statistics, capable of transforming complex environmental datasets into high-quality analytical and geographic insights.

🔹Who We Are🔹

Altia is a high-value digital transformation services company that has undertaken, changed, and reformulated international projects for nearly a thousand clients, leaders in their sectors, who have understood that their businesses can be revolutionized through digitalization. Over its 30 years of experience, it has proven to be a robust company with a future, a capacity for innovation, and adaptability.

🔹The project🔹

You will contribute to data analysis, environmental analytics, and geospatial activities within an international project supporting European institutions and agencies, working with complex datasets to support evidence-based analysis and decision-making.

Environmental Data Analysis: Analyse, manipulate, and interpret large and complex datasets, with a focus on environmental and biodiversity information.

Spatial Analysis & GIS: Perform advanced geoprocessing, spatial analysis, and cartographic activities to support the analysis and modelling of terrestrial ecosystems and environmental data.

Statistical Modelling: Apply advanced statistical methods to identify patterns, relationships, and insights within large environmental datasets.

Data Science & Environmental Accounting: Contribute to data science activities and, where applicable, natural capital accounting and environmental-economic assessment frameworks.

Data Quality & Modelling: Support data quality processes, database design, dimensional modelling, and the development of structured metrics and data catalogues.

Reporting & Communication: Prepare analytical reports, formal technical documentation, presentations, and geographic visualisations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

🔹Stack🔹

Data Analysis & Programming: SQL, Python, R, data manipulation, large datasets, environmental and biodiversity data.

Statistics: SPSS, R, Python statistical libraries, advanced statistical analysis and spatial statistics.

GIS & Spatial Data: ArcGIS, QGIS, GRASS GIS, GDAL, geoprocessing, spatial modelling, cartography and ecosystem analysis.

Environmental Data Science: Google Earth Engine (GEE), environmental analytics, biodiversity datasets, natural capital accounting, SEEA-EA, INCA.

Data Architecture & Quality: Data quality, database schemas, star and snowflake schemas, metrics catalogues and complex database environments.

Visualisation & Reporting: Geographic visualisation, analytical reporting, technical documentation and formal presentations.

Title: Data Analyst (UX) — Enterprise Service Monitoring for NATO with security clearance
Description:
An enterprise service performance dashboard has come out of prototype and now has real users, real feedback and a growing list of service providers who need to feed data into it. A small analytics team is being formed to take it further: more features, a better interface, and pipelines that can absorb far more service data than they do today.

You would be one of five analysts in that team, working alongside a service level manager, on site with the customer's own technical staff.

What You Would Be Doing


Analysing how services are performing and turning that into metrics people will actually act on.
Designing and building new dashboard features, from the first look at user feedback through to the released version.
Improving the experience of using the dashboard — the visualisations, the accessibility and the plain usability of it.
Designing the data collection interface: formats, measurements and controls, written up as a specification and taken through a formal review with the people who will use it.
Building, testing and deploying that interface so several service providers can supply their own performance data to one standard.
Building and automating the pipelines behind it with Python and modern ETL tooling, so the dashboard scales as more services are added.
Operating and maintaining what you build — incidents, access requests, user questions and training — against agreed availability and resolution targets.
Keeping the as-built documentation, use cases and data model accurate as the thing changes.


What you would bring


A relevant degree from a recognised university and at least four years of related experience, as a data analyst, data scientist or UX designer.
Demonstrable Python, and SQL against relational databases such as SQL Server.
Real depth in data visualisation, principally Power BI.
Experience building and integrating APIs so that monitoring can be driven by data rather than by hand.
Experience managing data flows with ETL and ELT tooling — Apache NiFi specifically is required.
Sound knowledge of KPIs and formal reporting through dashboards, including how to design user-experience metrics and monitor them.
Practical UX and UI design skills, and experience of IT service management.
The ability to write technical documentation, requirements and user guides, and to translate between what users ask for and what gets built.
Excellent spoken and written communication, with good briefing skills.

Ruime ervaring met DAX en SQL voor het opzetten van end-to-end rapportages.
Collega’s omschrijven jou als een analytische gesprekspartner die prioriteiten stelt en projecten strak opvolgt.
Uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands en de vaardigheid om vlot af te stemmen met Franstalige stakeholders.

Netto onkostenvergoeding voor extra maandelijks budget.

We leverage a network of high value-adding affiliates in consulting and industrial excellence, and leading partners across multiple sectors to provide you with the most comprehensive services and solutions in an ever-changing environment.

Analyze requests from the ticketing system
Understand business needs and evaluate requests
Document requirements in the form of structured specifications

Title: Business Analyst
Description:
At Alken-Maes, part of the HEINEKEN family, we are passionate about building iconic brands such as Cristal, Maes, Grimbergen, Affligem, Desperados and Mort Subite. Behind every successful brand is a team of people turning data into meaningful business decisions.

As a Business Analyst you will play a key role in supporting our Out-of-Home (ontrade) business by transforming large amounts of commercial data into actionable insights. You will partner closely with Sales, Revenue Management, Marketing, and Data & Technology teams to help shape commercial decisions, improve performance and drive growth. This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys diving deep into data, building stakeholder relationships, and making a visible impact on business results.




Your Responsibilities

Transform large volumes of commercial and market data into actionable business insights that support decision-making across the Out-of-Home business.
Analyze monthly sales volumes, channel performance and key commercial KPIs to identify trends, opportunities and risks.
Consolidate and interpret data from multiple sources, including Salesforce, Excel and Power BI, translating complex information into clear recommendations for stakeholders.
Own and continuously improve recurring reporting, dashboards and performance reviews, ensuring accurate and timely insights for the business.
Calculate, develop, monitor and challenge KPIs across different sales channels and customer segments.
Support monthly and quarterly business reviews, including performance analyses and sales incentive reporting.
Act as the key link between commercial teams and Data & Technology, ensuring business needs are translated into meaningful reporting and insights.
Partner closely with Sales Managers, National Sales Managers, Account Managers, Channel Marketing, Revenue Management, Finance and other stakeholders across the organization.
Guide and support commercial teams in understanding reports, KPIs and business performance, helping them turn insights into action.
Proactively identify opportunities to automate, simplify and improve reporting processes and ways of working.
Contribute to strategic projects, commercial initiatives and ad hoc analyses that drive business growth and performance.
Take ownership of your analyses and recommendations, confidently challenging stakeholders when needed and ensuring follow-up actions are delivered.




YOUR PROFILE

You have a Bachelor or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics or a related field.
You have a minimum of 3 years relevant working experience.
You are a real data cruncher and excel in Excel, any other analysis tools such as PBI experience are a plus, data modelling experience albeit in excel or other tools are also considered a plus.
You have strong stakeholder management skills and the confidence to challenge and influence others.
You are a bright analytical thinker and problem solver with eye for detail.
You have the ability to translate data insights clearly into understandable business language.
You are flexible in changing environments.
You are assertive and dare to speak up.
You are proactive, curious and able to work autonomously. You take ownership of your work, know how to prioritize competing requests and confidently engage with a broad range of stakeholders.
You have a good knowledge of English. Dutch or French is a plus.
Experience with Power BI and/or Revenue Growth Management is considered a strong asset.




What's in it for you?

Trust, challenge and support from experienced managers and professionals who know how to develop people, teams and take organizations to the next level.
We are the market challenger. This means we are a dynamic, local organization; with the benefits of belonging to the larger, international HEINEKEN family.
Awesome colleagues who enjoy a refreshing Cristal or Desperados 0% after work.
The opportunity to make your mark and take the initiative. (Which, according to our colleagues, is one of the greatest advantages of working at Alken-Maes).
A coaching environment, giving you an extraordinary learning opportunity.
And of course, a competitive package and other nice conditions.
10€ Meal vouchers
Hospitalisation plan
Group insurance
Company car
Bonus
Net allowances
33 leave days

Title: Reporting & Analytics Specialist
Description:
Wat ga je doen

Als Reporting & Analytics Specialist bent u verantwoordelijk voor het leveren van de nodige rapportages aan de operatie om de operationele prestaties te maximaliseren, evenals de benodigde analyses om de uitvoering te verbeteren. U gebruikt deze inzichten om de operationele processen in vraag te stellen en verbeteringen door te voeren binnen de organisatie.

Je beschikt over uitgebreide technische vaardigheden om data te verzamelen, verbeteren en toe te passen op een manier die ten goede komt aan de gehele organisatie.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de goede uitvoering van de logistiek door het juiste gegevensmateriaal/rapportages op het juiste moment te leveren.

Je meet, evalueert, verdedigt en daagt de KPI's uit van alle logistieke belanghebbenden, zoekt naar procesverbeteringen om de prestaties van distributiecentra en transport te optimaliseren en zorgt voor een effectieve en efficiënte operationele samenwerking.

Je ondersteunt de operatie door de go-to partner te zijn voor alle rapportagebehoeften.

Als expert op het gebied van rapportage en de benodigde tools (Excel, PowerBI, Databricks), analyseert en ontwikkelt het team de rapportages die nodig zijn om de operationele uitvoering te verbeteren.

Je fungeert als kenniscentrum voor de analyse van logistieke/transporte data. U analyseert de huidige configuratie van data en rapportages om mogelijke verbeteringen te identificeren op het gebied van nauwkeurigheid, toegankelijkheid en beschikbaarheid.

Je neemt deel aan data- en rapportageprojecten, volgens het projectplan en de voorgestelde resultaten, om ervoor te zorgen dat het project binnen het budget, de tijdslimieten en de overeengekomen doelstellingen wordt opgeleverd.

Je richt zich meer op de ontwikkeling van nieuwe technieken, standaardisatie en fungeert als architect van een oplossing.

Wie ben jij

Jij bent in het bezit van een bachelordiploma of beschikt over een gelijkwaardige ervaring. Jij hebt 2 tot 4 jaar ervaring in data of Business Intelligence.

Jij hebt een uitstekende operationele kennis van alle logistieke en supply chain-processen.

Jij hebt een analytisch denkvermogen en weet data om te zetten in bruikbare informatie.

Jij bent drietalig (NL/FR/EN) en beschikt over uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden.

Jij bent een expert in MS Office: Jij hebt een diepgaande kennis van Business Intelligence-tools en -platforms zoals Power BI en Azure Databricks. Jij beheerst data-analyse talen en technologieën zoals SQL, Python en/of R.

Jij bent veelzijdig, klantgericht en stressbestendig.

Waar werk je

Asse/Zellik - afdeling OPERATIONS PLANNING

Wat we bieden

Een job én een rijkelijk gevuld privéleven? Bij Delhaize kan dat. Je krijgt een aantrekkelijk loon aangepast aan jouw ervaring. Bovendien geniet je van diverse extralegale voordelen: bedrijfswagen met tank- of laadkaart binnen het federaal mobiliteitsbudget, gsm plus abonnement, netto vergoeding, jaarlijkse bonus, maaltijdcheques, uitgebreide groepsverzekering en facultatieve hospitalisatieverzekering en uiteraard een personeelskorting in de winkel! Je krijgt ook toegang tot onze fitness en een gevarieerd aanbod aan groepslessen. Thuiswerk spreekt voor zich en wordt voor elke job anders ingevuld. En groeien? Dat gaat hard bij Delhaize. Door de opleidingen, op de werkvloer én via onze opleidingscatalogus, krijg je daar de ruimte voor. Doorgroeien? Ook dat kan. Vraag maar aan één van je toekomstige collega’s. Spreekt bovenstaande functie jou aan? Solliciteer dan onmiddellijk en ontdek wat jouw mogelijkheden zijn bij Delhaize!

Over Delhaize

Beter leven begint bij beter eten. Dat geloven wij bij Delhaize met heel ons hart. Daarom zetten wij ons in voor het eten op het bord van 5 miljoen klanten, elke week opnieuw. In meer dan 810 winkels kunnen Belgische en Luxemburgse klanten terecht voor een uitgebreid assortiment van meer dan 20.000 kwaliteitsproducten. Van een snelle stop in een Shop&Go, over dagelijkse boodschappen in een lokale Proxy tot een ruim aanbod binnen onze AD Delhaize's; en vergeet zeker onze e-commerce diensten niet.

Die hele keten van voeding, die start binnen onze Logistiek. De 2200 collega's in onze distributiecentra van Zellik en Ninove verwerken dagelijks alle producten van onze leveranciers, vaak van Belgische bodem, en brengen deze via meer dan 3000 leveringen per dag tot bij onze winkels.

Maar het stopt niet in onze winkels of logistiek. Want ook onze meer dan 1000 collega's binnen Finance, HR, IT, Commerce of Legal staan staan om elkaar en onze klanten te helpen goed te eten.

Van een snelle stop in een Shop&Go, over dagelijkse boodschappen in een lokale Proxy tot een ruim aanbod binnen onze AD Delhaize's; en vergeet zeker onze e-commerce diensten niet.

Die hele keten van voeding, die start binnen onze Logistiek. De 2200 collega's in onze distributiecentra van Zellik en Ninove verwerken dagelijks alle producten van onze leveranciers, vaak van Belgische bodem, en brengen deze via meer dan 3000 leveringen per dag tot bij onze winkels.

Maar het stopt niet in onze winkels of logistiek. Want ook onze meer dan 1000 collega's binnen Finance, HR, IT, Commerce of Legal staan staan om elkaar en onze klanten te helpen goed te eten.

Title: Marketing & Data Analyst
Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Marketing & Data Analyst based in Belgium.

This is a hands-on analytics role responsible for connecting marketing performance, product behavior, and customer retention data.

You will own reporting and tracking across acquisition channels and help ensure business decisions are based on accurate, reliable information.

The role spans the full customer journey, including acquisition, funnels, conversion, subscriptions, retention, and lifetime value.

You will combine analytical expertise with technical tracking skills across tools such as GTM, GA4, Mixpanel, BigQuery, and marketing platforms.

You will investigate discrepancies, troubleshoot tracking issues, and continuously improve data quality across reporting systems.

Your analysis will help marketing, product, and business teams identify opportunities, evaluate experiments, and improve performance.

The position is ideal for an independent, detail-oriented analyst who enjoys working at the intersection of data, technology, and growth.

Accountabilities


Own marketing and product analytics, tracking, and reporting across acquisition channels.
Analyze performance throughout the customer journey, from acquisition and funnel conversion through subscription performance, retention, and lifetime value.
Track and analyze key metrics including CAC, ROAS, conversion rate, LTV, cohorts, rebills, cancellations, refunds, and churn.
Identify performance trends, changes, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement.
Translate complex datasets into clear reports and actionable insights for marketing, product, and business teams.
Analyze user behavior and acquisition funnels to identify conversion opportunities.
Evaluate A/B tests across landing pages, pricing structures, and customer journeys.
Assess experiment results and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders.
Monitor attribution across Meta, Google, internal data sources, and other acquisition platforms.
Investigate discrepancies between marketing platforms and internal reporting systems.
Improve attribution consistency and help ensure business teams rely on appropriate data for decision-making.
Set up, maintain, and troubleshoot tracking through Google Tag Manager.
Configure and manage Meta and Google pixels, Conversion APIs, and related marketing integrations.
Support both client-side and server-side event tracking.
Implement and troubleshoot event deduplication processes.
Maintain integrations between analytics and marketing platforms.
Proactively monitor data quality and consistency across reporting systems.
Investigate and resolve tracking and data discrepancies before they affect business decisions.
Work with large marketing and customer datasets to identify meaningful patterns and business opportunities.
Continuously improve analytics, reporting, and tracking processes as the business and acquisition channels evolve.


Requirements


3+ years of professional experience in marketing analytics, product analytics, data analytics, or a related field.
Strong hands-on experience with Mixpanel, GA4, or comparable analytics platforms.
Experience analyzing funnels, events, user behavior, conversion rates, and customer journeys.
Strong practical experience with Google Tag Manager, including event setup and debugging.
Experience with web and server-side tracking implementations.
Hands-on experience with Meta and Google pixels and Conversion APIs.
Experience integrating analytics and marketing platforms.
Strong understanding of attribution across paid media platforms and internal data sources.
Solid knowledge of CAC, ROAS, conversion rate, LTV, retention, churn, cohorts, rebills, cancellations, refunds, and subscription performance.
Hands-on experience working with BigQuery, GCP, and large marketing or customer datasets.
Strong SQL skills for querying and analyzing data.
Strong proficiency with Google Sheets and/or Microsoft Excel.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Ability to independently identify, investigate, and resolve data and tracking issues.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable business recommendations.
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with marketing, product, and business stakeholders.
Comfortable working independently in a hands-on, fast-moving environment.
Experience in telehealth, healthcare, or another subscription-based health business is a plus.
Understanding of healthcare marketing and data compliance is advantageous.
Experience with Tableau or Looker Studio is a plus.
Familiarity with TikTok, Snapchat, or other paid media tracking platforms is beneficial.
Experience with affiliate tracking or Everflow is an advantage.


Benefits


Full-time position.
Remote work arrangement.
Working hours from 14:00 to 22:00 EEST (Kyiv time).
Opportunity to own analytics across marketing, product, acquisition, and retention.
Hands-on role with significant responsibility for tracking, reporting, and data quality.
Opportunity to work with modern analytics, attribution, tracking, and marketing technologies.
Direct impact on marketing and business decision-making through actionable data insights.
Opportunity to work in a fast-growing telehealth environment.
Application review within five working days, with shortlisted candidates contacted to arrange an introductory call.

The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Rigueur et autonomie

Français courant

Le Néerlandais est un plus

Missions stratégiques auprès de grands acteurs bancaires et financiers
Environnement technique stimulant (Python, Power BI, data ESG)
Perspectives d'évolution rapide vers des postes de Senior Consultant / Lead Data Analyst
Culture d'entreprise axée sur l'expertise et l'innovation data

Title: Data Analyst & Planning Coordinator H/F/X
Description:
Notre client

Notre client est une société d'ingénierie et d'exploitation spécialisée dans la gestion technique des bâtiments, le traitement de l'eau et les solutions énergétiques : HVAC, énergies renouvelables, optimisation énergétique et installations techniques.

Dans le cadre du développement de ses activités, notre client recherche un(e) Data Analyst & Planning Coordinator disposant d'une solide compréhension des techniques du bâtiment.

Votre mission

Votre rôle consiste à centraliser, structurer et analyser les données techniques provenant de différents bâtiments et installations afin de les transformer en informations exploitables.

À l'intersection de la data, du facility management et des techniques spéciales, vous développez une vision claire de l'état des installations et contribuez à la planification des actions techniques à court, moyen et long terme.

Vos responsabilités


Centraliser les rapports techniques provenant des installations, équipes terrain et organismes de contrôle.
Structurer et consolider les données issues de différentes sources et outils.
Développer des dashboards simples et efficaces permettant de suivre les informations essentielles.
Analyser les données techniques liées notamment au HVAC, à l'électricité, au BMS et aux installations sanitaires.
Transformer les données disponibles en plans d'action et en recommandations concrètes.
Identifier les priorités d'intervention et contribuer à l'élaboration des plannings techniques.
Analyser les constats réalisés sur site et évaluer leur impact sur les installations.
Identifier les synergies et problématiques communes entre plusieurs bâtiments ou projets.
Développer des outils de visualisation facilitant le suivi et la prise de décision.
Suivre les échéances des contrôles, rapports, certifications et autres documents techniques.
Alerter les parties concernées et coordonner les actions nécessaires avant expiration.
Collaborer avec les équipes techniques, responsables de sites, ingénieurs et autres intervenants.
Participer à l'amélioration et à la digitalisation des processus de gestion technique.



Votre profil


Formation de niveau Bachelor ou Ingénieur dans un domaine technique pertinent.
Environ 10 ans d'expérience dans un environnement technique, idéalement lié aux bâtiments, à l'industrie ou au facility management.
Bonne compréhension de plusieurs disciplines : HVAC, électricité, BMS, sanitaire et techniques spéciales.
Forte affinité avec la data analyse, la visualisation de données et les outils digitaux.
Un intérêt ou une expérience avec des solutions basées sur l'IA constitue un atout.
Capacité à interpréter des informations techniques et à les transformer en indicateurs et actions concrètes.
Capacité à coordonner différents intervenants et, lorsque nécessaire, à superviser des collaborateurs.
Profil analytique, structuré et orienté solutions.
Autonomie et capacité à gérer plusieurs dossiers simultanément.
Vous maîtrisez le français ou le néerlandais, ainsi que l'anglais.



Notre offre


Une fonction multidisciplinaire combinant data, ingénierie et gestion technique des bâtiments.
Des projets variés sur différents sites et installations.
Une organisation à taille humaine favorisant l'autonomie et la prise d'initiative.
Un environnement technique en croissance offrant de réelles possibilités d'évolution.
Un package salarial attractif complété par des avantages extralégaux : chèques-repas, indemnité forfaitaire nette, assurances groupe et hospitalisation, GSM, ordinateur portable et 6 jours RTT supplémentaires.

Title: Operational Safety & Quality Insight Lead,
Description:
Excited to work for a key Belgian player in the energy landscape?

The Belgian and European energy landscape is in full swing. Did you know that Elia Belgium plays a crucial role in this? As part of Elia Group, a European transmission system operator, Elia Belgium ensures the reliability and sustainability of the electricity supply in our country.

Side-by-side with your talented colleagues, you will play a part in building a sustainable, green and reliable energy infrastructure that stimulates economic growth and reduces our ecological footprint.

Only together can we make the biggest impact possible! We believe in the power of diversity we are convinced that an inclusive and diverse work environment leads to more innovation, creativity and better results.

Operational Safety & Quality Insight Lead

Requisition ID 11510

Posting Start Date 23/09/2026

Your role


As Operational Safety & Quality Insight Lead, you play a key role in strengthening the organization’s Safety and Quality performance by turning data into actionable insights.
You design, develop, and continuously improve data-driven monitoring systems and dashboards to support both operational execution and strategic decision-making.
You act as the link between data, business, and leadership, ensuring that critical Safety & Quality priorities are translated into clear, reliable, and high-impact performance indicators.


Your Responsibilities


As Operational Safety & Quality Insight Lead, you develop and structure the Safety & Quality insight framework by defining a data strategy aligned with SQI priorities, establishing robust reporting governance, and identifying the key KPIs linked to safety performance and quality outcomes. You also define clear performance monitoring roadmaps for both the short and long term.
You design and manage dashboards tailored to both operational teams and management, ensuring clear, reliable, and actionable insights aligned with business priorities, while continuously improving the visualization and usability of reporting tools.
You analyze data to identify trends, risks, and performance gaps, investigate the root causes of safety or quality issues, and translate complex data into clear insights and fact-based recommendations to support decision-making and performance reviews.
You foster data-driven decision-making by working closely with SQI teams, operational stakeholders, and support functions, capturing business needs and translating them into relevant analytical solutions while promoting a strong data-driven culture.
You ensure data quality and integrity by monitoring data across systems, implementing validation mechanisms, defining standards, and driving the continuous improvement of data reliability.
Finally, you support tool and capability development by acting as a key user of reporting solutions, facilitating user adoption, identifying automation opportunities, and contributing to the evolution of the SQI data ecosystem.


Your Profile


Master’s degree or equivalent experience
Strong experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or performance monitoring
Proven experience with BI tools (Power BI, etc.)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to translate data into clear business insights
Good understanding of operational processes
Experience in Safety and/or Quality is a strong asset
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical and business stakeholders
Autonomous, proactive, and results-oriented


What’s in it for you?


This role offers a unique opportunity to grow at the crossroads of data, operations, and strategy, with a direct impact on Safety and Quality performance. You will gain strong visibility across the organization by working closely with operational teams and management, while shaping how data is used to drive decisions.
It is an ideal position to develop a cross-functional understanding of the business, strengthen your analytical and influencing skills, and play a key role in building a data-driven culture with a tangible impact on operational excellence.
You will play a central role in embedding data at the heart of operational excellence.


Our offer


Salary a competitive salary package, allowance for representation expenses, year-end bonus, double vacation pay, meal vouchers (€10 per working day), eco-vouchers, sport & culture vouchers, bonuses based on individual and group results.
Insurance group insurance, hospitalisation insurance, ambulant care insurance for the whole family and also personal accident insurance.
Vacation You will be entitled to 20 vacation days and 5 additional vacation days, 6 local days, 4 exempt days (after 1 year of employment) and up to 5 long-service days (1 day for every 3 years in employment).
Social fund Year-end vouchers, birth and marriage allowance. We will also cover part of the cost of glasses, a dental prosthesis or similar needs.
Communication you will be given an iPhone, a phone subscription (for work and private use) and a laptop with internet reimbursement.
Discounts you will enjoy a 30% discount on your gas and electricity bill.
Mobility we will offer you a company car and public transport or a mobility budget.
Elia shares Elia will give you the opportunity to subscribe to shares with a discount of 16.66% on the average share price.


Location

Avenue de Vilvorde 126 - 1000 Brussels

There’s something electric in the air with this job offer!

In exchange for your work and dedication, you enjoy the following benefits


A job full of variety with a top employer Elia encourages innovation and collaboration. Within our company you will be at the forefront of the energy transition, and you will have the chance to contribute to ground-breaking technologies designed to accelerate this transition. It is a one-of-a-kind opportunity to further develop your knowledge and skills.
Focus on personal growth and well-being at work Discover a wide range of professional training and coaching opportunities that are guaranteed to give your personal growth a solid boost. At the same time, as a top employer, we put maximum effort into a positive work culture in which your well-being is central.
Development opportunities for a challenging career At Elia, we encourage you to seek out and seize new professional opportunities. You will enjoy complete freedom to shape your career on your own terms.
A diverse team of passionate colleagues Elia puts a high value on diversity and inclusion. You will join a diverse and passionate team that enjoys sharing knowledge and leading the way towards a more sustainable future together.


These are just a few of the benefits that distinguish Elia as a Top Employer. We are convinced that your contribution to our team will be invaluable and look forward to welcoming you soon!

Title: V.I.E Sales Business Analyst - Eucerin
Description:
Your Tasks

Please note that this opportunity is offered as part of the VIE (Volontariat International en Entreprise) Programme, providing a unique international career experience within a global organization. Applications can only be considered from candidates who meet the formal eligibility criteria and participation requirements of the VIE Programme.

Your role

Acting as business partner for all Sales functions and driving data driven decision making for strategic topics. Responsible for the monitoring and KPI analysis of e.g. Sell-In & Sell-Out Data Dashboards, Promo activities, Category Management and the activities of the field sales team as well as working on strategic projects.

Main Responsibilities

Enable data driven Shopper & Customer Marketing


Uses data & insights to support the S&CM team in making best in class in-store shopper activations & maximizing offtake on Eucerin across all available shopper contact points
Monitors progress of promotional activities and handles Pre & Post analyses of promos to generate insights to be used to strengthen existing plans and maximize future activation plans - Supports on overall coordination of launches and helps deliver sales, market share & category growth for Eucerin
Continuous analysis of the market and competitors, e.g. to be inspired by new trends


Optimize & maximize Sales activities in the (e-)POS and category management via use of data


Analyses monthly sell out/ sell in data and prepares data in custom built Power BI tool
Uses data & insights to support on optimizing assortment ranking & distribution and shares gap analyses
Runs ad-hoc analyses as part of business partnering for the whole sales team


Enable high team performance by increasing effectiveness & efficiency


Supports team capacity planning and sector allocation in the field team by using data to find the most efficient set up
Tracks all relevant Sales KPIs as well as the Sales targets as defined by Sales Manager and shares updates with team
Handles weekly, monthly and quarterly Sales tracking and bonus incentive follow-up


Drive the future of the business via Sales Projects


Participates in / lead (strategic) sales projects to set the path for future success via e.g. improving the way of working, increasing efficiency & effectiveness etc.
Cooperates with the regional & global teams as well as teams from other countries to find synergies and share + make use of best practices


Your Profile

What it takes to join us?


Eligibility to VIE contract - conditions: https://mon-vie-via.businessfrance.fr/en/what-is-the-vie-french-international-young-talent-program
Available for 12 months (starting date 1 January 2027)
University degree (Sales, Business Administration, Marketing)
First experience as Business Analyst / Category Manager / RGM Manager or Business Controller
Analytical mindset & ability to handle multiple projects with medium to high complexity
High-level skills in Microsoft Office, Excel and Business Analytics
Problem solving and hands-on mentality
Team player with good communication skills
Multilingual preferred : English, Dutch, French


At Beiersdorf, we want to help people feel good about their skin – and our commitment goes far beyond caring for skin. For 140 years, we have developed innovative skin and body care products for well-known brands such as NIVEA, Eucerin, La Prairie, Hansaplast, and Labello. We act according to our purpose, WE CARE BEYOND SKIN, and take responsibility for our consumers, our employees, the environment and society. Behind every brand, every product and every accomplishment are our more than 20,000 employees. It is for them that we live an inclusive culture of respect and trust that is strongly aligned with our values – CARE, COURAGE, SIMPLICITY and TRUST. We also embrace diversity by valuing the uniqueness of each individual and being committed to equal opportunities for all.

Title: Research Science Analyst - Battery Insights
Description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


Your Impact

You'll analyze trends and opportunities across the battery value chain - including cell manufacturing, cathode and anode materials, and battery technologies.

You'll build proprietary market models and decision tools, and collaborate with cell makers, OEMs, suppliers and investors to deliver strategic insights.

You'll bring a deep understanding of the battery ecosystem - from raw materials and cell chemistry to gigafactory operations and market dynamics - and a passion for translating data into strategic recommendations. You should be comfortable using AI tools and basic coding to enhance workflows and modeling.

You will be part of the firm's think tank for innovation and decision support across the battery value chain. We help business leaders and policymakers solve critical challenges to accelerate the global shift to electrification and a low-carbon economy.

Working closely with our global network of battery experts, you'll help shape client strategies with data-backed perspectives on technologies, market outlooks, value pools, and cost and value-chain transparency across geographies.

You'll join one of our hubs – Munich, Brussels or Amsterdam - as part of the broader Battery Accelerator Team, with 250+ members, working closely with internal experts with relevant industry experience and academic expertise.

Your Qualifications and Skills


Master's degree in (electro-)chemistry, materials science, physics, chemical/materials engineering, electrical/mechanical engineering, or a related analytical field preferred
Academic background and/or first professional experience in batteries, electrification, energy storage or the battery value chain highly valued
Strong interest in battery technologies and a commitment to developing subject-matter expertise to support McKinsey teams and clients
Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint required; experience in a programming language (e.g., Python) and data management or visualization tools (e.g., SQL, Tableau, Power BI) is a strong plus
Comfort using AI tools and automation to streamline analysis and accelerate development of client-facing assets
Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with a problem-solving mindset
Ability to work confidently with senior stakeholders in fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environments
Strong process management skills; capable of coordinating multiple workstreams independently
Excellent verbal and written English communication skills; additional language skills are a plus (e.g., Mandarin, German, Korean)

Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:

  • Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
  • A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
  • Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
  • World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

Your Impact

You'll analyze trends and opportunities across the battery value chain - including cell manufacturing, cathode and anode materials, and battery technologies.

You'll build proprietary market models and decision tools, and collaborate with cell makers, OEMs, suppliers and investors to deliver strategic insights.

You'll bring a deep understanding of the battery ecosystem - from raw materials and cell chemistry to gigafactory operations and market dynamics - and a passion for translating data into strategic recommendations. You should be comfortable using AI tools and basic coding to enhance workflows and modeling.

You will be part of the firm's think tank for innovation and decision support across the battery value chain. We help business leaders and policymakers solve critical challenges to accelerate the global shift to electrification and a low-carbon economy.

Working closely with our global network of battery experts, you'll help shape client strategies with data-backed perspectives on technologies, market outlooks, value pools, and cost and value-chain transparency across geographies.

You'll join one of our hubs – Munich, Brussels or Amsterdam - as part of the broader Battery Accelerator Team, with 250+ members, working closely with internal experts with relevant industry experience and academic expertise.

Your Qualifications and Skills

  • Master's degree in (electro-)chemistry, materials science, physics, chemical/materials engineering, electrical/mechanical engineering, or a related analytical field preferred
  • Academic background and/or first professional experience in batteries, electrification, energy storage or the battery value chain highly valued
  • Strong interest in battery technologies and a commitment to developing subject-matter expertise to support McKinsey teams and clients
  • Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint required; experience in a programming language (e.g., Python) and data management or visualization tools (e.g., SQL, Tableau, Power BI) is a strong plus
  • Comfort using AI tools and automation to streamline analysis and accelerate development of client-facing assets
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with a problem-solving mindset
  • Ability to work confidently with senior stakeholders in fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environments
  • Strong process management skills; capable of coordinating multiple workstreams independently
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills; additional language skills are a plus (e.g., Mandarin, German, Korean)

Title: Business Insights Expert
Description:
About amfori

amfori advocates for a world in which trade serves a purpose: delivering social, environmental and economic benefits for everyone.




As a global business association, amfori supports its members at every step of their due diligence journey, offering a comprehensive range of ESG products and services.




Founded in 1977, and recognised for its flagship product amfori BSCI, amfori leverages decades of expertise and close collaboration with more than 2400 member companies as well as auditing companies, producers, factories, and other stakeholders such as policymakers. Representing a diverse array of industries in over 50 countries, that cover trade streams in over 100 countries, amfori continues to have a positive impact on fostering sustainable trade.




About the Role

As Business Insights Expert, you will collect, analyse and consolidate market, customer, member and competitive intelligence and translate it into insights that support business development, marketing and organisational decision-making. In this role, you will help guide acquisition priorities, identify growth opportunities and support strategic decision-making across the organisation.




This is an exciting opportunity for someone who combines strong analytical capabilities with commercial acumen and enjoys translating complex data into clear business direction.




Your Responsibilities will include:




Market and competitive intelligence

Monitor and analyse market trends, industry developments and external data sources
Identify emerging opportunities, market gaps and potential risks
Track competitor positioning, value propositions, pricing models and strategic developments
Partner with external research and data providers when required
Deliver insights that support strategic planning and acquisition priorities




Customer, member and pipeline insights

Analyse CRM, pipeline and customer data to uncover trends and opportunities
Conduct win/loss analysis and customer behaviour analysis
Generate insights from customer feedback and qualitative research
Identify high-potential markets, segments, geographies and use cases
Anticipate changing customer needs and buying behaviours




Prioritisation and business decision support

Develop data-driven frameworks to prioritise markets, segments and opportunities
Support acquisition strategy through evidence-based recommendations
Provide insights that help focus resources and investments on high-value opportunities
Enable more informed and effective business development decisions




Insight translation and stakeholder enablement

Transform complex data into clear, compelling and actionable recommendations
Provide insights that support targeting, positioning and messaging decisions
Equip business development and marketing teams with evidence, proof points and market intelligence
Support the organisation in building a stronger culture of data-driven decision-making




Data quality and continuous improvement

Consolidate data from multiple internal and external sources
Identify gaps, overlaps and opportunities to improve data quality and processes
Recommend improvements to tracking, reporting and insight generation capabilities




Your profile

Master's degree or equivalent experience
At least 3 years of experience in business intelligence, market research, commercial insights, strategy, consulting or a related field
Experience working with CRM platforms and analysing customer and pipeline data
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Commercial mindset and business acumen. Knowledge of market research and competitive intelligence methodologies
Ability to communicate complex findings in a clear and actionable way. Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills
Professional proficiency in English; additional languages are an asset




Why to join amfori?

At amfori, you will join a diverse, international environment all united by a common goal: to drive positive change toward a sustainable world in which trade serves a purpose.




Benefits

Group insurance and comprehensive health insurance
Working from home up to 3 days per week
Working from abroad
Extra-legal holidays per year
Net allowance and reimbursement of commuting costs
Internet allowance
Mobile phone and subscription

Title: Data Functional Analyst - FR
Description:
Description de la fonction

En tant que Data Functional Analyst, vous intégrez le Data Office au sein duquel travaillent des équipes agiles multidisciplinaires (Data Engineer, Chefs de Projet, Data Architects, Data Governance et Data Quality spécialistes, Experts en IA, …).

Rôle & responsabilités :


Mener des discussions avec les différents SME (Subject Matter Expert) pour comprendre leurs besoins business.
Identifier, évaluer et comprendre les processus métier, les flux de données opérationnelles et analytiques (entrants et sortants).
Traduire les besoins de l'entreprise en données et exigences techniques.
Concevoir et valider les modèles de données en collaboration avec les Data Architects.
Établir la conception fonctionnelle de nos développements en collaboration avec l'équipe de gouvernance des données, les responsables techniques BI et les équipes informatiques.
Être en contact avec le responsable Data Protection pour assurer la conformité au RGPD et à la sécurité des données.
Assurer le testing des solutions data développées.
Informer et former aux matières data et encourager l’utilisation et l'adoption des solutions dévelopées.


Profil

Vous êtes titulaire d’un Master en informatique ou expérience équivalente et disposez de minimum 5 ans d'expérience dans l'analyse fonctionnelle des données. Vous faites, par ailleurs, valoir une expérience concrète dans la modélisation de Data Warehouse (approche Kimball) et avez de l’expérience dans la conception et l'analyse des flux de données. Une expérience préalable en tant que Data Engineer est un plus.

Vous disposez de minimum 3 ans d'expérience concrète avec MS on-premise stack (SQL Server, SSIS, SSAS, PowerBI). Une expérience avec Azure Databricks est un plus.

Vos excellentes compétences en communication et en présentation vous permettent de traduire les besoins de l'entreprise en solutions techniques.

Vous disposez de bonnes compétences conceptuelles et commerciales.

Orienté solutions, votre approche pragmatique vous permet de mettre en œuvre les actions nécessaires à l’atteinte des objectifs.

Bon team player, vous êtes par ailleurs capable de fédérer autour d’un objectif commun.

Vous vous montrez persévérant, résistant au stress et flexible, aimez apprendre et êtes ouvert d'esprit.

Vous maîtrisez, par ailleurs, les deux langues nationales.

Nous offrons


Nous vous offrons un emploi varié, stimulant et socialement engagé vous permettant de contribuer à la réalisation de solutions informatiques ayant un impact sur la société. « ICT for society » n’est pas notre slogan par hasard.
Vous recherchez un bon équilibre vie privée - vie professionnelle ? Profitez de nos horaires de travail flexibles et de notre politique de télétravail très étendue.
Nous offrons de nombreuses possibilités de formation interne et externe vous permettant de perfectionner en permanence vos compétences techniques et vos aptitudes personnelles.
Nous vous proposons un salaire compétitif, complété par des avantages extralégaux tels qu'une assurance hospitalisation, un plan de pension complémentaire, des chèques-repas, des éco-chèques, etc.
Les fonctions IT peuvent bénéficier d’un budget mobilité avec le choix d'une voiture de société et/ou le remboursement des frais de transport en commun. Sous certaines conditions, ce budget peut même être utilisé pour le paiement de votre loyer ou de votre crédit hypothécaire.
Vous profitez via notre plateforme « Benefits at Work » de réductions avantageuses sur diverses marques de mode, d’électronique, diverses excursions et divers séjours de vacances…
Nous menons une politique d'égalité des chances et estimons notamment que l'égalité salariale est importante.

Title: Business Analyst (f/m/d)
Description:
Are you ready to shape the future of energy trading and sales? As a Business Analyst at Axpo, you will play a vital role in driving efficiency, reducing operational risks, and supporting strategic projects within the Axpo Solutions Group. Join us to make an impact in a dynamic and innovative environment.

What you will do:


Support the invoicing processes for Full Supply and PPA business.
Coordinate with Market Operations (MO), Front Office Services (FOS), and Front Office (FO) to ensure seamless contract onboarding into internal systems.
Reduce operational risks and enhance efficiency by implementing strategic decisions within Back Office Services and Business Support teams.
Lead and support individual business transformation and strategic projects.
Analyze processes, tackle complex P&L inquiries, and resolve operational challenges to ensure smooth daily delivery.
Collaborate on IT specifications and manage IT changes for Back Office Services.
Drive automation, quality improvements, and lead-time optimizations using your technical expertise.
Develop and maintain management reporting tools (e.g. KPI reports) and contribute to development and design of invoicing system.
Follow up on audit findings to ensure timely implementation.



What you bring & who you are:


Education & Experience:
Higher education in Business Management or Information Technology.
At least 3 years of relevant experience in energy trading and sales.
Business fluency in English (C1/C2); additional European languages are a plus.

Technical Expertise:
Strong knowledge of energy and financial markets (e.g., contract mapping, trading products, financial settlements, collaterals, and margins).
Expertise in deal lifecycle management for Full Supply and PPA business, including deal booking, contract modeling, and invoicing.
Proficiency in data analysis and coding (e.g., SQL, C#, Python).
Experience with BI tools like PowerBI or SSRS for data visualization and analysis.
Familiarity with ETL development tools (e.g., Visual Studio, DATAIKU) is a plus.

Other Skills:
Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder alignment abilities.
High customer and result orientation, even under time pressure.
Ability to balance compliance and innovation effectively.



About the team:

You’ll join a collaborative and diverse team that values innovation, efficiency, and mutual support. Working closely with Back Office Services, Front Office, Market and Credit Risk, Accounting, Controlling, and Logistics, you’ll contribute to impactful projects and daily operations in a dynamic environment that encourages growth and teamwork.

We look forward to your application — even if you don’t meet all the requirements! At Axpo, we value your unique perspective and are excited to hear from you.

At Axpo Group, we are dedicated to fostering a culture of non-discrimination, tolerance, and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications regardless of race and ethnicity, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, as well as socioeconomic, cultural, and religious background. We are committed to ensuring a respectful and inclusive recruiting process and workplace for everyone.

Title: Attribution de performance (F/H/X)
Description:
Descriptif du poste

Dans le cadre d’un programme stratégique de transformation mené par un acteur majeur de la gestion d’actifs à l’échelle internationale, vous rejoindrez l’équipe Global Operations Reporting pour accompagner la production courante (BAU) de l’attribution de performance, ainsi que la préparation de la migration des rapports d’attribution de performance post-production.

En tant que Performance Attribution Specialist, vous apporterez un support spécialisé aux gérants de portefeuille des équipes d’investissement.

Vos missions principales

🔹 Standardisation et supervision de la production


Standardiser la production dès que possible et faciliter son transfert vers la Reporting Factory (basée en Asie)
Assurer le suivi du planning de production et veiller à l’application du cadre de contrôle
Être le point de contact interne pour ces rapports


🔹 Production spécifique (hors standardisation)


Suivre la performance des portefeuilles des centres d’investissement qui vous sont attribués
Identifier les écarts de performance entre portefeuilles similaires
Produire des rapports d’attribution de performance expliquant l’impact des décisions d’investissement
Calculer les caractéristiques spécifiques des portefeuilles complexes (spread de crédit, duration, exposition)
Fournir des analyses à valeur ajoutée en reliant les zones de risque aux zones de surperformance


🔹 Support et coordination


Répondre aux questions générales relatives à l’attribution de performance
Coordonner avec les différentes équipes de reporting et parties prenantes pour implémenter de nouvelles attributions ou optimiser les process existants
Contribuer activement à la résolution des problèmes, en support à la Reporting Factory
Escalader les problèmes critiques auprès du responsable d’équipe


Vos responsabilités clés

✅ Production dans les délais des attributions de performance

✅ Suivi quotidien de la production réalisée par la Reporting Factory (contribution aux KPI)

✅ Application rigoureuse du cadre de contrôle qualité

✅ Résolution proactive des problèmes récurrents (logging, analyse, actions correctives)

✅ Communication des enjeux opérationnels au management

Profil recherché

Compétences techniques


Excellente maîtrise de l’anglais (obligatoire) ; la maîtrise du français et/ou du néerlandais est un vrai plus
Bonne connaissance des produits financiers et des workflows de traitement des transactions
Maîtrise des outils informatiques standards ainsi que des applications spécifiques métier
La connaissance d’un langage de programmation (VBA, Python, SQL…) est un atout


Compétences comportementales


Rigueur et sens du détail, notamment dans l’application des contrôles qualité
Capacité d’analyse et esprit de synthèse
Autonomie et sens des responsabilités dans le suivi de la production
Excellent relationnel pour coordonner avec des équipes internationales (notamment avec l’Asie)
Réactivité et proactivité dans la résolution de problèmes
Capacité à travailler dans un environnement en transformation (contexte de migration)


Formation et expérience


Formation supérieure en finance, mathématiques financières, ou domaine connexe
Expérience en attribution de performance, gestion de portefeuille, ou reporting financier appréciée
Connaissance du secteur de la gestion d’actifs (Asset Management) souhaitée


Déroulement des entretiens


Un premier échange téléphonique de 5 à 10 minutes afin de comprendre vos attentes et de vous présenter brièvement le processus.
Un premier entretien avec un Digital Sales Manager, d’environ 45 minutes, pour mieux connaître votre parcours et vous présenter eXalt.
Un second entretien avec un Business Manager Senior, d’une durée de 45 minutes à 1 heure, afin d’échanger sur nos clients, nos missions et les opportunités envisageables.


Chaque étape est conçue pour vous donner une vision complète de notre environnement et vérifier que nous partageons les mêmes ambitions.

Qui sont-ils ?

En entreprise, comme en musique, tout est une question de tempo. Depuis 2018, nous réunissons des consultant·e·s passionné·e·s, curieux·ses et ambitieux·ses, uni·e·s par une même conviction : mettre leur expertise au service des défis numériques, sectoriels et industriels de nos clients.

Notre mission ? Accélérer les transformations en combinant excellence opérationnelle, curiosité et audace. Nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs du luxe, du retail, de l’énergie, du transport, du tourisme, de la banque ou encore de l’assurance — partout où la technologie rencontre l’humain.

Nous aimons la tech quand elle connecte et libère les potentiels. Nos consultant·e·s ne se contentent pas de conseiller : ils construisent, testent, mettent en production, mesurent, ajustent et recommencent. Avec nos clients, nous faisons partie du jeu, du début à la fin.

Notre organisation repose sur une culture de la confiance, de l’apprentissage et de la collaboration. Nous avons conçu un cadre unique qui accompagne chaque eXalté·e à chaque étape de sa carrière, avec des rôles clairs, des communautés actives et des rituels qui renforcent le collectif.

Nos eXaltemps trimestriels, notre eXalt Academy et nos projets internes sont autant d’occasions d’apprendre, de partager et de grandir ensemble.

Aujourd’hui présents en France, au Canada, aux États-Unis, au Royaume-Uni, en Belgique, en Espagne, au Portugal et à Monaco, nous sommes portés par un engagement fort et une énergie contagieuse.

Parce qu’apprendre est notre discipline, agir notre obsession et réussir ensemble notre plus belle victoire.

Pulse. Make. Learn.

Trois mots qui rythment notre quotidien. Et peut-être bientôt le tien?

  • Suivre la performance des portefeuilles des centres d’investissement qui vous sont attribués
  • Identifier les écarts de performance entre portefeuilles similaires
  • Produire des rapports d’attribution de performance expliquant l’impact des décisions d’investissement
  • Calculer les caractéristiques spécifiques des portefeuilles complexes (spread de crédit, duration, exposition)
  • Fournir des analyses à valeur ajoutée en reliant les zones de risque aux zones de surperformance

🔹 Support et coordination

  • Répondre aux questions générales relatives à l’attribution de performance
  • Coordonner avec les différentes équipes de reporting et parties prenantes pour implémenter de nouvelles attributions ou optimiser les process existants
  • Contribuer activement à la résolution des problèmes, en support à la Reporting Factory
  • Escalader les problèmes critiques auprès du responsable d’équipe

Vos responsabilités clés

✅ Production dans les délais des attributions de performance

✅ Suivi quotidien de la production réalisée par la Reporting Factory (contribution aux KPI)

✅ Application rigoureuse du cadre de contrôle qualité

✅ Résolution proactive des problèmes récurrents (logging, analyse, actions correctives)

✅ Communication des enjeux opérationnels au management

Profil recherché

Compétences techniques

  • Excellente maîtrise de l’anglais (obligatoire) ; la maîtrise du français et/ou du néerlandais est un vrai plus
  • Bonne connaissance des produits financiers et des workflows de traitement des transactions
  • Maîtrise des outils informatiques standards ainsi que des applications spécifiques métier
  • La connaissance d’un langage de programmation (VBA, Python, SQL…) est un atout

Compétences comportementales

  • Rigueur et sens du détail, notamment dans l’application des contrôles qualité
  • Capacité d’analyse et esprit de synthèse
  • Autonomie et sens des responsabilités dans le suivi de la production
  • Excellent relationnel pour coordonner avec des équipes internationales (notamment avec l’Asie)
  • Réactivité et proactivité dans la résolution de problèmes
  • Capacité à travailler dans un environnement en transformation (contexte de migration)

Formation et expérience

  • Formation supérieure en finance, mathématiques financières, ou domaine connexe
  • Expérience en attribution de performance, gestion de portefeuille, ou reporting financier appréciée
  • Connaissance du secteur de la gestion d’actifs (Asset Management) souhaitée

Déroulement des entretiens

  • Un premier échange téléphonique de 5 à 10 minutes afin de comprendre vos attentes et de vous présenter brièvement le processus.
  • Un premier entretien avec un Digital Sales Manager, d’environ 45 minutes, pour mieux connaître votre parcours et vous présenter eXalt.
  • Un second entretien avec un Business Manager Senior, d’une durée de 45 minutes à 1 heure, afin d’échanger sur nos clients, nos missions et les opportunités envisageables.

Chaque étape est conçue pour vous donner une vision complète de notre environnement et vérifier que nous partageons les mêmes ambitions.

Qui sont-ils ?

En entreprise, comme en musique, tout est une question de tempo. Depuis 2018, nous réunissons des consultant·e·s passionné·e·s, curieux·ses et ambitieux·ses, uni·e·s par une même conviction : mettre leur expertise au service des défis numériques, sectoriels et industriels de nos clients.

Notre mission ? Accélérer les transformations en combinant excellence opérationnelle, curiosité et audace. Nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs du luxe, du retail, de l’énergie, du transport, du tourisme, de la banque ou encore de l’assurance — partout où la technologie rencontre l’humain.

Nous aimons la tech quand elle connecte et libère les potentiels. Nos consultant·e·s ne se contentent pas de conseiller : ils construisent, testent, mettent en production, mesurent, ajustent et recommencent. Avec nos clients, nous faisons partie du jeu, du début à la fin.

Notre organisation repose sur une culture de la confiance, de l’apprentissage et de la collaboration. Nous avons conçu un cadre unique qui accompagne chaque eXalté·e à chaque étape de sa carrière, avec des rôles clairs, des communautés actives et des rituels qui renforcent le collectif.

Nos eXaltemps trimestriels, notre eXalt Academy et nos projets internes sont autant d’occasions d’apprendre, de partager et de grandir ensemble.

Aujourd’hui présents en France, au Canada, aux États-Unis, au Royaume-Uni, en Belgique, en Espagne, au Portugal et à Monaco, nous sommes portés par un engagement fort et une énergie contagieuse.

Parce qu’apprendre est notre discipline, agir notre obsession et réussir ensemble notre plus belle victoire.

Pulse. Make. Learn.

Trois mots qui rythment notre quotidien. Et peut-être bientôt le tien?

Title: Senior BI Engineer (Data Engineer/AI Engineer) F/M/X
Description:
Rejoins l'équipe Data & AI de Mantu Group

Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons des Senior Data Engineer, Senior BI Engineer, Senior Data Analyst et Senior AI Engineer (F/H/X) pour rejoindre l'équipe Data & AI de Mantu Group.

Tu interviendras sur des projets stratégiques et variés, en interne comme chez nos clients, avec l'opportunité de couvrir l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur de la Data : collecte, transformation, modélisation, valorisation, BI, Data Engineering, Machine Learning et IA.

Selon ton profil et tes appétences, tu pourras notamment :

Concevoir et développer des pipelines ETL/ELT
Modéliser et intégrer des données issues de sources multiples
Écrire et optimiser des requêtes SQL
Construire des dashboards et solutions de reporting

Contribuer à l'industrialisation des solutions (CI/CD, Cloud, automatisation des flux)
Piloter ou contribuer à des sujets à fort enjeu métier, en lien direct avec les décideurs

Tu as entre 5 et 15 ans d'expérience sur la chaîne de valeur de la Data et tu es reconnu(e) comme référent(e) technique sur ton domaine d'expertise.

Tu maîtrises solidement au moins une des technologies mentionnées ci-dessus et sais faire preuve d'autonomie sur des sujets complexes, du cadrage technique à la mise en production, y compris dans la relation avec les clients.

Que tu sois plus à l'aise en modélisation de données, en visualisation, en ingénierie de pipelines ou en IA, ton profil nous intéresse. Nous cherchons avant tout des personnes curieuses, autonomes, capables de prendre du recul sur les enjeux métier autant que de manipuler la donnée.

Envie de construire des solutions Data utiles et à fort impact ? On serait ravis d'échanger avec toi !
