Title: Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning Expert
Description:
Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) Expert




NTU International is preparing a proposal for the project “Support to the Africa-EU Space Partnership Programme – AESPP Boost.”




The programme aims to strengthen cooperation between Africa and the European Union in the space sector, supporting policy dialogue, institutional partnerships, knowledge exchange, innovation, private sector engagement and investment, while contributing to stronger and more sustainable African space ecosystems.




In this context, we are seeking a highly qualified Non Key Expert – Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) Expert to support the design, implementation and continuous improvement of the programme's monitoring, evaluation and learning framework.




Minimum Qualifications and Skills

University degree at Master’s level in evaluation, statistics/data science, development economics, social sciences, or a related field. In the absence of such degree, four additional years of relevant professional experience.
Excellent command of English.
Working knowledge of French and/or Portuguese will be considered an asset.




Minimum General Professional Experience

Minimum 8 years of professional experience in monitoring and evaluation, results-based management, programme evaluation and/or applied data analysis.




Minimum Specific Professional Experience

At least 4 years of professional experience in the design and/or operation of Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning frameworks for donor-funded or complex multi-partner programmes, including indicators, baselines, data collection protocols, evidence consolidation and/or impact assessment.
Experience with EU-funded programmes and in Africa is an asset.




If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply and upload your CV via LinkedIn or send to recruitment@ntu.eu. Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted due to the large amount of applicants

Title: Senior Data Science Analyst - OptimusAI
Description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


Your Impact

As a Data Science Specialist, you’ll collaborate in a dynamic, multi-disciplinary team of 3–6 experts, using your creativity and analytics expertise to drive client performance in areas like energy efficiency, product quality, and capacity. You’ll work side-by-side with client process engineers and analytics specialists, presenting your insights directly to executive audiences.

Internally, you’ll partner with our talented product engineers to develop innovative products and algorithms that address both current and future client needs. You’ll play a key role in codifying best practices, amplifying our impact both inside and outside the firm, and shaping the product roadmap.

You’ll be based in our Brussels office as part of McKinsey’s manufacturing AI solution, OptimusAI, which sits at the intersection of three practices: Global Energy and Materials, QuantumBlack, and Operations.

Global Energy and Materials: Advises production and investor companies across chemicals & agriculture, paper & packaging, metals & mining, oil & gas, and power generation on strategic, operational, and growth issues.

QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey: The AI arm of our firm, helping clients transform faster, innovate smarter, and anticipate the future.

Operations: Assists clients in solving complex operational challenges by developing and implementing strategies and solutions for their most critical problems—connecting boardroom strategies to shop floor operators.

At the intersection of these groups, OptimusAI is a team of ~10 expert consultants, data scientists, and engineers focused on improving processing plant productivity through data analytics. We develop real-time AI advisory systems to support decision making in plant control rooms, optimize process control systems, and unlock plant bottlenecks through data-driven process changes.

OptimusAI also supports a global community of consultants by developing an innovative machine learning toolkit and codifying our approach to deliver significant and lasting client impact.

You’ll benefit from world-class training in business problem structuring and client advisory, working closely with senior manufacturing and analytics experts. Experience unparalleled career growth, with significant ownership and responsibility from day one, all within a collaborative, diverse, and non-hierarchical environment. Plus, seize the opportunity to travel to client sites—locally and around the world.

There is a flexibility to hire at different role level, depending on your experience.

Your Qualifications and Skills


Bachelor’s or master’s degree in data science, computer science, engineering, or a related field
3+ years of hands-on experience in advanced analytics, ideally within heavy industry environments
Advanced Python programming skills, with a passion for writing clean, efficient, modular, and maintainable code
Proven ability to implement and maintain MLOps pipelines for seamless model integration and deployment
Strong DevOps and backend engineering capabilities, including experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible)
Self-starter with excellent organizational abilities—able to independently initiate tasks and drive them to completion
Skilled in making rational, data-driven decisions based on facts and logical reasoning
Ability to create high-quality work products, such as PowerPoint presentations, Excel models, articles, or other written outputs
Exceptional time management skills to thrive in a complex, largely autonomous work environment
Willingness to work or attend meetings outside traditional business hours, and to take on projects at short notice when needed
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills in English with the ability to tailor your style to different audiences and seniority levels

Title: School Internship in Data Consulting (2026-2027)
Description:
Contribute to creating a better tomorrow

The only way we can tackle the challenges of this fast-changing world is with passionate people. Led by our purpose of building trust and solving important problems, we come together at PwC to address the biggest issues facing the world in a way that drives positive impact. Are you eager to join a team fuelled by open and curious minds? People who are passionate about their work and create new solutions for a new day? Then you’re at the right place.

Bring your talent, learn new skills, make a positive impact

Managed Services is the operational execution engine of PwC Advisory. Our mission is to help clients solve complex operational challenges and reach ambitious business objectives. We work hand-in-hand with our colleagues from other PwC Advisory teams to develop, deploy and run operational solutions combining the best experience, methodologies and technologies. Our team turns ideas and insights into concrete actions and results. Under the expert stewardship of our Advisory experts, you’ll delve into the inner workings of companies to find the best solutions for any challenge they might have.

Curious to see how we help our clients transform and move forward in the new industrial and digital age? Wonder what happens behind the scenes of the tailored solutions we design for clients? Whatever your background, if you’re looking for an interesting new challenge, we want to meet you!

In this role, you will work closely with our App & Data team to provide insights and recommendations to drive business growth and improve decision-making processes. You will have the opportunity to work with various data analysis tools, including PowerBI, PowerApps, Excel or other data tools and contribute to business governance and strategy initiatives.

Your Impact:


Collaborate with the team to gather and analyze data from various sources.
Develop and maintain data visualizations and reports using PowerBI and other relevant tools.
Assist in the implementation and maintenance of Custom Tools, PowerApps or Dashboards.
Conduct data analysis to identify trends, patterns and insights to support business decision-making.
Support the development and execution of Data Strategies based on data-driven insights.
Assist in the identification and implementation of process improvements to enhance data quality and accuracy.


About you?


Master or bachelor student in a business study field with interest in data
Willingness to work with the latest tools such as PowerBI, PowerApps and other relevant software.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data sets in Excel or other tools.
Excellent attention to detail and the ability to work with large datasets.
Interest in business governance principles and strategies.
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, to effectively present findings and recommendations.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
Familiarity with data visualization best practices
Basic understanding of statistical concepts and techniques.
Fluent in English and at least one of the national languages
Proactive, showing initiative and strong organizational skills
Uphold the firm's code of ethics and business conduct


Life at PwC Belgium

Our culture and workplace are something we’re proud of. Here’s a sneak peek at some of the benefits you can look forward to.


Flexibility: flexible working hours so you can decide your most effective working pattern.
Infinite learning and growing: broad opportunities to learn every day and exciting career pathways that help you explore different disciplines or areas of expertise.
Diversity & inclusion: we believe that diversity makes PwC stronger. It helps us solve important problems and deliver added value to our clients. We encourage an inclusive culture where people can be the best versions of themselves. We organise various D&I initiatives, including an active employee-led Employee Resource Group (ERG) community, comprising 9 diversity groups with over 200 PwC employees aiming to make an impact within and beyond PwC.
Well-being: an extensive health and well-being programme that includes access to professional sport coaching, individual sessions, sports communities and mental health resources. We encourage a healthy lifestyle with regular wellness challenges and various catering options at our cafeteria.
Team events such as Last Friday Drinks, quarterly themed parties, team-building days and celebrations, as well as time spent on community days and charity activities.
International PwC network: broad access to industry expertise, both locally and through our wider global network of member firms.
Supporting you in every phase of your life, including family friendly work schemes.

Title: Performance Team Intern
Description:
In a nutshell

Kick-start your career with Toyota Motor Europe! As a Performance Team Intern, you'll analyze sales performance, create impactful reports, and help drive business decisions. Bring your analytical mindset and apply today!

Company Information

Toyota is one of the world’s largest automobile manufacturers and a leading global company, founded in 1937. Today, Toyota sells vehicles in 170 countries and employs over 350,000 people worldwide.

You extract and analyze data to support performance initiatives and help improve business tools.
You review key reports and sales KPIs to identify trends and provide actionable insights.
You coordinate team touchpoints and help ensure clear and effective communication across stakeholders.
You perform performance and competitor analyses to identify risks, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
You prepare reports, presentations, and ad hoc analyses using tools such as Excel and PowerPoint.

Your Profile


You are fluent in English (TME’s business language)
You are proficient in Microsoft Excel and enjoy using it to analyze data and create insightful reports.
You are familiar with Power BI and can use data visualizations to uncover and communicate key insights.
You have strong organizational and coordination skills, allowing you to manage multiple priorities effectively.
You communicate clearly and confidently, both in writing and verbally.
You can work independently, while also thriving as part of a collaborative team.
You have a keen eye for detail and take a proactive approach to solving challenges.

Duration

Flexible working hours and hybrid working (homeworking, 10 days from abroad);

Consulting staff position in Competition Economics in Brussels

We are currently looking for Consulting staff to join our Economics Practice in Brussels. We require a highly motivated problem solvers with strong analytical ability and a desire to advance within BRG.

We are dedicated to supporting your professional development and qualifications relevant to your role. You will also have the opportunity to participate in professional events and networking opportunities. Our firm culture is entrepreneurial and inclusive, welcoming individuals from all backgrounds. We are seeking team members who are intellectually curious and passionate about making a difference.

Responsibilities

Your work will involve both execution and oversight of engagement work streams that may be either qualitative or quantitative in nature.

Responsibilities include data cleaning, designing and implementing statistical and econometric analyses, performing rigorous quality control checks, developing and delivering client-ready materials, and conducting in-depth industry and market research.


Reviewing relevant case-specific literature;
Conducting literature and case law reviews to draw conclusions for case work.
Carrying out and leading data cleanup and preparation.
Conducting economic and econometric analyses.
Presenting your findings through data visualisation and drafting of client reports.
Develop project management skills communicate results and work product as appropriate.
Supporting and supervising interns or more junior staff.
Participating in internal and external business development projects such as contributing to opinion pieces, conferences and workshops.


The ideal candidate will have skills and experience in the following areas:


You hold an advanced degree (M.A., M.Sc., or PhD) in Economics or related fields from a leading university.
Ideally have previous internship or work experience with a focus on competition economics or related field (beneficial but not essential, we welcome applications from those without this experience)
You have an interest in competition economics and a good knowledge of theoretical and/or empirical microeconomics and industrial organisation.
You enjoy conceptual issues and working with data.
You are proficient in Excel and statistical software/programming languages (e.g., R, Stata or Python) and desire to expand those skills further and train others.
You can draft and communicate effectively in English and German. A good knowledge of other languages (e.g., French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, etc.) is an asset.
You are committed to producing high-quality analyses and paying close attention to detail.
You have a positive can-do attitude and you are willing to proactively engage with your colleagues.

Title: Business Analyst - Fraud & Financial Crime
Description:
Help financial institutions build the next generation of fraud prevention.

Online fraud and phishing are no longer simply cybersecurity or customer-awareness issues. For banks and insurers, fraud prevention is increasingly becoming a business transformation challenge involving payments, technology, data, customer journeys, operations and governance.

At Capco, we help financial institutions translate this changing fraud landscape into practical solutions. Our work spans fraud prevention and detection, payment controls, real-time decisioning, fraud intelligence, customer protection and operating models.

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst with a strong track record in Fraud, Financial Crime, Payments or related Risk domains within financial services.

What will you do?

As a Business Analyst, you will work at the intersection of business, risk, operations and technology. You will help banks and insurers turn complex fraud challenges and regulatory requirements into concrete processes, requirements and solutions.


Analyse and redesign fraud prevention and detection processes
Translate business and regulatory requirements into functional requirements, user stories and process designs
Design and improve payment and customer journeys around fraud prevention and intervention
Define requirements for real-time fraud monitoring and decisioning
Work on fraud data, behavioural analytics, device intelligence and fraud signals
Support the design of fraud operating models, including roles, processes and governance
Contribute to initiatives around victim support, case management and customer communication
Facilitate workshops with stakeholders across Fraud, Risk, Payments, Operations, IT, Compliance and Customer Experience
Translate complex business challenges into clear recommendations and actionable solutions


What are we looking for?

You are a Business Analyst who already has hands-on experience in fraud or a closely related domain and who understands the realities of financial services.


2+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Analyst, Product Owner or similar role
Proven experience in fraud prevention, fraud detection, financial crime, payments or related risk domains
Experience working within banking or insurance
Fluent knowledge of Dutch OR French AND English
Strong experience in requirements gathering, process analysis and stakeholder management
The ability to translate complex business, operational and regulatory requirements into clear functional solutions
Experience working across business and technology teams
Strong analytical, communication and workshop facilitation skills
A structured and pragmatic approach to solving complex problems


Why Capco?

At Capco, you will work predominantly within financial services, alongside experienced consultants and subject-matter experts. You will work on complex transformation programmes where business, technology and financial-services expertise come together.


Work on banking and insurance transformation programmes with real business impact
Collaborate with senior stakeholders across Fraud, Risk, Payments, Operations, IT and Compliance
Combine business analysis with technology, data and regulatory expertise
Build your profile in a fast-moving domain where financial institutions are redesigning fraud prevention

Title: Investment Support Officer F/M
Description:
Position description

Business unit

Investment Management - Institutional Portfolio Management

Job title

Investment Support Officer F/M

Contract type

Permanent

Candriam Group Presentation

Candriam is a global multi-specialist asset manager and a recognized pioneer and leader in sustainable investment. For more than 25 years, Candriam has offered innovative and diversified investment solutions across many asset classes including fixed income, equities, absolute return , asset allocation and illiquid assets.

As a Responsible Employer, Equal Employment Opportunity is crucial to Candriam. We are committed to building the best global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We provide an inclusive work environment and support wellbeing and work-life balance.

Mission

Support the investment activities of Candriam’s Institutional Portfolio Management team by ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and timely delivery of portfolio data, analyses, and operational processes.

The Investment Support Officer acts as a key partner to portfolio managers, contributing to portfolio monitoring, performance analysis, and investment decision support.

This role plays a central part in enhancing investment processes, supporting governance, and facilitating coordination across front office, risk, sales & reporting, and operational teams.

Responsabilities


Provide daily support to portfolio managers through monitoring of investment limits, NAV validation, and performance analysis.
Contribute to portfolio construction activities by supporting rebalancing processes and replicating benchmark risk exposures.
Manage liquidity through execution and monitoring of money market and repo transactions.
Prepare and analyse investment data for economic presentations, internal committees, client presentations and strategic discussions.
Produce forward-looking analyses such as accounting return projections for insurance companies and fee simulations.
Ensure consistency and quality of investment data across systems used for portfolio management, risk, and reporting.
Act as a liaison between portfolio management and internal stakeholders (risk, compliance, IT, client servicing).
Coordinate and contribute to responses to RFPs and client-specific investment requests.
Participate in the development and enhancement of investment tools (Excel, VBA, PowerBI), including automation of existing analyses.



Profile

Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to summarise complex data or operational issues clearly.

Fluent in English as well as Dutch.

Min 1 to 3 years of experience in an asset management company as portfolio assistant, risk officer or equivalent position.

Strong understanding of financial markets and investment products (fixed income, equities, multi-asset).

Proven ability to coordinate with multiple teams and resolve operational issues across systems and data sources.

Familiarity with ESG and financial data.

Advanced Excel skills; experience with portfolio management systems (BBG, Factset) and reporting tools.

Collaborative, flexible, and eager to contribute to process improvement initiatives.

Job location


Candidate criteria

Education


Master's Degree I / Bac+4



Minimum Level Of Experience Required

2-5 years

Languages


English (C1 - Fluent)
Dutch (C1 - Fluent)

Title: Functional Data Engineer
Company: Projective Talent | Part of Projective Group
Description:
At Projective Talent, we connect ambitious professionals with challenging environments where they can accelerate their growth and make a real impact.




For one of our leading clients in the financial services sector, we are looking for a Functional Data Engineer who wants to play a key role in a large-scale data transformation journey.




You'll join a modern data environment that is evolving towards a Data Mesh architecture, helping teams turn complex data into structured, scalable and future-proof data products. In this role, you act as the link between business stakeholders and technical data engineers, ensuring data requirements are translated into clear models and actionable solutions.




This is the ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys combining analytical thinking, data modelling and stakeholder interaction.




Your Responsibilities:

Analyse business requirements and translate them into clear data solutions.
Identify, assess and document data sources across multiple domains.
Design and maintain logical data models and data structures.
Collaborate closely with Technical Data Engineers throughout implementation.
Support the development of modern data products within a Data Mesh environment.
Validate delivered solutions and ensure alignment with business needs.
Drive discussions around data definitions, ownership and quality.
Contribute to data governance and continuous improvement initiatives.
Work with a variety of stakeholders to solve complex data challenges.




Your Skills:

We're looking for someone who combines strong analytical capabilities with a genuine interest in data modelling and stakeholder collaboration.




You have/are

A Master in IT, Engineering, Data, Business Engineering or a related field.
Experience in Data Analysis, Data Modelling, Data Warehousing or a similar domain.
Strong SQL skills.
Good understanding of relational databases such as Oracle or PostgreSQL.
Experience with data modelling concepts and methodologies.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
The confidence to challenge stakeholders and drive discussions forward.
Strong communication skills and the ability to translate complex concepts into clear solutions.
Fluency in English in addition to French/Dutch




Nice to have

Experience with Data Vault modelling.
Knowledge of Data Mesh principles.
Experience with PowerDesigner or similar data modelling tools.
Exposure to Data Governance practices.
Experience working in a large and complex enterprise environment.

Projective Talent is part of Projective Group. We do not do things the typical way. We are not a recruiter and not just a classic consultancy firm. We are a launchpad for ambitious minds. You are in the driver’s seat of your career, and we are here to support your journey.

A competitive salary and a flexible mobility budget, including the option of a company car or bike leasing.
Meal and eco vouchers, an individual training budget, and bonus opportunities because we believe great work should be rewarded.
Entry into one of our Smart Programmes, based on where you are in your career and where you want to grow.
A tailored client match based on your skills, ambitions, and personality.
Coaching throughout your journey by your very own Talent Development Officer, genuinely there to help you thrive.

Title: Internship - Customer Strategy and Planning
Description:
Life tastes better with ice cream

With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.

We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.

What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work.

We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.

We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.

The Role

You will join as an Intern in our Category Management team based in Brussels Tour & Taxis (Belgium).

The Customer Strategy and Planning team (CSP) is sitting at the very centre of Strategy and Operations of our business. The team analyzes and understands the market, turning data into insights, uncovering trends and opportunities. Externally the CSP business partner for key customers to help them grow their categories through objective advice on category strategy, promotion, assortment and shelf.

What You'll Be Responsible For


Conduct data analysis to understand market performance and results.
Summarize data into actionable, cross-functional insights for commercial and marketing-teams.
Present analysis to internal stakeholders.
Contribute to preparation of external customer sessions
Lead internal processes for go-to-market excellence
Update tools and analytical frameworks


We're Looking For Someone Who


You are available for 5 to 6 months starting Q3 2026 (minimum 32 hours/week).
You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor/Master-degree, preferably in Business Economics or Business Engineering
You are fluent in Dutch or French and English.
You have strong analytical thinking skills.
You have a passion for high performance


Why join us?

This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!

You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.


Roles with real accountability and visible impact
Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
Continuous learning and development as the business grows
Reward linked to performance and contribution.


Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.

Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?

If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.

If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.

Additional Information

The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

Title: Internship - Management Consulting Intern -Song Services - As of February 2027
Description:
Are you analytical by nature, curious about experience, and motivated by change?

Do you enjoy working across different industries, problem spaces, and project types?

Are you eager to turn data and insights into real, tangible impact?

As a Management Consulting Intern in the Customer Insight & Delivery team, you will help organizations rethink and transform how they care for their customers. You will work at the intersection of data, customer insight, technology, and delivery, contributing to projects that reinvent customer experience and customer care models across industries.

This role is ideal for someone with a strong analysis mindset, who embraces variety and continuous learning in a fast-changing consulting environment.

Your Job

As part of our team, you will contribute to customer transformation initiatives combining advisory and delivery.

Because our work is highly diverse, your role may evolve from one project to another: in scope, industry, and responsibilities.

At the core of our work, we enhance customer experience across industries through three pillars. The examples below illustrate your typical responsibilities you may take on within each pillar:

Data-driven knowledge (e.g. transforming customer data into insights using analytics and speech-to-text technologies)



Provide background analytical support to the team by collecting and cleaning data, building simple analyses, and preparing charts, summaries, and slides that help the project team progress internal work and client deliverables.



Technology enablement (e.g. chatbots and digital solutions to optimize processes and experience)



Support delivery workstreams through documentation, requirements notes, basic solution research, and quality checks (e.g., test scripts, issue logs), helping the team prepare materials and keep implementation tasks on track.



Strategy definition (e.g. redefining customer approach and service models)



Contribute to strategy and transformation engagements by doing desk research, supporting process mapping, preparing workshop materials, capturing meeting notes, and structuring inputs into clear storylines for internal alignment and client-ready outputs.

You have a strong analytical mindset and enjoy working with data, insights, and problem-solving.

You are curious, adaptable, and motivated by variety and change across projects and industries.

You are interested in customer experience, service transformation, and consulting.

You enjoy combining thinking (analysis) with doing (delivery).

You have an interest in digital and customer-related technologies (e.g. CRM platforms, conversational AI, customer analytics).

You thrive in multidisciplinary and diverse teams.

You are fluent in English + French and/or Dutch (both is a strong asset).

You are in the process of getting a Master’s degree in any educational background.

Title: Ormit Talent - Data Traineeship
Description:
Ben je goed met data? Top. Maar wij zoeken mensen die data menselijk maken.

Data is krachtig. ALS je weet hoe je ermee werkt. En nee, het gaat niet alleen om code. Het gaat om jou. Jouw nieuwsgierigheid. Jouw lef. Jouw drive om dingen beter, slimmer of anders te doen.




Geen standaard data traineeship

In dit traineeship ga je verder dan cijfers. In twee jaar tijd werk je in verschillende datarollen, ontdek je meerdere bedrijven én krijg je een flinke dosis training en coaching. Hard skills? Zeker. Human skills? Dubbel zeker. Die mix maakt van jou een future data chief.




Je toekomstige job

Vergeet theoretische cases. Vergeet vacatures die verwachten dat je alles al weet. Dit traineeship is er om uit te zoeken waar jij blij van wordt én om je klaar te stomen voor een impactvolle carrière in data.

Ontdek jouw data-ding. Probeer rollen uit als data-analist, data translator, business analist of junior data scientist. Vind jouw sweet spot!
Pin je niet vast op één rol of specialisatie. Je draait mee bij verschillende bedrijven, in diverse teams en sectoren. Zo bouw je een brede kijk op data.
Een team dat je steunt. Met je eigen coach, data mentor én mede-data trainees die elkaar uitdagen en supporten.
Werk aan je menselijke kant. Van communicatie en leiderschap tot zelfbewustzijn en kritisch denken.
En ja hoor, tech skills ook. Denk: hackathons, echte klantencases én een persoonlijk opleidingsbudget.




🤔 Ben jij wie we zoeken?

Je hebt een bachelor of master in een data-gerelateerd domein. Denk: Wiskunde, Computerwetenschappen, AI, Data Science, Informatiebeheer... En max drie jaar werkervaring.
Je bent nieuwsgierig. Je staat open voor het onbekende. Je wil ontdekken wat er allemaal mogelijk is met data.
Je spreekt data & code. Excel voelt vertrouwd. En je hebt al geëxperimenteerd met Python, SQL of Power BI. Kennis van Azure of Databricks? Extra nice!
Je spreekt Nederlands, Frans én Engels. Concreet: C1 Engels, plus C2 in Nederlands of Frans, én B2 in de andere taal. Zo kun je vlot werken in heel België.
Je hebt people skills. Je communiceert helder, durft je mening te geven en maakt makkelijk connectie. Empathie, lef, probleemoplossend denken en een kritische blik: daar gaan we op aan.
Je wil groeien. Perfect zijn hoeft niet. Maar een groeimindset is wel een must.




Waarom jij hiermee gaat uitpakken bij je vrienden:

Unieke mix van hard & human skills. Data leren combineren met leiderschap, communicatie en zelfinzicht? Yes please.
Persoonlijke coaching & mentoring. Met je eigen coach én experten uit het werkveld groei je sneller dan in eender welke junior job.
Een sterke community. Je maakt deel uit van een hechte groep trainees die samen groeien, leren en lachen.




Twijfel je nog? Geen probleem.

Je hoeft nog niet te weten wat je droomjob is. Dat ontdekken we samen.

Solliciteer gewoon en dan praten we verder.

Description:
About this Position At Henkel, you can be a game changer and craft your career. Unleash your entrepreneurial spirit by bringing your ideas to life within a global team. Our leading brands and technologies, along with our high-performing businesses, will provide you with countless opportunities to develop your skills and explore new paths. Your career at Henkel will contribute to a more sustainable future, while you grow within our vibrant, diverse culture of trust and belonging. If you are up for challenging the status quo, join our team of pioneers and make your mark on the future with us.

What You´ll Do


Collaborate closely with NRM manager to align on key priorities & lead the channel execution & delivery of projects.
Set-up and structure Data Tools and then analyze internal KPIs and external market share data through several lenses.
Support daily tasks and projects in the strategic areas of pricing analysis, promotion effectiveness, portfolio mix & trade terms optimization.
Translate, analysis, insights into clear recommendations & presentations to help maximize our overall turnover, profit & market share.
The opportunity to collaborate closely with other functions such as Sales, Marketing, Category Development, ... to ensure NRM priorities are embedded & delivered across functions.


What makes you a good fit


Bachelor or Master students of business-related studies with focus on business Administration, Data analytics, Economics, Econometrics, Finance, ...
Practical experience, e.g., by former internships, especially in sales, marketing, or controlling is beneficial
Firm knowledge of MS Office Package, especially MS Excel and Power Point
Excellent knowledge of English (written & spoken), command of Dutch or French is a plus, but not a prerequisite
Strong analytical mind & excellent communication skills
Self-driven, proactive, and goal-oriented team player, with excellent collaboration & organizational skills
Available for 6 months full-time internship, starting as of January 2027


Some perks of joining Henkel


An exciting and educational full-time internship in an international FMCG business
Fun and educational events organized for the intern community, with opportunities to broaden your network
10 days of holidays and the possibility to work from home 40% of the time

Title: Job | Digital Performance Analyst | Brussel
Description:
Omschrijving

Je analyseert en interpreteert digitale prestaties aan de hand van een helder KPI‑kader en bestaande dashboards.

Door jouw inzichten en consistente rapportering creëer je transparantie en zorg je ervoor dat Belfius slimme, datagedreven beslissingen kan nemen.

De job in een notendop

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het beheren van een consistent KPI‑framework, het opvolgen van digitale prestaties via bestaande dashboards en het vertalen van data naar duidelijke aanbevelingen en inzichten.

Je belangrijkste taak is ervoor te zorgen dat KPI’s op een uniforme manier worden gedefinieerd, gemeten en geïnterpreteerd, zodat de volledige organisatie werkt met één single source of truth.

Je team bestaat uit collega’s binnen de Corporate Office van Digital, Brand & Communication, en jouw rol hierin is optreden als performance‑expert die KPI‑governance bewaakt, rapportering verzorgt en inzichten deelt met de Digital Hub en businesslijnen.

Een typische werkdag ziet er als volgt uit: je monitort evoluties in KPI’s, bereidt week- en maandrapporten voor, duikt in opvallende trends, stemt interpretaties af met stakeholders en ondersteunt beslissingen met heldere storytelling.

Jij hoeft geen witte raaf te zijn

Al kan je er bij ons wel één worden. Bij ons mag je volop je vleugels uitslaan als je iemand bent met:


een opleiding in digitale analyse, marketing, economie, business of een relevante werkervaring
ervaring met KPI‑governance, performancemonitoring of datarapportering
sterke analytische skills en de capaciteit om complexe data om te zetten in duidelijke, bondige inzichten



Je scoort extra met:


tweetaligheid (Nederlands/Frans)
kennis van QlikSense of ervaring met datavalidatie en interpretatie



Belfius koestert zijn talenten

Behalve de kans om elke dag te shinen, bieden wij jou een fulltime contract van onbepaalde duur met:


Een mooi loon aangevuld met een innovatief aanbod om een persoonlijk budget samen te stellen dat je kan besteden volgens je voorkeuren (bv. wagen, fiets, pc, smartphone, tablet, huisvesting onder bepaalde voorwaarden) en extralegale voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, personeelsvoordeel op eigen producten en diensten, en een hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering.
Mogelijkheden te over om je te ontwikkelen door een brede waaier aan opleidingen en carrièrekansen in de hele Belfius-groep.
Een goede werk-privé balans dankzij flexibele uren, de combinatie kantoor- en thuiswerk en een aantrekkelijk aantal vakantiedagen.
Een moderne werkplek in het hart van Brussel met een coole fitness, een lekker gezond restaurant en gezellige ontmoetingsruimtes, dit alles op wandelafstand van de winkelstraat, het treinstation Brussel-Noord en de metrohalte Rogier.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Het team Data Analytics ondersteunt CM in haar ambitie om uit te groeien tot het meest datagedreven gezondheidsfonds van België. We begeleiden de organisatie tijdens haar volledige data- en analyticsreis en ontwikkelen maatwerkoplossingen op basis van moderne technologieën. Zo helpen we de verschillende businessdomeinen om data optimaal te benutten voor innovatie, procesoptimalisatie en het realiseren van strategische doelstellingen.

Onze expertise omvat onder meer datastrategie, data Governance, advanced analytics, innovatie-workshops en de ontwikkeling van data-oplossingen op maat.

Je maakt deel uit van een multicultureel team van ongeveer 30 professionals, waaronder Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Reporting Specialisten en Analisten. Samen bouwen we innovatieve oplossingen die de verschillende businessdomeinen van CM ondersteunen.

Vandaag bevindt het team zich midden in een belangrijke transformatie. We evolueren van een klassieke centrale dienstverlening naar domeingerichte Agile teams, waarin business en IT samen eigenaar zijn van de data-oplossingen die ze ontwikkelen en beheren.

Als Data Scientist analyseer je complexe bedrijfsproblemen en ontwikkel je verschillende soorten dataproducten zoals predictieve modellen, dashboards of API’s die bijdragen aan strategische beslissingen. Je voert diepgaande data-analyses uit, experimenteert met algoritmes en vertaalt inzichten naar concrete oplossingen met maatschappelijke impact.

Je werkt nauw samen met business stakeholders, ML Engineers en andere dataspecialisten om deze dataproducten niet alleen te bouwen, maar ook succesvol te implementeren.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden


Analyseren van businessuitdagingen en formuleren van datagedreven oplossingen.
Ontwikkelen, trainen en valideren van machine learning- en optimalisatiemodellen.
Uitvoeren van exploratieve data-analyses en het bouwen van verschillende types deliverables zoals dashboards of API's.
Visualiseren en communiceren van inzichten via presentaties, dashboards en storytelling.
Samenwerken met analisten, data-engineers en andere data scientists rond het bouwen van dataproducten.
Adviseren en samenwerken met klanten en stakeholders rond de inzet van data-oplossingen binnen hun context


AanbodExt

Aantrekkelijk loonpakket: We bieden je een contract van onbepaalde duur, een aantrekkelijk salaris en een mooi pakket aan voordelen: maaltijdcheques van 9 euro en een bedrijfsrestaurant, 13 de maand, een extra premie in juli, netto-onkostenvergoeding , terugbetaling openbaar vervoer 100%, fietsvergoeding, aanvullende kinderbijslag, groepsverzekering, hospitalisatieverzekering, verzekering gewaarborgd inkomen, fietslease, …

Flexibel werken: Mogelijkheid tot 4 dagen per week thuiswerken of vanuit één van onze regionale kantoren. Vakantie, 20 verlofdagen, 4 extra feestdagen, 12 ADV-dagen en extra verlof naarmate je langer bij ons werkt.

Maatschappelijke impact: Bij CM werk je niet zomaar. Samen met je collega’s draag je rechtstreeks of onrechtstreeks je steentje bij aan de gezondheid van velen. Je werk heeft echt betekenis.

Opleidingen en Groeimogelijkheden: Bij CM sta je zelf aan het stuur van je loopbaan. Je krijgt kansen om te groeien in je functie en in de organisatie. Er zijn opleidingen om je kennis en vaardigheden te vergroten.

Team: Als kers op de taart, enthousiaste en toffe collega’s en een dynamische en open werkcultuur die gericht is op samen mooie resultaten behalen.

InteresseExt

Bezorg ons je cv en motivatiebrief via onderstaande link. We kijken ernaar uit je reactie te mogen ontvangen!

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Werken bij CM, is werken met goesting. Want bij CM heb je een positieve impact op het leven van miljoenen Belgen. Dat ervaren onze duizenden medewerkers elke dag. Samen dragen we bij aan een gezondere samenleving voor iedereen. Dat geeft voldoening en energie. Ook voor jou is CM een fijne en zorgzame werkomgeving, waar je idee ë n uitwisselt en jezelf ontwikkelt. Waar je kan rekenen op je collega ’ s en je verbonden bent met elkaar. Plezier hebben in wat je doet, daar doen we het voor! Bij CM telt elke dag. Voor de mensen, de samenleving en voor jezelf.

Met 600 ICT-collega's zetten we ons dagelijks samen in om de beste service te bieden aan onze 4.7 miljoen leden en onze bijna 8.000 personeelsleden.

Flexibiliteit gegarandeerd! Mogelijkheid tot 4 dagen per week homeworking of vanuit één van onze regionale kantoren.

Sterke basis in statistiek, SQL en experimenteel design.
Ervaring met visualisatietools zoals Power BI of QuickSight.
Inzicht in MLOps en samenwerking met technische teams.

Title: Job | Senior Quantitative Risk Analyst | Brussel
Description:
Omschrijving

Je staat in voor de ontwikkeling, het onderhoud, en vaak ook de implementatie en/of het gebruik van financiële modellen die dienen om de risico's, die de bank loopt, te kwantificeren.. Je draagt bij tot een goede risico inschatting vooraf, en correcte voorstelling van de gelopen risico's aan management en regulator.

De job in een notendop

Binnen de afdeling Strategic Risk Management & Modelling (directie CRO) is het team verantwoordelijk voor het kwantificeren van de diverse risico’s die de bank neemt: het kredietrisico (IRB-risicoparameters, krediet economisch kapitaal/ECAP), provisionering (IFRS9), ALM-risico’s (voorafbetaling, rentevoet), niet-financiële risico’s (ESG, operationeel risico) en algemene risico’s (stresstesting).

Het team ondersteunt ook andere risicobeheersafdelingen bij het uitwerken stand brengen van kwantitatieve tools ter ondersteuning van het beslissingsproces (bv. goedkeuring van kredieten of early warning-systemen).Het team is belast met het globaal beheer van de modellen en begeleidt hen doorheen hun hele levenscyclus: ontwikkeling en verbetering van modellen, ondersteuning van de implementatie, geregeld testen en onderhoud. Het team interageert actief met de teams Credit Risk Management en Strategic Risk Management om te zorgen voor het afdoend kwantificeren van de risico’s en het aangepast integreren van de modellen in de risk- en de businessprocessen.

Gezien het belang voor de bank van een goed risk management in het algemeen, en de rol van modellen die daarbij gebruikt worden, komt het team frequent in contact met het centrale management van de bank en met de regulator.

Jij hoeft geen witte raaf te zijn

Al kan je er bij ons wel één worden. We zoeken vooral een straffe persoonlijkheid met een learning mindset.

Bij ons mag je volop je vleugels uitslaan als je je herkent in de volgende eigenschappen:


De ideale kandidaat is nieuwsgierig en analytisch ingesteld en heeft een natuurlijke gedrevenheid om het beter te doen dan de onmiddellijke vereisten van het project en om hindernissen te overwinnen.
Je beschikt over een master in een wetenschappelijk domein zoals wiskunde, fysica, engineering, handelsingenieur.
Je beschikt over uitgesproken kennis van wiskunde en statistiek en over degelijke vaardigheden op het vlak van data mining en data-analyse.
Je beschikt over IT-/programmeervaardigheden met bij voorkeur Python (maar ook Java of C++, Visual Basics) en technische data management-vaardigheden met bij voorkeur SQL (maar ook Oracle, Access).
Eerdere ervaring inzake Financiën/Verzekeringen en gevorderd statistiek, econometrie en in stochastische modelvorming of kredietrisicomodelvorming is een pluspunt.
Je bent oplossingsgericht en kan theoretische vereisten omzetten in pragmatische technische oplossingen.
Je bent in staat zelfstandig te werken en initiatief te nemen, en je bent ook bereid om je in te passen in een team en in een groter project.
Je bent in staat helder te communiceren over ingewikkelde onderwerpen.Je bent in staat vlot te communiceren (zowel mondeling als schriftelijk) in het Engels, alsook in het Nederlands en/of het Frans (als werktaal).
Je hebt meerdere jaren ervaring met (een deel van) de topics die in het team behandeld worden en met de technieken die in het team gebruikt worden. Je bent in staat complexe projecten te managen.

Samenwerken binnen het team om tijdige rapportering aan te leveren.

Je neemt deel aan projecten, analyses en nieuwe initiatieven, waarbij je het vermogen toont om over verschillende afdelingen een project te leiden of te ondersteunen.
Zelfstandig of in samenwerking met andere teams ondersteunen van het balansbeheer, inclusief terugkerende taken en gespecialiseerde opdrachten.

Een inzicht behouden in economische, financiële en regelgevende ontwikkelingen, en die kennis kunnen toepassen in de dagelijkse praktijk.
Op de hoogte blijven van de interne methodologieën van Belfius en externe regelgeving in de contex van je job.

Al kan je er bij ons wel één worden. Bij ons mag je volop je vleugels uitslaan als:


Een wiskundig diploma met interesse in economie hebt of een economisch diploma met een brede passie voor data en kwantitatieve data-analyse.

Title: Job | Data Engineer (Focus Economie) | Bruxelles
Description:
Description

Vous êtes un/une Data Engineer, doté de solides compétences en IT et d’une passion pour la (macro)économie.

Votre job en deux mots


Vous êtes un(e) data-engineer ou data-scientist qui maîtrise tous les aspects du traitement des big data.
Vous travaillerez avec des milliards de données de transactions anonymes de clients Belfius. Avec vos collègues de l’équipe Strategic Research, vous traduisez ces données en analyse économiques pertinentes.
Vous êtes responsable de rendre nos recherches de données et nos processus plus efficaces, comme par exemple via l’automatisation des processus.
Vous êtes également responsable du développement d’outils logiciels, de dashboards, etc. pour soutenir nos analyses économiques et leurs presentation.
Vous êtes un maillon crucial entre notre équipe de Strategic Research, le département IT et l’AI-Lab de Belfius.
Vous aimez gérer vos propres projets créatifs. Pour cela, vous collaborez avec une équipe talentueuse de dix économistes, statisticiens et spécialistes des finances publiques.
Vous fournissez un soutien général à l’équipe pour les questions de données et de modèles.



Pas besoin d’être un oiseau rare

Mais vous pouvez en devenir un, parmi nous. Chez nous, vous pouvez vous distinguer et révéler le meilleur de vous-même si vous répondez aux critères suivants:


Vous avez un master en data engineering, STEM ou un diplôme equivalent.
Vous avez de l’expérience avec l’intelligence artificielle et le traitement des big data, le profiling, la validation et le nettoyage des données ne vous font pas peur.
Vous avez une connaissance approfondie des outils End User (Python, Spark, R, SQL…). Idéalement, vous connaissez aussi Azure ML, DevOps, Cloud.
Vous avez un esprit d’équipe et vous aimez aussi travailler de façon autonome.
Vous êtes capable de traduire des sujets complexes de manière simple à des collègues ayant moins de connaissances data ou AI.
Vous avez un intérêt pour la statistique et/ou l’économétrie.
Vous pouvez suivre des réunions en néerlandais, français et anglaise.



Belfius prend soin de ses talents

Outre la possibilité de faire votre chemin dans un job qui vous plaît, nous vous offrons un contrat à temps plein à durée indéterminée avec :


Un salaire attractif complété par une offre innovante vous octroyant un budget à utiliser selon vos préférences personnelles (p. ex. voiture, vélo, PC, smartphone, tablette, loyer ou crédit hypothécaire sous certaines conditions) et des avantages extralégaux, tels que des chèques-repas, des avantages sur les produits et services internes, une assurance hospitalisation et une assurance groupe.
Des possibilités de développement par le biais d'un large éventail de formations et des opportunités de carrière dans l’ensemble du groupe Belfius.
Un bon équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée grâce à des horaires flexibles, à la combinaison du travail au bureau et à domicile et un nombre attractif de jours de congé.
Un lieu de travail moderne au cœur de Bruxelles, avec une salle de sport branchée, un délicieux restaurant sain et des espaces de réunion confortables, le tout à quelques pas de la rue commerciale, de la gare Bruxelles-Nord et de la station métro Rogier.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Astrelya est un cabinet de conseil franco/suisse, en très forte croissance depuis sa création en 2017, spécialisé dans la transformation digitale, l’excellence opérationnelle et l’innovation technologique. Il est composé de 300 experts passionnés. Le cabinet accompagne ses clients sur l’ensemble du cycle de transformation, depuis la phase de cadrage jusqu’à la mise en œuvre opérationnelle, avec une expertise forte en Data/IA, Cloud, DevOps et méthodes agiles.




Astrelya se distingue par un modèle fondé sur la proximité, la confiance et une culture humaine forte, qui place les collaborateurs au cœur de la création de valeur.




Votre Mission :

Dans le cadre d’un projet de modernisation d’un environnement décisionnel, vous intervenez en tant qu’Expert Data Analyst Power BI / Microsoft Fabric.

Votre rôle consiste notamment à contribuer à la migration d’un environnement Tableau vers Power BI / Microsoft Fabric, tout en garantissant la qualité, la performance et la pérennité des solutions BI mises en place.

Vous apportez également votre expertise aux Data Analysts sur les problématiques complexes et les bonnes pratiques liées à l’écosystème Microsoft BI.




Concrètement vous allez :

Participer à la migration de dashboards Tableau vers Power BI / Microsoft Fabric.
Concevoir, développer et optimiser des rapports et dashboards Power BI.
Concevoir et faire évoluer les modèles de données et modèles sémantiques.
Intégrer et exploiter des données provenant de différentes sources.
Contribuer à la mise en place et à l’évolution de l’environnement Microsoft Fabric.
Analyser et améliorer les performances des rapports et modèles de données.
Participer aux réflexions autour du Capacity Planning Power BI / Fabric.
Définir et partager les bonnes pratiques BI.
Apporter un support technique et accompagner les Data Analysts sur les sujets complexes.




Votre futur environnement technique :

Power BI • Microsoft Fabric • DAX • Power Query • SQL • Semantic Models • Lakehouse • Data Warehouse • Data Lake / OneLake • Tableau • ETL/ELT




Qui êtes-vous ?

Vous disposez d’au moins 5 ans d’expérience en Data Analytics / Business Intelligence.
Vous possédez une expertise confirmée sur Power BI et une expérience pratique de Microsoft Fabric.
Vous maîtrisez la modélisation de données et la conception de solutions BI complexes.
Vous avez une bonne connaissance des problématiques de performance et d’optimisation Power BI.
Une expérience de migration Tableau vers Power BI / Fabric est particulièrement appréciée.
Vous êtes à l’aise avec les architectures Data Warehouse, Data Lake et/ou Lakehouse.
Vous êtes capable d'intervenir comme référent technique et d'accompagner d'autres Data Analysts.
Vous êtes autonome, pragmatique et à l’aise dans un environnement impliquant des interlocuteurs techniques et métiers.




Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Un terrain de jeu pour progresser : Formations, certifications, coaching technique, communautés d’expertise (Java, Cloud, DevOps, Data…) et participation à des projets innovants (IA, architectures Cloud, automatisation…).

Un cadre de travail motivant : Projets variés et à forte valeur ajoutée, événements internes réguliers, afterworks et ateliers tech et salon (DevopsREX, Devoxx et ParisJUG…).

Un engagement RSE : Ecovadis Gold, Signataire de la charte pour la diversité, du Pacte des Nations Unies et mise en place du Mécénat de compétences

Votre futur process de recrutement :

Entretien RH avec une de nos chargées de recrutement
Entretien final avec un de nos managers




Chez Astrelya, nous construisons des solutions innovantes… mais surtout, nous construisons des parcours humains.




Prêt(e) à rejoindre l’aventure ?

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

Talan est un groupe international de conseil et d’expertises technologiques, qui accompagne et accélère la transformation digitale de ses clients par les leviers de la technologie, de la data et de l’innovation.

Présent sur 5 continents dans 21 pays, le Groupe, certifié Great Place To Work, compte plus de 7000 collaborateurs.



Doté d'un Centre de recherche et d'innovation, Talan met l'innovation au cœur de son développement et intervient dans les domaines des mutations technologiques telles que l'Intelligence Artificielle, la Data Intelligence, la Blockchain, pour servir la croissance des grands groupes et des ETI dans une démarche engagée et responsable.

#TalanSuisse





Job Description

Analyser et documenter les données issues de différentes sources et systèmes existants.

Réaliser des analyses exploratoires : profilage, volumétrie, complétude, anomalies, cohérence.

Accompagner les utilisateurs et contribuer à la formalisation des besoins.

Expérience concrète en migration de données.

Bonne compréhension des architectures ETL / Data Warehouse.

Capacité à rédiger des spécifications fonctionnelles et à formaliser des règles de transformation.
Bonne compréhension des problématiques de Data Quality.

ABOUT FORFIRM

FORFIRM is providing solutions to real business challenges for our clients through innovation and deep industry understanding.

We pride ourselves on being a knowledge-based company, with no barriers or pre-built solutions. We listen to our clients and solve their unique problems.

At FORFIRM, we are creating a culture where each person can define their own role parameters and speak their mind without hesitation. We are a true meritocracy, where individual results define each person's career path.

We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated Senior Data Analytics Consultant to join our international team and contribute to strategic data and reporting initiatives for leading Swiss and European organizations.

About The Role

The Senior Data Analytics Consultant will act as a trusted advisor for clients and internal stakeholders, supporting the design and implementation of data-driven solutions that enable effective decision-making and business transformation.

The role combines consulting expertise, data modelling capabilities, advanced SQL development, and Business Intelligence competencies. The selected candidate will lead analytical initiatives, interact directly with business stakeholders and management teams, and contribute to the definition of modern data architectures and reporting frameworks.

Responsibilities

Data Analytics & Consulting


Engage with business stakeholders to understand strategic objectives and analytical requirements.
Translate business needs into scalable data and reporting solutions.
Lead workshops, requirement-gathering sessions, and analytical assessments.
Support clients in defining KPI frameworks and performance measurement models.
Act as a trusted advisor for data-driven decision-making initiatives.


Data Modeling & Data Architecture


Design and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models.
Define dimensional data models (Star Schema and Snowflake Schema) supporting enterprise reporting needs.
Collaborate with Data Engineers and Architects to define scalable analytics architectures.
Support data governance, master data management, and data quality initiatives.
Ensure consistency, integrity, and sustainability of analytical data platforms.


SQL Development & Data Analysis


Develop and optimize complex SQL queries and database objects.
Perform advanced data analysis and profiling activities.
Conduct data reconciliation and root cause investigations.
Analyze large datasets to identify trends, anomalies, risks, and opportunities.
Support data migration and transformation initiatives.


Power BI & Business Intelligence


Design and develop enterprise-grade dashboards and reports using Microsoft Power BI.
Develop advanced DAX calculations, KPIs, measures, and semantic models.
Implement reporting best practices and governance standards.
Support executive reporting and management dashboards.
Ensure performance optimization and scalability of reporting solutions.


Leadership & Project Delivery


Act as senior reference point within client engagements.
Coach and mentor junior consultants and analysts.
Collaborate with project managers in defining scope, timelines, and deliverables.
Contribute to proposal preparation and business development activities.
Support pre-sales initiatives related to Data & Analytics services.


WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?


Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Data Science, or a related discipline.
At least 5 years of professional experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing, or related fields.
Strong expertise in SQL development and relational databases.
Solid experience in conceptual, logical, dimensional, and physical data modeling.
Proven experience designing and developing solutions with Microsoft Power BI.
Strong knowledge of DAX, Power Query, and semantic model design.
Experience interacting directly with business stakeholders and senior management.
Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving capabilities.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Fluent English and Italian.


NICE TO HAVE


Python for data analysis, automation, and data processing.
Microsoft Fabric.
Azure Data Platform.
Data Warehouse architectures.
ETL / ELT frameworks and tools.
Cloud analytics environments.
Banking or Financial Services experience.
Knowledge of Data Governance, Data Quality, and Regulatory Reporting frameworks.


What We Offer


Opportunity to work on strategic and highly visible projects for major Swiss and international clients.
Exposure to complex Data & Analytics transformation programs.
Meritocratic environment with clear career progression opportunities.
Continuous investment in professional development and certifications.
Dynamic, international, and collaborative working environment.
Participation in the growth of FORFIRM's Data & Analytics practice.

Title: Flight Test Data Analyst
Description:
Über uns

Skysec Defence ist ein Schweizer Unternehmen, das sich auf die Entwicklung modernster C-UAS (Counter-Unmanned Aircraft Systems) Lösungen spezialisiert hat.

Mit einem interdisziplinären Team aus Software-, Elektronik-, System- und Entwicklungsingenieuren arbeiten wir an der Spitze der Drohnentechnologie und entwickeln Systeme, die neue Massstäbe in der Luftabwehr setzen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Flight-Testing-Teams suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte und verantwortungsbewusste Persönlichkeit als Flight Test Data Analyst.

Deine Rolle

Du arbeitest direkt mit Daten aus realen Flugversuchen und leistest einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Bewertung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Systeme.

Deine Analysen bilden die Grundlage für nachvollziehbare Testberichte, fundierte technische Entscheidungen und die Verbesserung unserer Systemmodelle. Title: RFP Data Analyst
HTML:
Job Description

The RFP Data Analyst is part of LGT Capital Partners’ Product and Client Solutions (PACS) team in Pfäffikon SZ and plays an active role in both the firm's client engagement activities and its data infrastructure. The successful candidate is expected to start as soon as possible.

The role has a strong focus on data analysis within a client servicing and investor relations context. The successful candidate will work with fund, performance, portfolio and firm-level data that supports RFPs, RFIs, DDQs and other investor-facing materials. This is a role for someone who enjoys working analytically with data, understands the importance of accuracy in client-facing communication, and is able to translate quantitative inputs into clear, reliable and well-structured content.

The person will also help improve the team’s workflows by using AI and other tools to maintain the knowledge base and strengthen content and data processes. A key expectation is that the person acts as a bridge between the data and the wider PACS team, ensuring that analytical inputs are accurate, consistent and suitable for use in external client and investor communication.

As part of the PACS team, the successful candidate will contribute to data-driven client servicing across the following areas:

  • Take ownership of the analytical inputs used in RFPs, RFIs, DDQs and investor materials, including pulling, cross-checking, analyzing and formatting performance, fund, portfolio and firm-level data from multiple sources;
  • Complete RFP, RFI and DDQ processes from prospective and existing clients across private and public markets, working within stated deadlines;
  • Generate high-quality, tailored responses and continuously improve the firm's standard content library;
  • Collaborate directly with business development, investment management and other internal teams to gather inputs and ensure responses reflect LGT CP's current positioning accurately;
  • Act as the link between client-facing teams and the PACS Data team, translating investor relations and client servicing needs into clear data requirements and helping ensure timely, accurate delivery;
  • Operate as a power user of the firm's RFP platform (Responsive), data workflows and AI-assisted tools, contributing to the continuous improvement of data quality, content maintenance, automation and process efficiency.

Requirements

  • University degree in quantitative finance, finance, business analytics, economics or a related field; CFA, CAIA or an equivalent qualification is a plus;
  • Minimum two years of relevant experience in data analysis, ideally within investor relations, RFP/DDQ, product management, or a related function in asset management;
  • Excellent written English; French, German or other languages an asset;
  • Prior exposure to data workflows or digital tools, with eagerness to develop these skills further;
  • Curiosity and confidence in using AI-assisted tools;
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple concurrent deadlines without losing precision and attention to detail;
  • Clear, proactive communicator with the confidence to flag issues and ask clarifying questions across teams;
  • Team-oriented, with a high sense of ownership and follow-through.

What You Can Expect

  • We provide modern working conditions, including work-from-home options, flexible hours and a home office allowance to ensure staff members have a work environment equipped with the latest technology;
  • A diverse culture founded on mutual respect, teamwork and appreciation awaits you at LGT Capital Partners. We go the extra mile to generate impact;
  • We empower and invest in you: your professional development and personal growth are our priority. We offer various internal and external training opportunities that are aligned with your ambitions and our business needs. If you are interested, you can also enhance your German or English language skills;
  • We are proud to be owned by the Princely Family of Liechtenstein and our company is inspired by its entrepreneurial spirit;
  • Commitment to ESG: our approach to business is influenced by the Princely Family’s long-term perspective. Sustainability is key for us and has shaped our actions since 2002;
  • You benefit from favorable terms and conditions if you wish to participate in LGT Capital Partners’ investment programs or to use LGT banking products and services.

Contact Information

If you are interested in becoming an integral part of a successful alternative investment management team in an international, multicultural working environment we will be pleased to get to know you soon.

For further information please contact us.

Cassandra Fritschi

Human Resources

LGT Capital Partners AG, Pfaeffikon

Title: Customer Data Specialist
Description:
Welcome to GenTwo

GenTwo is a global financial engineering company enabling the creation, issuance, and lifecycle management of innovative investment products. With our state-of-the-art platform and securitization infrastructure, we empower financial institutions, asset managers, and professional investors to bring new investment ideas to market faster, more efficiently, and without traditional constraints.

We are a Series-B-stage company with global ambitions, serving clients in more than 25 countries. We value clarity, ownership, and people who thrive in complexity.




Our core values

Stronger Together
Create Clarity
I Own It
Figure It Out




Location: Zurich, Switzerland

Department: CRM & Data Insights

Employment Type: Full-time




Who you are:




As a Customer Data Specialist, you don’t just pull the numbers - you make them worth trusting. You keep CRM data clean, processes well-governed, and every number traceable to its source. You’re comfortable connecting the dots across CRM, GTM systems, and campaign data, and just as confident explaining what the numbers mean to leadership.

If you want to own the data layer that powers how a fast-growing fintech goes to market, let’s talk!




Your tasks & responsibilities:




You turn data into decisions: You analyse campaign performance, conversion rates, pipeline quality, and translate what you find into recommendations people act on.
You build the reporting layer: Dashboards that are accurate, self-refreshing, and built on KPI definitions everyone has agreed to.
You make the business self-sufficient: You resolve advanced reporting requests fast, and reduce the next one through governed self-service, documentation, and a bit of training.
You own CRM: You make sure our workflows meet business needs, and that permissions, integrations, and configurations stay aligned with how the business sells. You're also the first call when something breaks.
You guard data quality: You keep customer acquisition data complete, accurate, and consistent across HubSpot and the tools around it. When something drifts out of line, you spot it early, get to the bottom of it, and fix it with the stakeholders involved, at the source wherever that's possible.
You use AI where it makes sense: You know where AI can simplify repetitive work and improve efficiency, and where it adds unnecessary complexity. You apply it thoughtfully to solve real business problems.




What you bring:




3–5 years in customer analytics, revenue/marketing operations, or BI, ideally in fintech, SaaS, or a similarly fast-moving environment.
Hands-on HubSpot/Salesforce experience, including admin and workflow work.
Strong reporting and analytics skills, including hands-on Power BI experience and working with data across multiple sources, systems, and channels. Familiarity with data warehouse or lakehouse concepts is a plus.
You’re confident working with stakeholders across the business, translating their needs into data solutions and explaining findings in a clear, actionable way.
You already use AI tools in your daily work and are curious about where they go next.
Fluent in English; Swiss work permit or EU/EFTA citizenship required.




What we offer:




A high-impact role in a growing, international fintech - you own the data foundation our entire GTM engine runs on and build it out.
Company-wide AI tooling at your disposal from day one.
Hybrid working with regular home office days.
A central office in the heart of Zurich.




What the process looks like:




If you're still reading, we're guessing you're interested. Here's what happens next:

Send us your application, including your CV, references, and diplomas.
Join an online chat with our People & Culture Manager.
Meet the hiring manager, complete a live case study, and connect with key stakeholders during the final conversations.




Disclaimer: Legitimate recruiting outreach from GenTwo will always come through verified channels. We will never ask candidates to communicate via SMS or WhatsApp.

The role provides analytical leadership across sales performance, profitability, demand planning, inventory optimization and commercial governance.

Working closely with Retail Leadership, Category Managers, Planning teams, Finance, Operations and Digital teams, the role develops the analytical frameworks, dashboards and insights required to optimize assortment, inventory investment and retail performance across the global fleet.

Ship
Boutique
Category
Brand
SK
Itinerary
Guest segment

Sell-through
Gross margin
Inventory productivity
Stock turn
Create automated reporting tools to improve decision speed and visibility.
Support weekly, monthly and seasonal business reviews.

Identify best sellers, slow movers and inventory risks.

Allocation
Replenishment
Stock balancing
Inventory optimization
Support stock shortage prevention and opportunity capture.


Commercial Control & Profitability


Monitor margin performance and identify improvement opportunities.
Support pricing validation and pricing consistency across categories.
Analyze promotional performance and markdown effectiveness.
Support annual budgeting, forecasting and Open-To-Buy (OTB) governance.
Evaluate profitability by:
Category
Brand
Product
Ship
Boutique


Assortment & Category Insights


Provide analytical support to Category Managers for assortment decisions.
Analyze:
Product productivity
SKU contribution
Collection performance
Brand performance
Price architecture
Identify opportunities to improve assortment depth and efficiency.
Support seasonal assortment reviews and buying decisions.


Inventory Productivity


Monitor inventory health across the fleet.
Identify:
Overstock situations
Stock shortages
Obsolete inventory
Low productivity products
Recommend actions to improve inventory return and cash efficiency.
Support markdown and liquidation decisions when required.


Data Management & Tools


Partner with IT and Digital teams to improve retail data availability and reporting capabilities.
Support the development of future retail systems and analytics solutions.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency and governance.
Contribute to the transition from manual Excel-based reporting toward automated analytics.


Cross Functional Collaboration


Work closely with:
Head of Forecast, Budget and Analytics
Category Managers
Retail Operations
Merchandise Planning
Finance
Supply Chain
IT / Digital teams
Act as a trusted analytical partner supporting commercial decisions


Your Journey so far


5–10 years of experience in retail analytics, merchandise planning, business intelligence or commercial performance.
Experience in luxury retail, fashion, travel retail or multi-store environments.
Strong experience analyzing sales, inventory and profitability data.
Experience building dashboards and performance reporting frameworks.
Experience with retail planning systems, BI tools and advanced Excel.


Your Essentials


Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
Excellent understanding of retail business drivers and commercial KPIs.
Ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations.
Strong understanding of inventory management and merchandise planning principles.
Advanced Excel skills and experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau or equivalent).
Strong communication skills and ability to influence stakeholders.
Business-oriented mindset with attention to operational details.
Ability to work in a fast-moving international environment.
Fluent English; additional languages are an advantage.


Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!
