Title: Sales Analyst
Description:
We are seeking a motivated Sales Analyst to join our growing team in the Sales Department. This role is ideal for young individuals who are interested in sustainable energy, data analysis, and commercial development. You will support the sales team by analyzing market trends, customer data, pricing conditions, and sales performance to drive data-backed decision-making.

Main Duties And Responsibilities


Assist in collecting, organizing, and analyzing sales data, customer profiles, and market insights.
Conduct thorough research and monitor biofuel market trends, including pricing, supply-demand indicators, regulatory changes, and competitor activities.
Prepare regular reports, dashboards, and presentations to support sales planning and forecasting.
Support sales managers with customer quotations, pricing analysis, and contract administrative tasks.
Identify and profile key stakeholders in the biofuel ecosystem, including airlines, aircraft manufacturers, government agencies, and environmental organizations.
Stay updated on biofuel-related regulations, incentives, and policies that may impact the market and customer behavior.
Work closely with cross-functional teams (operations, logistics, finance) to ensure data accuracy and timely information flow.
Prepare and present research findings, insights, and recommendations to internal stakeholders, including management and product development teams.
Assist in developing CRM updates, pipeline tracking, and sales performance metrics.
Participate in ad hoc analysis and projects to support commercial strategy.


Qualifications And Requirements


Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Data Science, Environmental Science, Energy Management, or related disciplines.
Strong analytical and numerical skills with the ability to interpret data effectively.
Proficiency in Excel; familiarity with data tools (e.g., Power BI, SQL, or CRM systems) is an advantage.
Interest in renewable fuel, sustainability principles, or commodities markets is highly preferred.
Good communication skills and ability to present findings clearly.
Detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to learn.
A passion for environmental sustainability and a commitment to reducing greenhouse gas emissions in the aviation sector.
Fresh graduates are welcome; relevant internship experience is a plus.

Les Services industriels de la Ville de Lausanne (SIL) proposent une palette complète de prestations multifluides qui répondent aux défis d'une société en constante mutation dans le respect de la durabilité et des engagements climatiques. Reconnus comme prestataire de référence sur nos zones de distribution, nous plaçons notre clientèle au centre de nos préoccupations. Ouverts aux changements, nous travaillons ensemble pour l'atteinte d'objectifs communs.




Afin de compléter notre équipe, nous sommes à la recherche d'une ou d'un spécialiste Business Intelligence (BI). Dans ce rôle, vous concevez, mettez en place et faites évoluer des solutions BI à partir des outils disponibles afin de répondre aux besoins métiers liés aux systèmes commerciaux SAP CRM et SAP IS-U. Vous garantissez la qualité, la pertinence et la disponibilité des données, ainsi que leur mise à disposition pour d'autres systèmes, en veillant à leur adéquation avec les besoins fonctionnels.




Vous souhaitez rejoindre une entreprise axée sur le développement durable, l'innovation et la qualité? Rejoignez-nous! Nous vous offrons un poste de travail varié dans un environnement dynamique et collaboratif, une flexibilité du temps de travail, ainsi que des prestations sociales de qualité.




Lieu de travail: Place Chauderon 25, 1003 Lausanne




Missions

Assurer le bon fonctionnement et le suivi des demandes d'évolution BI liées aux systèmes commerciaux SAP CRM et SAP IS-U, en analysant les besoins, les solutions possibles et leurs impacts sur les outils de reporting et les processus internes
Analyser les besoins BI et de mise à disposition des données, puis coordonner l'élaboration, la mise en oeuvre et le suivi des projets liés aux systèmes commerciaux, notamment en formalisant les exigences métier, en validant les spécifications et en assurant les tests et la mise en production
Concevoir, mettre en forme et faire évoluer les indicateurs, rapports et tableaux de bord de la division Administration des ventes à l'aide des outils BI disponibles, notamment Power BI, Tableau, SAP BI et SAP Analysis
Modéliser et optimiser les données utilisées dans les rapports, définir les processus d'extraction, de transformation et de chargement des données et contribuer à l'automatisation du reporting en collaboration avec l'IT
Gérer le support opérationnel des demandes BI de la section OSM (Outils, Systèmes et Méthodes), notamment les demandes d'extraction de données, le conseil expert et le diagnostic d'anomalies, en garantissant un traitement autonome, priorisé et de qualité
Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des processus et solutions BI du Service commercial, renforcer l'autonomie des utilisateurs et participer aux activités opérationnelles de la section OSM




Profil

Master HES en management/informatique ou formation équivalente
Formation complémentaire en conduite de projets
5 ans d'expérience dans une entreprise de type utilities, dans la gestion d'un système de reporting BI
Bonnes connaissances des solutions BI au sein d'un environnement SAP (SAP IS-U, SAP SD, SAP FI-CA, SAP BW et SAP CRM)
Capacité à travailler en autonomie et à prendre des initiatives, orientation résultats, précision et rigueur
Excellent esprit d'analyse et de synthèse, capacité à piloter ou superviser des projets, créativité et aisance dans la communication
Maîtrise des outils Microsoft Office, de SharePoint et Visio ou produits similaires, ainsi que d'un système de gestion et de traitement des demandes tel que Jira




Taux d'activité 80-100%




Classe salariale 10




Entrée en fonction De suite ou à convenir




Renseignements M. Pol Mas Soro, responsable de la section OSM, 021 315 81 24




Postulation

Merci de nous envoyer votre candidature et les documents habituels jusqu'au 16.10.2026 via le formulaire en ligne. En cas d'impossibilité, vous pouvez contacter directement le service au 021 315 87 14.

Title: Analytics & Insights Manager
Description:
Join our dynamic corporate team and become part of Aman Group. With offices strategically located around the world (Zug, London, Dubai, Singapore, Bangkok, Miami and New York), our corporate colleagues are at the forefront of driving innovation and excellence for our ultra-luxury brand.

Role:

We are seeking an Analytics & Insights Manager reporting to the Director of Analytics & Insights. Based in our Baar, Switzerland corporate office you will lead data analysis, reporting, and dashboarding across the business. This role will transform complex data into actionable insights, oversee end-to-end data processes, and ensure accuracy across core systems. You will partner closely with cross-functional teams to align on KPIs, support strategic decision-making, and foster a strong data-driven culture.

Responsibilities:


Oversee daily data ingestion, synchronization, and validation processes across internal (CRM, PMS, Finance) and external data sources (vendors, partners, market feeds)
Ensure all data pipelines and manual uploads are executed accurately and on schedule
Coordinate with Data Engineering to troubleshoot data discrepancies, failed loads, or system mismatches
Collaborate with Data Engineering to ensure data readiness, consistency, and governance across CRM, PMS, and ancillary systems
Validate and maintain the integrity of datasets, ensuring alignment with enterprise data standards and with data privacy / compliance / governance requirements
Conduct deep-dive analyses and develop predictive models (e.g., seasonality, demand forecasting, pricing performance, customer engagement)
Partner with global and regional stakeholders to define and maintain standardized KPIs (e.g., occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, GOP, channel mix)
Own the end-to-end development of dashboards and reporting frameworks in PBI for hotel performance across regions
Ensure metrics for business performance are defined, measured, and maintained consistently across teams to support scalability and transparency
Partner with Commercial and Operations teams to identify performance drivers and opportunities across markets, lines of business, and properties Translate recurring requirements of commercial and operational teams into automated, self-service dashboards
Deliver actionable insights on revenue trends, booking behaviour and operational efficiency


Requirements:


Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Economics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field
6 -8 years of experience in customer analytics, data science, or business intelligence, preferably within luxury hospitality, travel, or consumer sectors
Demonstrated expertise in predictive modelling and business analysis
Proficiency in SQL and Power BI required; experience with Python, R, or statistical modeling tools preferred
Experience with DBT, GitHub and Snowflake
Experience integrating data from CRM, PMS, and external sources
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to communicate insights to senior stakeholders
Deep understanding of data governance, privacy compliance, and analytical best practices


Benefits

At Aman Group, we believe our colleagues are at the core of our success. We offer competitive benefits, including exciting global career opportunities within a rapidly expanding company. We prioritize and support your professional journey, ensuring you feel valued, included, and at home.

If you are passionate about attracting exceptional talent and creating a positive experience for every candidate, we invite you to apply to join us on our journey.

Title: FP&A Analyst, Program/ portfolio Controlling & Data Analytics (h/f/x) 80-100%
Description:
Employeur solide et tourné vers l’avenir, la Vaudoise figure parmi les assureurs leaders en Suisse. Fidèle à sa nature coopérative et à ses valeurs, elle favorise un environnement de travail sain, inclusif et inspirant, propice au développement des talents.

Afin de renforcer notre Direction Finance, nous recherchons un ou une FP&A Analyst, Program/ portfolio Controlling & Data Analytics (h/f/x) 80-100%.

Dans cette fonction à double dimension, vous agissez d'une part comme partenaire financier au quotidien, en étroite collaboration avec la Lead Program Controlling pour piloter le portefeuille de transformation. D'autre part, vous contribuez également au développement d’outils de reporting, de modélisation et de scénarisation destinés à l’ensemble de l’unité FP&A, Controlling & Performance.

La répartition entre ces deux dimensions évoluera en fonction des priorités. Ce poste s’adresse donc à une personne flexible, capable d’alterner naturellement entre une collaboration en binôme et des projets transverses.

Vos Missions

﻿ Développer les capacités Data Analytics et Reporting de l’unité

Vous contribuez au développement des outils et méthodes permettant d’améliorer la qualité des analyses et la prise de décision financière.


Concevoir, développer et faire évoluer les tableaux de bord Power BI
Automatiser les productions et reportings récurrents
Développer des modèles d’analyse et de scénarisation (« what-if »)
Exploiter les outils d’intelligence artificielle pour accélérer certaines analyses (détection d’anomalies, commentaires automatisés, analyses exploratoires)
Garantir la fiabilité des données, la documentation des modèles et la traçabilité des règles de gestion
Contribuer à la diffusion des bonnes pratiques Data & Analytics au sein de l’unité


Accompagner le pilotage économique du portefeuille de transformation

En binôme avec la Lead Program Controlling, vous participez au pilotage financier des initiatives de transformation.


Construire les Business Cases des projets de transformation
Modéliser les gains attendus et les hypothèses financières
Définir les KPI et les baselines de référence
Assurer le suivi de la création de valeur et analyser les écarts observés
Contribuer aux projections budgétaires et aux exercices de forecast
Préparer les analyses et la documentation à destination des instances de gouvernance


Votre Profil

Une solide expérience en FP&A et contrôle de gestion


Expérience significative en FP&A et dans les processus financiers
5 à 8 ans d'expérience professionnelle au total
Solides connaissances en budget, forecast, business case, ROI et pilotage de la performance
Excellentes capacités d'analyse et de modélisation financière
Diplôme universitaire ou HES en finance, contrôle de gestion, économie d'entreprise ou domaine connexe
Une expérience préalable en Program Controlling n'est pas requise ; vous développerez progressivement cette expertise au sein de l'équipe.


Une forte sensibilité Data & Analytics


Excellente maîtrise de Power BI (Power Query, DAX)
Bonnes connaissances en SQL et en modélisation de données
Solides compétences en Excel avancé et en analyses de scénarios « what-if »
Expérience concrète de l'utilisation d'outils d'intelligence artificielle dans l'analyse de données
Sensibilité marquée à la qualité, à la traçabilité et à la gouvernance des données
La connaissance de Python et de Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations constitue un atout.


Excellente maîtrise du français ; bonne maîtrise de l'anglais (B2 minimum) ; l'allemand constitue un atout.

Vous savez prendre du recul sur une problématique métier avant de vous lancer dans l'analyse et faites preuve de rigueur, d'esprit critique et de synthèse. À l'aise dans un environnement en évolution, vous appréciez autant le travail en binôme que la collaboration avec des interlocuteurs variés, tout en sachant vulgariser des sujets techniques et partager vos connaissances.

Nous vous offrons


Un poste à fort impact, à la croisée du pilotage de la performance, de la transformation et de la Data Analytics
L'opportunité de contribuer activement au développement des capacités Data & Analytics de la Finance et d'évoluer vers un rôle de référent dans ce domaine
Un environnement de travail sain au sein d'une entreprise mutualiste certifiée « Great Place to Work »
Une grande flexibilité dans l'organisation du travail ainsi que des avantages sociaux attractifs
Une culture d'entreprise fondée sur la confiance, la collaboration et le bien-être des collaborateurs
Un accompagnement dans votre développement professionnel grâce à des opportunités de formation et d'apprentissage continu


Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre dossier de candidature complet par voie digitale (CV, lettre de motivation, copie des certificats de travail et diplômes).

Title: Marketing Analytics Specialist 100% (f/m/d)
Description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Julius Baer is the leading Swiss private banking group and a premium brand in global wealth management with a focus on servicing and advising sophisticated private clients. In order to strengthen our leading position and shape the future of wealth management, both a comprehensive range of first-class solutions and committed teams behind them are essential. We therefore celebrate and value the individual qualities of our employees, enabling them to be entrepreneurial and empowered to create value beyond wealth.

Brand & Marketing power our firm's short- and long-term success by positioning, promoting and protecting our unique brand. We design intuitive digital user journeys, enhanced by data-driven insights, and produce impactful content through website, publications and social media, showcasing Julius Baer's outstanding investment expertise and offering. Our global client engagement initiatives, backed by unified standards and scalable tools, deliver meaningful experiences and drive measurable business impact.

Within the Digital Channels & Analytics team, we are looking for a Marketing Analytics Specialist who is passionate about delivering data-driven marketing insights and continuous improvements to our marketing measurement capabilities.

YOUR CHALLENGE

In your role, you will:


Analyse impact-generating customer journeys across public digital touchpoints to identify trends, behavioural patterns, and optimisation opportunities
Monitor and analyse marketing touchpoint and provide actionable recommendations to improve engagement and conversion outcomes
Create recurring reports, dashboards, and automated reporting solutions using Adobe Analytics, Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery), and related data sources
Consolidate and integrate data from multiple digital and offline marketing channels to create a holistic view of marketing performance and customer engagement
Translate datasets into business recommendations, tailored to operational teams, marketing stakeholders, and senior leadership
Support data validation and (A/B) testing activities
Partner with stakeholders across internal and external stakeholders to define KPIs, measurement approaches, and reporting requirements
Collaborate closely with the Data Specialist to leverage and continuously enhance data quality, measurement standards, tracking concepts, and analytics capabilities
Serve as the first-level technical support for analytics tools and dashboards (Tableau, Power BI, Adobe) within Brand & Marketing


YOUR PROFILE


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Analytics, Statistics, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field
2-3 years of experience in marketing analytics or a similar analytical role
Experience analysing marketing performance and impact across digital and offline marketing channels
Experience in dashboard development and data visualisation, using Tableau and Power BI
Working knowledge of SQL and experience with cloud-based data platforms such as Adobe Analytics and BigQuery. Python is a plus
Understanding marketing objectives, A/B testing, conversion funnels, customer journey analytics, and marketing performance measurement
Familiarity with AI-powered analytics, automation, and self-service reporting solutions is an advantage
Experience working with Scrum methodology and tools such as Jira
Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly and translate data into practical business recommendations
Excellent written and spoken German and English


Mindset & Skills:


Curious and eager to learn new technologies, analytics methodologies, automation approaches, and AI-supported capabilities
Passionate about data, user behaviour, marketing performance, and emerging analytics technologies
Structured and detail-oriented working style with a strong focus on quality and accuracy
Hands-on mentality with the ability to independently drive dashboarding and analytical tasks
Strong communication and stakeholder collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across teams and explain analytical findings
Ability to balance technical implementation with business needs and user experience
Strong business acumen and a practical understanding of marketing funnels and performance measurement

Title: Client Data & Insights Manager
Description:
CLIENT DATA & INSIGHTS MANAGER

CDI

Plan-les-Ouates

For Those Who Seek Excellence

Join one of the most respected Maisons in fine watchmaking where excellence is both a given and a never-ending quest. Play your part in driving our collective success.

YOUR ROLE

We are seeking a Client Data & Insights Manager who is responsible for driving the global client engagement strategy through rigorous data governance, disciplined performance monitoring and cross-functional collaboration.

This role ensures that client data is transformed into actionable insights to support business growth, client development, and CRM excellence across markets.

PLAYING YOUR PART

Client Data Management


You will track and analyze key KPIs to monitor performance across markets and support client engagement growth
You will translate business insights into data-driven action plans
You will support markets in implementing client development strategies based on insights
You will develop and maintain dashboards to ensure clear data performance visibility tailored for retail teams and top management
You will supervise client segmentation and scoring methodologies
You will ensure the highest standards of data governance and compliance
You will support retail teams in embedding a strong client data culture


Database Quality & Targeting


You will Ensure a healthy, compliant, and actionable client database at all times
You will monitor data quality, completeness, and enrichment across markets
You will drive continuous improvement in targeting accuracy
You will ensure relevant targeting strategies for campaigns, in close collration with the client team
You will support retail teams in embedding a strong client data culture


Client Performance Governance


You will manage and track requests through a centralized ticketing system
You will ensure proper prioritization and resolution of data, CRM, and reporting requests
You will standardize KPI frameworks and reporting methodologies
You will strengthen executive visibility on client performance globally


Group Interface & Cross-functional Collaboration


You will act as key contact for client data topics with the Group
You will ensure alignment with Group frameworks, tools, and reporting standards
You will collaborate closely with Regions, Marketing, Retail, Commercial, CS and key maison stakeholders to fuel business growth
You will promote best practice sharing across markets


WHAT WILL MAKE YOU SUCCESSFUL?

Success In This Role Will Require


A solid experience in client analytics, CRM, or data-driven environments
An expertise in CRM ecosystems (Salesforce, a plus) and understanding of database management and data quality principles
Ability to operate in a complex, international matrix organization, with a high level of precision and business acumen
Ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex insights effectively
Solution approach and client-centric mindset with attention to detail
Adaptability and agility, Collaborative and Team spirit
Fluency in English and French


Vacheron Constantin celebrates 270 years as the world’s oldest watchmaker in continuous production since 1755. Headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, we operate a global retail network of nearly 200 points of sale across 36 countries. Every member of our exceptional global community of watchmakers, artisans and dedicated professionals share a common devotion to our exceptional heritage and a passion to trailblaze an even brighter future.

If this fires your imagination, we welcome your application.

Title: Data Scientist / Analyst/-in II
Description:
Zimmerwald BE | 80-100% (Jobsharing möglich)

Diesen Beitrag kannst du leisten


Kommunikationsdaten gemäss sicherheitspolitischen Zielsetzungen auf ihre Relevanz prüfen und inhaltlich analysieren
Analyseergebnisse mit Informationen aus öffentlich zugänglichen Quellen anreichern
Gewonnene Erkenntnisse in Form von schriftlichen Berichten aufbereiten
Zugewiesene Dossiers selbständig bearbeiten und proaktiv weiterentwickeln
Optimierung bestehender sowie Erarbeitung neuer Prozesse, Methoden und Analysetechniken aktiv mitgestalten


Das macht dich einzigartig


Hochschulabschluss oder vergleichbare höhere Ausbildung
Ausgeprägtes analytisches Denken und überdurchschnittliche redaktionelle Fähigkeiten
Besonderes Interesse an sicherheitspolitischen Fragestellungen sowie Streitkräften im ostasiatischen Raum
Hohes Verständnis für technische Zusammenhänge und Kompetenzen im Bereich Cyber, Telekommunikation, Informatik und/oder Data Science
Gute aktive Kenntnisse einer zweiten Amtssprache und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse; Sprachkenntnisse in Mandarin (B2–C1) sind von Vorteil


Auf den Punkt gebracht

Du arbeitest selbstständig in einem Analyseteam an vorgegebenen Themenbereichen. Du hilfst mit, in einem dynamischen Umfeld aus Kommunikationsdaten nachrichtendienstlich relevante Erkenntnisse zugunsten der Sicherheitspolitik der Schweiz zu gewinnen. Du arbeitest gewissenhaft, hast Freude daran, dich in neue Technologien einzuarbeiten, und behältst auch in hektischen Zeiten den Überblick. Die Anstellung ist befristet vom 1. Januar bis zum 30. Juni 2027.

Das bieten wir


Arbeiten für die Schweiz Wir setzen uns für das Erfolgsmodell Schweiz ein und arbeiten zum Wohl der Bevölkerung.
Gelebte Vielfalt Dank Chancengleichheit entfalten wir unsere Kompetenzen und bringen unterschiedliche Perspektiven ein.
Gesund am Arbeitsplatz Wir unterstützen und beraten unsere Mitarbeitenden im Bereich der physischen und psychischen Gesundheit.


Alle Benefits

Dein Einsatz für Sicherheit und Freiheit

Das Kommando Cyber (Kdo Cy) steht für Kompetenz in den Bereichen Cyber und Digitalisierung. Wir vereinen die Begeisterung für unsere Aufgabe mit Know-how, Innovation, modernsten Technologien und agilen Arbeitsweisen. Wir erbringen sichere, robuste und resiliente Informatikleistungen für die Schweizer Armee und unsere Partner im Sicherheitsverbund Schweiz. Damit ermöglicht das Kdo Cy der Schweizer Armee den notwendigen Wissens- und Entscheidvorsprung – für eine sichere Schweiz. Die Schweizer Armee beschäftigt über 9'000 Mitarbeitende in vier militärischen und rund 200 zivilen Berufen – und dies an 110 Standorten schweizweit. Auch für den Nachwuchs ist gesorgt: Die Schweizer Armee bildet in über 30 Berufen Lernende aus.

Zusätzliche Informationen

Eine Anstellung bei der Schweizer Armee macht Sinn und bringt viele Vorteile mit sich. Überzeuge dich auf armee.ch/vorteile. Angebote von Personalvermittlern werden nicht berücksichtigt. Title: Revenue Management Analyst
Description:
MSC Mediterranean Shipping Company is a global business engaged in the shipping sector. Present in 155 countries, MSC facilitates international trade between the world’s major economies, and among emerging markets across all continents. Headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, since 1978, MSC is a privately-owned organisation driven by the Aponte family.




Today, we continue to focus on caring for customers, employees and the environment.

From a one-vessel operation to a globally respected business we have an unfaltering commitment to people that have passion, creativity and willing to make a change. Do you recognize yourself?

Then come work with us and be part of MSC’s family.




YOUR IMPACT




Strategic Analysis and Benchmarking of MSC Trade Revenues (Sea and Land)




Lead the comprehensive analysis of MSC trade revenues across sea and land identifying key trends, market conditions, and performance indicators.
Develop and oversee the implementation of benchmarking methodologies to compare MSC’s performance against industry standards and competitors.
Provide strategic insights and recommendations to management based on revenue analysis to drive decision-making and strategic planning.




Reporting and Insights Communication to Senior Management




Synthesize complex data and analysis into clear, actionable insights for the Liner in charge, presenting findings in a compelling and easy-to-understand manner.
Prepare and deliver high-level presentations to senior management, highlighting critical findings, potential risks, and strategic opportunities.
Ensure continuous improvement in reporting processes and the quality of insights provided to management.




Special Conditions (THC, Local Charges, Demurrage)




Analyze special conditions (THC, local charges, demurrage) granted to customers and address the outcome to liners.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to evaluate the financial impact of special conditions on customers and its profitability.
Develop strategic recommendations for adjustments to special conditions to optimize revenue.




Monthly KPI and Performance Analysis Reporting




Establish a robust framework for the preparation and presentation of monthly KPIs and performance analysis to management and liners.
Ensure the accuracy, relevance, and timeliness of KPI reports, highlighting key performance metrics and trends.
Lead continuous enhancement of KPI reporting tools and techniques to provide deeper insights and support strategic decision-making.




Ad-Hoc Analysis and Strategic Support




Lead the execution of ad-hoc analysis requests from Management and Liners Department, ensuring high-quality and timely deliverables.
Act as a strategic advisor to senior management, providing expert analysis and recommendations on a wide range of business issues.
Foster a culture of data-driven decision-making within the organization, promoting the use of analytics and insights in strategic planning and operations.




Stakeholder Engagement and Collaboration

Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across the organization, ensuring alignment and collaboration on strategic initiatives.
Represent the analytics function in cross-functional meetings and projects, providing expert insights and contributing to the achievement of business objectives.




YOUR BACKGROUND




Degree in Finance or Business Management or alternatively Maritime background.
8 -10 years of experience in a similar role.
Shipping experience is mandatory.
Commercial acumen is a strong asset.
Advanced Excel skills.
Strong analytical skills.
Work accuracy and precision.
Team player with strong communication skills.
Excellent command of English and French, both written and spoken.
Ability to work under pressure and within short deadlines.
Transversal thinking and accuracy.




CONTRACT DETAILS




Based in Geneva.
Full Time.
Permanent Role.
EU citizenship or valid Swiss work permit is required.

Title: Analytics & Technology Specialist (80 - 100%)
Description:
Do you want to help shape the future of market surveillance through advanced analytics, technology and data-driven decision making?

Surveillance Assurance & Development (SAD) is responsible for the continuous enhancement of surveillance capabilities supporting SIX Exchange Regulation's mission to detect market abuse and rule violations, including insider trading, market and price manipulation. SAD acts as the bridge between market surveillance, business stakeholders and IT, driving the evolution of surveillance systems, analytical models and technologies while ensuring their effectiveness and quality.

As an Analytics & Technology Specialist, you will play a key role in developing and improving surveillance methodologies, alert logic and analytical solutions. You will work closely with Markets Supervision & Investigations (MSI) and IT to assess new opportunities, evaluate the effectiveness of existing controls and identify innovative approaches to strengthen market surveillance.

The role combines advanced analytics, statistics, surveillance expertise and technology. You will contribute to the design and evolution of surveillance scenarios, assess the impact of new requirements, and leverage advanced analytics, statistical methods, artificial intelligence and data science techniques to enhance surveillance effectiveness. At the same time, you will help ensure continuity of key surveillance solutions while supporting the ongoing transformation towards a cloud-based technology landscape.

 

What You Will Do  
Ensure continuity of selected surveillance solutions, data assets and technical processes currently maintained by the departing Data Engineer, while supporting the gradual transition of some responsibilities to IT.
Analyse, review and enhance market surveillance alerts, detection methodologies, scenarios, parameters and thresholds, applying advanced analytics, statistical methods and AI/ML techniques to improve surveillance effectiveness.
Assess the impact of new features, business requirements and regulatory changes on surveillance processes and systems, and identify required enhancements.
Evaluate new surveillance approaches, anomaly detection techniques and emerging technologies, contributing to the evolution of market surveillance capabilities.
Translate surveillance and business requirements into technical specifications and implementation concepts, and collaborate closely with business and IT teams throughout design, testing and implementation.
What You Bring 
University degree in Finance, Economics, Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science or a related field. 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including experience with statistical analysis, anomaly detection and model evaluation, combined with the ability to assess and improve analytical models, alert calibration and detection methodologies.
Strong SQL and Python skills and experience analysing large datasets, ideally using modern analytics platforms such as Azure, Databricks, Spark/PySpark. Knowledge of AI-assisted analytics tools and techniques is considered an advantage.
Experience in financial markets, market surveillance or transaction reporting is considered a strong asset. 
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and IT functions. 
Fluent in English (both verbal & writing), German is a plus.

Title: Underwriting Portfolio Analyst - Motor & Haushalt (m/w/d)
Description:
136760 | 70 - 100% | Oerlikon, Zürich | Hybrid

Möchtest du das Portfolio Management von morgen mitgestalten? Bei uns verwandelst du Daten gemeinsam im Team in echte Erkenntnisse – und entwickelst mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern Lösungen, die unser Geschäft wirklich voranbringen.

Als Underwriting Portfolio Analyst – Motor & Haushalt bist du Teil des Geschäftsbereichs P&C Underwriting im Team Portfolio Management und gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung von Zurich Schweiz aktiv mit. Dabei bringst du deine Fähigkeiten ein, um gemeinsam mit uns aus Daten wertvolle Einblicke zu gewinnen und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Underwriting-Strategien zu unterstützen. Du verbindest analytisches Denken mit deinem Wissen über den Markt und unsere Produkte, um zusammen mit dem Team fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen und unser Portfolio optimal zu steuern. Im engen Austausch mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus verschiedenen Bereichen gestaltest du strategische Initiativen aktiv mit und trägst so dazu bei, unser Portfolio nachhaltig weiterzuentwickeln.

Das erwartet dich


Du bringst deine analytischen Fähigkeiten und dein Wissen über den Markt und Nichtlebensversicherungsprodukte ein, um gemeinsam mit verschiedenen Teams Lösungen zu entwickeln und das Privatkundenportfolio zu steuern
Du analysierst unser Versicherungsportfolio im Detail und identifizierst im Austausch mit anderen gezielt Optimierungsmöglichkeiten
Du entwickelst und implementierst gemeinsam mit deinem Team Methoden und Tools, die die Portfolio-Analyse und -Optimierung voranbringen
Du unterstützt die Definition und Erstellung von Metriken, KPIs und Dashboards, um die datenbasierte Steuerung der Abteilung im Team zu stärken
Du gewinnst wertvolle Erkenntnisse aus Daten und nutzt diese, um gemeinsam die Underwriting-Strategie weiterzuentwickeln und die gesetzten Ziele zu erreichen


Das zeichnet dich aus


Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium in Wirtschafts- oder Naturwissenschaften, Mathematik, Statistik, Data Science oder (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, oder gleichwertige Berufserfahrung in der Versicherungswirtschaft
Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Nichtlebensversicherungsgeschäft, idealerweise in Portfolioanalyse oder Produktmanagement, sowie tiefes Verständnis der wichtigsten Werttreiber und Steuerungs-Kennzahlen (KPIs); ergänzende Erfahrung im Underwriting willkommen
Ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten, hohe Präsentationsstärke sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Analysen klar zu strukturieren und adressatengerecht für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufzubereiten
Sicherer Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken, grossen Datenmengen und mindestens einer Programmiersprache (z.B. SQL oder Python), Erfahrung in der Aufbereitung von Daten für fundierte Business-Entscheidungen; aktuarielles Wissen von Vorteil
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Arbeitsort: Oerlikon, Zürich

Title: LPG Analyst
Description:
As an LPG Analyst to support our global oil trading team, providing in-depth market analysis, building and updating supply and demand models, providing value-add market insights, and analyzing high-frequency indicators of market dynamics. The role is based in Geneva, Switzerland.

Key Responsibilities

Collating, analysing and interpreting data to produce commodity market insights

Conduct comprehensive research and analysis on fuel oil markets, including supply/demand dynamics, pricing trends, arbitrage opportunities, and regulatory developments across major global trading hubs

Build and maintaining supply and demand models, and develop detailed market reports, presentations, and trade recommendations to inform trading strategies

Provide trade flow analysis and other ad-hoc analysis to support decision-making by senior traders and management

Collaborate closely with traders, operations teams, and other analysts to identify trading opportunities, monitor positions, and manage risk exposure

Build and maintain proprietary models and tools for market analysis, forecasting, and scenario planning.

Stay up-to-date on industry news, market intelligence, and competitor activities to provide a competitive edge

Establish strong relationships with key market participants, including refiners, suppliers, and customers, to gather market intelligence.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a related quantitative field;

Minimum of 4 years of experience in commodity analysis or a related analytical role, preferably with exposure to fuel oil/refined products markets

Prior experience in commodity research, specifically in LPG analytics

Strong quantitative and analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex data sets and extract meaningful insights

Experience using trade data, data visualization tools and statistical data modeling software.

Proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., Python, R, SQL) and Microsoft Office suite.

Knowledge of commodity trading fundamentals, risk management principles, and financial modeling

Fluency in English

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced educational degree

Fluency in another foreign language

Programming experience and a solid understanding of database concepts (Python and SQL preferred; R, MATLAB or VBA beneficial).

Direct knowledge of LPG markets

Attributes for success

Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely

Strong intrinsic interest in financial markets, geopolitical developments and a sound understanding of economic theory and cycles

Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Ability to work independently and proactively to deliver timely results.

Analytical mindset and critical thinking skills, with an emphasis on providing proactive insights that have tradeable value.

Work Authorization:

We welcome applications from candidates across the globe. Relocation support and visa sponsorship details will be discussed during the hiring process.

Reporting Structure

- Reporting directly to Head of Oil Research Europe & Asia

Title: Sales Analyst
Description:
We are seeking a motivated Sales Analyst to join our growing team in the Sales Department. This role is ideal for young individuals who are interested in sustainable energy, data analysis, and commercial development. You will support the sales team by analyzing market trends, customer data, pricing conditions, and sales performance to drive data-backed decision-making.

Main Duties And Responsibilities


Assist in collecting, organizing, and analyzing sales data, customer profiles, and market insights.
Conduct thorough research and monitor biofuel market trends, including pricing, supply-demand indicators, regulatory changes, and competitor activities.
Prepare regular reports, dashboards, and presentations to support sales planning and forecasting.
Support sales managers with customer quotations, pricing analysis, and contract administrative tasks.
Identify and profile key stakeholders in the biofuel ecosystem, including airlines, aircraft manufacturers, government agencies, and environmental organizations.
Stay updated on biofuel-related regulations, incentives, and policies that may impact the market and customer behavior.
Work closely with cross-functional teams (operations, logistics, finance) to ensure data accuracy and timely information flow.
Prepare and present research findings, insights, and recommendations to internal stakeholders, including management and product development teams.
Assist in developing CRM updates, pipeline tracking, and sales performance metrics.
Participate in ad hoc analysis and projects to support commercial strategy.


Qualifications And Requirements


Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Data Science, Environmental Science, Energy Management, or related disciplines.
Strong analytical and numerical skills with the ability to interpret data effectively.
Proficiency in Excel; familiarity with data tools (e.g., Power BI, SQL, or CRM systems) is an advantage.
Interest in renewable fuel, sustainability principles, or commodities markets is highly preferred.
Good communication skills and ability to present findings clearly.
Detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to learn.
A passion for environmental sustainability and a commitment to reducing greenhouse gas emissions in the aviation sector.
Fresh graduates are welcome; relevant internship experience is a plus.

Title: Retail Business Analytics Manager
Description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Retail Business Analytics Manager is responsible for transforming retail data into actionable business insights that improve commercial performance, inventory productivity and decision-making across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

The role provides analytical leadership across sales performance, profitability, demand planning, inventory optimization and commercial governance.

Working closely with Retail Leadership, Category Managers, Planning teams, Finance, Operations and Digital teams, the role develops the analytical frameworks, dashboards and insights required to optimize assortment, inventory investment and retail performance across the global fleet.

The position acts as a strategic business partner, enabling data-driven decisions and continuous improvement across all retail categories

Your Impact

Business Performance Analytics


Develop and maintain retail performance dashboards covering sales, margin, inventory and productivity indicators.
Provide regular performance analysis by:
Ship
Boutique
Category
Brand
SK
Itinerary
Guest segment
Identify commercial opportunities and performance gaps.
Translate data into clear recommendations and action plans for Retail Leadership and Category teams.


KPI Framework & Reporting


Define and improve the global retail KPI framework, including:
Sales performance
Conversion rate
Average Transaction Value (ATV)
Units Per Transaction (UPT)
Sales per square meter / selling space
Sell-through
Gross margin
Inventory productivity
Stock turn
Create automated reporting tools to improve decision speed and visibility.
Support weekly, monthly and seasonal business reviews.


Demand & Inventory Analytics


Support demand forecasting by SKU, ship, boutique and geographic area.
Analyze sales trends, seasonality, itinerary impact and guest behavior to improve forecasts.
Identify best sellers, slow movers and inventory risks.
Provide recommendations for:
Allocation
Replenishment
Stock balancing
Inventory optimization
Support stock shortage prevention and opportunity capture.


Commercial Control & Profitability


Monitor margin performance and identify improvement opportunities.
Support pricing validation and pricing consistency across categories.
Analyze promotional performance and markdown effectiveness.
Support annual budgeting, forecasting and Open-To-Buy (OTB) governance.
Evaluate profitability by:
Category
Brand
Product
Ship
Boutique


Assortment & Category Insights


Provide analytical support to Category Managers for assortment decisions.
Analyze:
Product productivity
SKU contribution
Collection performance
Brand performance
Price architecture
Identify opportunities to improve assortment depth and efficiency.
Support seasonal assortment reviews and buying decisions.


Inventory Productivity


Monitor inventory health across the fleet.
Identify:
Overstock situations
Stock shortages
Obsolete inventory
Low productivity products
Recommend actions to improve inventory return and cash efficiency.
Support markdown and liquidation decisions when required.


Data Management & Tools


Partner with IT and Digital teams to improve retail data availability and reporting capabilities.
Support the development of future retail systems and analytics solutions.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency and governance.
Contribute to the transition from manual Excel-based reporting toward automated analytics.


Cross Functional Collaboration


Work closely with:
Head of Forecast, Budget and Analytics
Category Managers
Retail Operations
Merchandise Planning
Finance
Supply Chain
IT / Digital teams
Act as a trusted analytical partner supporting commercial decisions


Your Journey so far


5–10 years of experience in retail analytics, merchandise planning, business intelligence or commercial performance.
Experience in luxury retail, fashion, travel retail or multi-store environments.
Strong experience analyzing sales, inventory and profitability data.
Experience building dashboards and performance reporting frameworks.
Experience with retail planning systems, BI tools and advanced Excel.


Your Essentials


Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
Excellent understanding of retail business drivers and commercial KPIs.
Ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations.
Strong understanding of inventory management and merchandise planning principles.
Advanced Excel skills and experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau or equivalent).
Strong communication skills and ability to influence stakeholders.
Business-oriented mindset with attention to operational details.
Ability to work in a fast-moving international environment.
Fluent English; additional languages are an advantage.


Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Services industriels

Analyser les besoins BI et de mise à disposition des données, puis coordonner l'élaboration, la mise en oeuvre et le suivi des projets liés aux systèmes commerciaux, notamment en formalisant les exigences métier, en validant les spécifications et en assurant les tests et la mise en production

Master HES en management/informatique ou formation équivalente

Service commercial

Services industriels


Les Services industriels de la Ville de Lausanne (SIL) proposent une palette complète de prestations multifluides qui répondent aux défis d'une société en constante mutation dans le respect de la durabilité et des engagements climatiques. Reconnus comme prestataire de référence sur nos zones de distribution, nous plaçons notre clientèle au centre de nos préoccupations. Ouverts aux changements, nous travaillons ensemble pour l'atteinte d'objectifs communs.


Afin de compléter notre équipe, nous sommes à la recherche d'une ou d'un spécialiste Business Intelligence (BI). Dans ce rôle, vous concevez, mettez en place et faites évoluer des solutions BI à partir des outils disponibles afin de répondre aux besoins métiers liés aux systèmes commerciaux SAP CRM et SAP IS-U. Vous garantissez la qualité, la pertinence et la disponibilité des données, ainsi que leur mise à disposition pour d'autres systèmes, en veillant à leur adéquation avec les besoins fonctionnels.


Vous souhaitez rejoindre une entreprise axée sur le développement durable, l'innovation et la qualité? Rejoignez-nous! Nous vous offrons un poste de travail varié dans un environnement dynamique et collaboratif, une flexibilité du temps de travail, ainsi que des prestations sociales de qualité.


Lieu de travail: Place Chauderon 25, 1003 Lausanne


Missions

  • Assurer le bon fonctionnement et le suivi des demandes d'évolution BI liées aux systèmes commerciaux SAP CRM et SAP IS-U, en analysant les besoins, les solutions possibles et leurs impacts sur les outils de reporting et les processus internes
  • Analyser les besoins BI et de mise à disposition des données, puis coordonner l'élaboration, la mise en oeuvre et le suivi des projets liés aux systèmes commerciaux, notamment en formalisant les exigences métier, en validant les spécifications et en assurant les tests et la mise en production
  • Concevoir, mettre en forme et faire évoluer les indicateurs, rapports et tableaux de bord de la division Administration des ventes à l'aide des outils BI disponibles, notamment Power BI, Tableau, SAP BI et SAP Analysis
  • Modéliser et optimiser les données utilisées dans les rapports, définir les processus d'extraction, de transformation et de chargement des données et contribuer à l'automatisation du reporting en collaboration avec l'IT
  • Gérer le support opérationnel des demandes BI de la section OSM (Outils, Systèmes et Méthodes), notamment les demandes d'extraction de données, le conseil expert et le diagnostic d'anomalies, en garantissant un traitement autonome, priorisé et de qualité
  • Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des processus et solutions BI du Service commercial, renforcer l'autonomie des utilisateurs et participer aux activités opérationnelles de la section OSM


Profil

  • Master HES en management/informatique ou formation équivalente
  • Formation complémentaire en conduite de projets
  • 5 ans d'expérience dans une entreprise de type utilities, dans la gestion d'un système de reporting BI
  • Bonnes connaissances des solutions BI au sein d'un environnement SAP (SAP IS-U, SAP SD, SAP FI-CA, SAP BW et SAP CRM)
  • Capacité à travailler en autonomie et à prendre des initiatives, orientation résultats, précision et rigueur
  • Excellent esprit d'analyse et de synthèse, capacité à piloter ou superviser des projets, créativité et aisance dans la communication
  • Maîtrise des outils Microsoft Office, de SharePoint et Visio ou produits similaires, ainsi que d'un système de gestion et de traitement des demandes tel que Jira


Taux d'activité 80-100%


Classe salariale 10


Entrée en fonction De suite ou à convenir


Renseignements M. Pol Mas Soro, responsable de la section OSM, 021 315 81 24


Postulation

Merci de nous envoyer votre candidature et les documents habituels jusqu'au 16.10.2026 via le formulaire en ligne. En cas d'impossibilité, vous pouvez contacter directement le service au 021 315 87 14.


Agences de recrutement s'abstenir s.v.p.


Nous accordons une grande attention à la diversité des parcours de vie de nos collaboratrices et collaborateurs. Nos postes sont ouverts tant aux femmes qu'aux hommes.


Cette offre ne correspond pas à votre profil? Rejoignez notre communauté LinkedIn et soyez les premières et premiers à découvrir nos futures annonces!

Title: Junior Product and Analytics Specialist (12 months temporary role) (80% - 100%)
Description:
Do you have a client-centric mindset, embrace new technologies easily, and strive for process efficiency? Are you looking for an entry-level position in the financial industry following the completion of your BSc or MSc?

If so, we invite you to explore this opportunity to join Vontobel’s Client Content Center as a Junior Product and Analytics Specialist for our Institutional Clients Segment. In this role, you will be exposed to our Investment Boutiques, which manage over CHF 110bn of client assets across the globe, with a focus on the Multi Asset Boutique.

You will run reports on investment and client data, contribute to process automation, and help deliver high-quality client communications while collaborating with global stakeholders across Client Portfolio Managers, Content Operations & Marketing Enablement and Investment teams, with a focus on the Multi Asset Boutique and the Swiss Institutional business.

What would your role be?


Support client meetings and reporting activities, through data analysis and the preparation of client-facing materials.
Contribute to the enhancement and automation of reporting and presentation processes, helping to improve efficiency and the quality of deliverables used across the business.
Gain hands-on experience in transforming and analyzing investment, fund and client data, translating complex information into clear and meaningful insights.
Collaborate with global teams to enhance presentation content and reporting materials, supporting the continuous evolution of marketing and client communication tools.


What are we looking for?


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with strong quantitative focus, preferably in Finance, Sciences or Engineering
Experience in working in a data management and/or processing role and interest in the asset management sector
Entrepreneurial mind with problem solving skills and a willingness to challenge the status quo
Structured personality with the ability to work on multiple tasks and to effectively communicate with stakeholders
Proficient in MS Office, with strong skills in Excel and PowerPoint; Porfolio Management software, Bloomberg and programming/scripting languages (Python or Matlab) are a plus
Equipped with graphic skills to improve product presentations
Familiar with AI tools and techniques to improve efficiency (automation, agents, reviews, etc.)
Fluent in English and German; Italian, Spanish and/or French is a plus


What do we offer?


Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces and free lunch
Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space
All the latest technology to help you excel and advance
Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other
Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels
Campus feeling and a collaborative spirit


We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. By 2030, we want to be known as one of the leading and most trusted global investment firms. We have 2,300+ engaged professionals, based in 27 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich.

We are both majority family-owned and publicly listed. Our capacity for long-term focus, on topics such as sustainability, is underpinned by the security of the family’s 100-year commitment. Driven by an ownership mindset, you can unlock your potential and translate insights into opportunities. We are hiring talented individuals who are determined to deliver in a changing world and who come from a wide variety of backgrounds. Do you want to be Vontobel?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.

We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone who wants to be part of our performance culture can be themselves. It is based on mutual respect and zero tolerance for any form of discrimination.

If you have any questions you can contact us through our contact form.

Title: Customer Journey Analytics
Description:
About Us:

LTIMindtree is a global technology consulting and digital solutions company that enables enterprises across industries to reimagine business models, accelerate innovation, and maximize growth by harnessing digital technologies. As a digital transformation partner to more than 700+ clients, LTIMindtree brings extensive domain and technology expertise to help drive superior competitive differentiation, customer experiences, and business outcomes in a converging world. Design develop and maintain Adobe Customer Journey Analytics CJA implementations that deliver actionable customer insight
Configure and manage data views connections calculated metrics dimensions filters and derived fields within CJA
Integrate and validate data from Adobe Experience Platform AEP and multiple enterprise sources for customer journey analysis

Translate business reporting requirements into scalable CJA solutions in partnership with stakeholders

Stay current with Adobe Experience Cloud capabilities and drive adoption of best practices in journey measurement attribution and reporting
MustHave Skills
Handson delivery experience with Adobe Customer Journey Analytics CJA
Working knowledge of Adobe Experience Platform AEP schemas datasets identities and data ingestion
Strong grounding in web and app analytics customer journey analysis data modelling and reporting
Proficiency in SQL and structured data validation techniques

Title: Sales Controller & Analytics
Description:
Du verwandelst Zahlen in klare Entscheidungen und möchtest die Vertriebssteuerung aktiv mitgestalten? Dann entwickle mit uns aussagekräftige Analysen, moderne BI-Lösungen und eine datengetriebene Entscheidungsbasis. Als Sparringspartner:in für Vertrieb, Einkauf und Geschäftsleitung schaffst du Transparenz und bringst unser Reporting gezielt weiter.




Deine Aufgaben




Aktive Unterstützung des Vertriebs bei der Steuerung von Umsatz, Ertrag und Kundenentwicklung
Analysen zu Umsatz, Deckungsbeiträgen, Margen, Profitabilität, Beschaffung und Supply Chain
Identifikation von Wachstums- und Optimierungspotenzialen sowie Ableitung konkreter Handlungsempfehlungen
Vorbereitung und Moderation von Performance-Dialogen mit den Fachbereichen
Unterhalt und Weiterentwicklung der Power-BI-Landschaft sowie aussagekräftiger Dashboards
Mitwirkung bei Monatsabschluss, Budget, Forecasting und Managementreporting
Durchführung von Szenario- und Ad-hoc-Analysen
Mitarbeit und Leitung bereichsübergreifender Projekte sowie
Digitalisierung und Automatisierung von Reportingprozessen




Dein Profil




Deine Basis stimmt! Abgeschlossenes Studium in Betriebswirtschaft, Controlling, Finance, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung

Controlling & Analytics: Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Controlling, Business Analytics oder Sales Controlling

BI-Kompetenz: Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Excel und Power BI sowie Erfahrung mit Datenmodellierung und Reportinglösungen

Business-Verständnis: Gutes Verständnis für Vertriebs-, Kunden- und Margensteuerung

Sprachen sind dein Vorteil! Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher in Wort und Schrift; Französisch ist von Vorteil




Das zeichnet dich aus




Analytischer Weitblick - Du erkennst Zusammenhänge, strukturierst komplexe Daten und machst daraus Entscheidungsgrundlagen.

Business Partner:in - Du kommunizierst sicher, arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichen Anspruchsgruppen und überzeugst auf Augenhöhe.

Unternehmerische Denkweise - Du denkst voraus, setzt Prioritäten und leitest konkrete Empfehlungen für das Business ab.

Gestalter:in statt Verwalter:in - Du möchtest Prozesse, Reporting und die Organisation aktiv weiterentwickeln.

Struktur mit Teamspirit - Du arbeitest selbstständig, lösungsorientiert und schätzt die bereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit




Wer wir sind – und warum du zu uns passt




Die Weita AG ist Teil der globalen Bunzl plc. Unternehmensgruppe und eines der führenden Schweizer Handelsunternehmen für Verbrauchsgüter. Unsere Kunden? Spitäler, Heime, Gastronomie, Industrie und viele mehr!




Was uns besonders macht? Unser Teamgeist! Bei uns zählen Respekt, Wertschätzung und eine offene Kommunikation. Wir begegnen uns auf Augenhöhe, lernen voneinander und wachsen gemeinsam.




Was wir dir bieten




Eine abwechslungsreiche Schlüsselrolle mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum
Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsleitung und Fachbereichen
Ein motiviertes Team mit Teamspirit & Spass bei der Arbeit
5 Wochen Ferien plus zusätzliche Brückentage
Prämienbeteiligung bei Sozialversicherungen
Moderne Infrastruktur und eine sorgfältige Einarbeitung
Offene „Du-Kultur“ und bereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit
Vergünstigungen im Webshop, Gratisgetränke und Teamevents

Participer à des projets IA / Machine Learning

R&D

Deliver projects related to the monitoring of the client's digital activity based on key performance indicators (reporting), to onsite conversion optimization through data analysis and webtesting, to online media buy optimization and CRM.

Meet clients' needs and pay strong attention to the quality of all deliverables
Occasional travel possible, within Switzerland or abroad (including Paris)

Master's degree (business, engineering) or equivalent diploma
Experience in digital marketing, consulting firms, marketing or business intelligence software, or media agencies
Working with web analytics tools
Knowledge of the main online acquisition channels: SEO, SEM and bidmanagement, display and programmatic, affiliates, email and social media


Skills and Interests

Fluent in French & English and excellent communication, oral and written
Strong analytical skills and knowledge of analysis, statistical software and data vizualization tool
Good business and market understanding

Good team spirit
Strong interest in new technologies and the digital industry

Title: Analytics & Technology Specialist (80 - 100%)
Description:
Do you want to help shape the future of market surveillance through advanced analytics, technology and data-driven decision making?

Surveillance Assurance & Development (SAD) is responsible for the continuous enhancement of surveillance capabilities supporting SIX Exchange Regulation's mission to detect market abuse and rule violations, including insider trading, market and price manipulation. SAD acts as the bridge between market surveillance, business stakeholders and IT, driving the evolution of surveillance systems, analytical models and technologies while ensuring their effectiveness and quality.

As an Analytics & Technology Specialist, you will play a key role in developing and improving surveillance methodologies, alert logic and analytical solutions. You will work closely with Markets Supervision & Investigations (MSI) and IT to assess new opportunities, evaluate the effectiveness of existing controls and identify innovative approaches to strengthen market surveillance.

The role combines advanced analytics, statistics, surveillance expertise and technology. You will contribute to the design and evolution of surveillance scenarios, assess the impact of new requirements, and leverage advanced analytics, statistical methods, artificial intelligence and data science techniques to enhance surveillance effectiveness. At the same time, you will help ensure continuity of key surveillance solutions while supporting the ongoing transformation towards a cloud-based technology landscape.

 

What You Will Do  
Ensure continuity of selected surveillance solutions, data assets and technical processes currently maintained by the departing Data Engineer, while supporting the gradual transition of some responsibilities to IT.
Analyse, review and enhance market surveillance alerts, detection methodologies, scenarios, parameters and thresholds, applying advanced analytics, statistical methods and AI/ML techniques to improve surveillance effectiveness.
Assess the impact of new features, business requirements and regulatory changes on surveillance processes and systems, and identify required enhancements.
Evaluate new surveillance approaches, anomaly detection techniques and emerging technologies, contributing to the evolution of market surveillance capabilities.
Translate surveillance and business requirements into technical specifications and implementation concepts, and collaborate closely with business and IT teams throughout design, testing and implementation.
What You Bring 
University degree in Finance, Economics, Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science or a related field. 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including experience with statistical analysis, anomaly detection and model evaluation, combined with the ability to assess and improve analytical models, alert calibration and detection methodologies.
Strong SQL and Python skills and experience analysing large datasets, ideally using modern analytics platforms such as Azure, Databricks, Spark/PySpark. Knowledge of AI-assisted analytics tools and techniques is considered an advantage.
Experience in financial markets, market surveillance or transaction reporting is considered a strong asset. 
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and IT functions. 
Fluent in English (both verbal & writing), German is a plus.

Title: Underwriting Portfolio Analyst - Motor & Haushalt (m/w/d)
Description:
136760 | 70 - 100% | Oerlikon, Zürich | Hybrid

Möchtest du das Portfolio Management von morgen mitgestalten? Bei uns verwandelst du Daten gemeinsam im Team in echte Erkenntnisse – und entwickelst mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern Lösungen, die unser Geschäft wirklich voranbringen.

Als Underwriting Portfolio Analyst – Motor & Haushalt bist du Teil des Geschäftsbereichs P&C Underwriting im Team Portfolio Management und gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung von Zurich Schweiz aktiv mit. Dabei bringst du deine Fähigkeiten ein, um gemeinsam mit uns aus Daten wertvolle Einblicke zu gewinnen und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Underwriting-Strategien zu unterstützen. Du verbindest analytisches Denken mit deinem Wissen über den Markt und unsere Produkte, um zusammen mit dem Team fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen und unser Portfolio optimal zu steuern. Im engen Austausch mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus verschiedenen Bereichen gestaltest du strategische Initiativen aktiv mit und trägst so dazu bei, unser Portfolio nachhaltig weiterzuentwickeln.

Das erwartet dich


Du bringst deine analytischen Fähigkeiten und dein Wissen über den Markt und Nichtlebensversicherungsprodukte ein, um gemeinsam mit verschiedenen Teams Lösungen zu entwickeln und das Privatkundenportfolio zu steuern
Du analysierst unser Versicherungsportfolio im Detail und identifizierst im Austausch mit anderen gezielt Optimierungsmöglichkeiten
Du entwickelst und implementierst gemeinsam mit deinem Team Methoden und Tools, die die Portfolio-Analyse und -Optimierung voranbringen
Du unterstützt die Definition und Erstellung von Metriken, KPIs und Dashboards, um die datenbasierte Steuerung der Abteilung im Team zu stärken
Du gewinnst wertvolle Erkenntnisse aus Daten und nutzt diese, um gemeinsam die Underwriting-Strategie weiterzuentwickeln und die gesetzten Ziele zu erreichen


Das zeichnet dich aus


Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium in Wirtschafts- oder Naturwissenschaften, Mathematik, Statistik, Data Science oder (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, oder gleichwertige Berufserfahrung in der Versicherungswirtschaft
Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Nichtlebensversicherungsgeschäft, idealerweise in Portfolioanalyse oder Produktmanagement, sowie tiefes Verständnis der wichtigsten Werttreiber und Steuerungs-Kennzahlen (KPIs); ergänzende Erfahrung im Underwriting willkommen
Ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten, hohe Präsentationsstärke sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Analysen klar zu strukturieren und adressatengerecht für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufzubereiten
Sicherer Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken, grossen Datenmengen und mindestens einer Programmiersprache (z.B. SQL oder Python), Erfahrung in der Aufbereitung von Daten für fundierte Business-Entscheidungen; aktuarielles Wissen von Vorteil
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift


Gut zu wissen

Teilzeit oder Vollzeit: 70 - 100%

Arbeitsort: Oerlikon, Zürich

Stellenantritt: ab 01.02.2026 oder nach Vereinbarung

Location: Romont, Switzerland

Work model: On site / Hybrid / Full time

Contract type / duration: Permanent

Reimagine what coffee can be. Reimagine what you can become.

As a SPX Data Specialist / Data Engineer at Nespresso, your mission is to turn sensory, consumer, product and market data into trusted insights that strengthen coffee superiority, coffee authority and consumer centricity. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with Sensory and Product Experience, Product Development Center, Coffee Expertise, Innovation, Marketing, Artificial Intelligence and Data Science, NPTC Coffee, and information technology and data teams. This is your opportunity to elevate the world of coffee through meaningful results that drive positive impact.

How you’ll make an impact as a SPX Data Specialist / Data Engineer


Leading data flows across sensory, consumer, product, technical, market and operational sources to enable trusted and faster decision-making.
Building strong data foundations that improve quality, accessibility and governance for strategic coffee projects.
Embedding scalable analytics into innovation and renovation governance so teams can identify risks earlier and make stronger portfolio choices.
Developing reusable models, dashboards and decision tools that increase insight speed, traceability and self-service.
Partnering with data and technology teams to create reliable systems, pipelines and digital solutions for product development.
Growing analytical capability across teams through training, coaching and practical ways of working that support a data-driven culture.


What Will Make You Successful


Bringing strong expertise in data analysis, modelling and business intelligence to turn complex information into actionable recommendations.
Applying knowledge of data governance, data quality and decision-support methodologies to build trusted and scalable insight solutions.
Solid experience within Power BI, Python, Azure, Power Query, VBA or R Shiny to automate analysis, reporting and digital workflows.
Collaborating with cross-functional teams to influence priorities, align methods and drive adoption of data-driven practices.
Communicating fluently in English and French.
Embodying our WECAN behaviors: We Inspire, we Care, we Act, and we Innovate, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.


What To Expect From Our Hiring Process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Title: Pricing Analyst / Specialist (m/f/x)
Description:
Your Responsibilities

In this position you will take ownership for the pricing strategy within BU AxM and drive its continuous development, defining and implementing pricing approaches based on key business drivers and market dynamics
You will provide data-driven insights, analyses and tools to support management in shaping pricing strategies and preparing customer quotations while ensuring a solid and consistent data foundation
You will monitor, identify and leverage additional price quotations beyond existing databases to benchmark products and parts, supporting accurate and competitive pricing decisions
You will develop and implement IT tools that foster long-term transparency and a deeper understanding of pricing structures
You will closely monitor product life cycle changes and manage the regular pricing updates regarding spare parts
You will define and manage pricing strategies for specific internal and external requests, including new components, parts, kits and projects
You will collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Product Management, Controlling, Customer Service and Sales to align pricing structures, including product feature segregation, margin calculations and quotation processes
You will support further role-related activities, including maintaining the component-machine customer database, contributing to external market development, and benchmarking within the Construction & Mining Machinery industry


Your Profile

You have successfully completed a degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance or equivalent
You bring strong business acumen with a solid understanding of pricing, margins, value propositions and market dynamics
You have a good understanding of high-level hydraulic component features
You are experienced in data analysis and market research, ideally in a Data, Finance or Business Analyst role, with the ability to turn data into actionable insights
You are proficient in MS Office, ERP systems and Power BI
You combine strong analytical skills with a structured and detail-oriented way of working. With your business mindset, proactive approach and clear communication style, you collaborate effectively with stakeholders across different functions
You are fluent in English and have good knowledge of German and French


Our Offer
Can we inspire you to take on a responsible position in a dynamic and independent family business? We offer you room for ideas, a secure job, modern and family-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, home office, a company restaurant, training opportunities as well as many benefits. The workplace is located in Bulle, surrounded by the wonderful nature of the Gruyère region. Start planning your personal and professional development with us.
In order to ensure a fair application process, we cannot accept applications by post or email.

Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Anna KOMARDINA.
One Passion. Many Opportunities.

The Company
Liebherr Machines Bulle SA is the centre of excellence for combustion engines (diesel and gas engines) and hydraulic components (axial piston pumps and motors). The company develops and produces various products, which find their use in building construction and civil engineering, mining, agriculture, decentralised energy, machine and plant engineering, as well as aerospace.

2 years of experience in Data Science, Applied AI, or similar technical roles.

2 years of experience or familiarity with one or more of the following languages: SQL, R, Python, or C++.
Experience in deriving actionable insights, root causes, and intelligence from complex data sources across cybersecurity or anti-fraud, protecting users against cyber threats, and using AI to automate complex processes or operations
Ability to understand complex engineering systems and processes.
Excellent communication and presentation skills and the ability to influence cross-functionally at various levels.
Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills with attention to detail and focus on getting things done.


About The Job

Trust & Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know-how, excellent problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big-picture thinker and strategic team-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed - with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.

You will join a team of engineering analysts dedicated to protecting Google accounts and products from emerging threats. In this role, you will be at the cross-roads of cyber-security and AI, designing and implementing machine learning models and AI-powered agents to solve some of our most critical business challenges.

You will play a key part in a fast-paced environment where you will have the chance to apply your analytical and technical skills to complex problems at a global scale. This is more than just a job; it's an opportunity to learn, innovate, and make a real impact.

At Google we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust & Safety is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. We partner with teams across Google to deliver bold solutions in abuse areas such as malware, spam and account hijacking. A team of Analysts, Policy Specialists, Engineers, and Program Managers, we work to reduce risk and fight abuse across all of Google’s products, protecting our users, advertisers, and publishers across the globe in over 40 languages.

Responsibilities


Build a new AI-based capability leveraging our Transformers-based detection system to evolve and automate Incident Response, while generating threat intelligence that is relevant to protect Google accounts.
Transform, automate and scale up our team processes by developing AI Agents.Automate a large fraction of our operational workload, like alert generation and incident analysis, using techniques derived from ML, LLMs, operations research.
Apply our threat intelligence to be ready to respond to new adversarial campaigns.
Manage the response to incidents targeting Google Accounts, including the special response in case of severe incidents in collaboration with other partner teams.
Work with our Operations team to scale the operational work required to protect Google accounts, e.g, managing low severity escalations and alerts, and maintaining the ground truth quality. Provide the training and work to get tooling improvements when needed.
